Mishneh Torah, Second Tithes and Fourth:
Halokeach behema lezivche shelamim vechayya livsar taava mimmi sheeno taggar veeno medakdek yatza haor lechullin. afillu hayu deme haor merubbin al deme habbasar. aval hallokeach min hattaggar lo yatza haor lechullin: 
Vechen hallokeach kadde yayin setumot mimmakom sheddarkam lehimmacher setumot mimmi sheeno taggar yatza hakkankan lechullin. lefichach tzarich hammocher liftoach rashe hakkaddim kede shello yetze hakkankan lechullin. veim ratza lehachamir al atzmo velimkor bemidda yatza hakkankan lechullin: 
Lekachan petuchot o setumot bemakom sheddarkan lehimmacher petuchot. o shellakach min hattaggar shemmedakdek bimchirato lo yatza hakkankan lechullin. lakach salle teenim vaanavim im hakkeli lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin: 
Lakach egozim ushekedim vechayyotze bahen yatzu kelippatan lechullin. lakach chotal shel temarim yatza hachotal lechullin. kuppa shel temarim im derusot yatzu hakkuppot lechullin. veim lav lo yatzu lechullin: 
Mi shehaya lo yayin shel maaser sheni vehishil kankannav leoto maaser. af al pi shessatam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim. kinnes hayyayin letocho setam im kara shem veasahu maaser ad shello satam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim. veim mishshessatam pihen kara shem veasahu maaser kana maaser et hakkankan. hifkid letoch hakkankan reviit chullin o shekkanas letochan shemen o chometz o tzir o devash shel maaser sheni setam ben mishshessatam ben ad shello satam lo kana maaser et hakkankannim: 
Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser umet yikkaver beoro. lekacho chay ushechato venitma hare ze yippade kishar perot shennitmeu. hammanniach dinar maaser sheni lihyot ochel kenegdo ad sheyyetze lechullin vehaya haddinar yotze beesrim maa. achal alav beeser maa vehuzzelu hammaot leachar zeman vahare haddinar yotze bearbaim maa tzarich leechol alav beesrim maa veachar kach yetze lechullin. hukeru hammaot vahare haddinar yotze beeser main ochel alav bechamesh main veachar kach yetze lechullin: 
Hallokeach perot besela shel kesef maaser umashach happerot velo hispik litten hassela ad shehukeru happerot veamdu bishtayim. hare ze mafrish alehen sela bilvad shenneemar venatan (et) hakkesef vekam lo. bintinat hakkesef kone. vehassachar lamaaser: 
Mashach perot bishte selaim velo hispik litten hammaot ad shehuzelu happerot veamdu besela eno mafrish alehen mimmeot maaser sheni ella sela achat. umosif aleha sela sheniyya min hachullin venoten lammocher. veim haya hammocher am haaretz hare ze muttar litten sela sheniyya mimmeot maaser sheni shel demay. natan lo sela shel maaser velo hispik limshoch happerot ad sheamdu bishtayim. ma sheppada pada vehaddin benehen: 
Natan lo selaim shetayim shel maaser velo hispik limshoch happerot ad shechazru lihyot besela ma sheppada pada. umiddat haddin benehem shehammaaser sheni pediyyato hi meshichato: 
Mi shehayu lo perot chullin birushalayim vehayu lo meot maaser sheni chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al happerot haellu veyochlem sham betohora veyetzu otan hammaot lechullin bimkoman: 
Hayu lo meot maaser sheni birushalayim veyesh lo perot chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem veyetzu hammaot lechullin veyaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. sheeno tzarich lihyot hammaot vehapperot bemakom echad bishat hachillul: 
Mi shehayu lo meot maaser birushalayim vetzarich lahem. veyesh lachavero perot chullin sherotze leachlan. omer lachavero hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha venimtzeu otam happerot lekuchot bechesef maaser veyochal otam chavero betohora. velo hifsid kelum. veyatzu hammaot lechullin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya chavero baal happerot chaver. sheen mosrin perot shel maaser sheni shel vadday ella lechaver. lefichach im hayu hammaot shel demay omer ken af leam haaretz. umuttar lechallel maaser sheni al perot am haaretz veal meotav veen choshshin lahem shemma shel maaser sheni hem: 
Hammanniach dinar shel maaser lihyot ochel kenegdo veholech kevan sheachal alav ad shello nishar mimmennu (ella) pachot mipperuta yatza lechullin. bamme devarim amurim beshel demay aval beshel vadday lo yetze lechullin ad sheyyishshaer mimmennu pachot mishsheve peruta achar shemmosifin et hachomesh. kegon shennishar mimmennu pachot mearbaa chumshe sheve peruta: 
Temein utehorin shehayu ochlin o shotin keechad birushalayim. veratzu hattehorin lihyot ochlin maaser sheni shellahem. mannichin sela shel maaser sheni veomer. kol shehattehorim ochlim veshotin sela zo mechullal alav. vetetze hassela lechullin shehare achlu veshatu beshavyah betohora. uvilvad shello yiggeu hattemeim bamaachol shello yetammeuhu:

Neta revai hare hu kodesh. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 24)</small> "uvashshana harviit yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim laAdonai". vedino leheachel birushalayim livalav kemaaser sheni. ucheshem sheen maaser sheni besureya kach en neta revai besureya. uveneta revai hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 5 10)</small> "veish et kodashav lo yihyu" sheen lecha kodesh shello nitparesh dino battora lemi shehu chutz minneta revai: 
Harotze lifdot neta revai podehu kemaaser sheni. veim padahu leatzmo mosif chomesh. veen podin oto ad sheyyaggiu leonat hammaaser shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 25)</small> "lehosif lachem tevuato" ad sheyyaase tevua. veen podin oto bimchubbar kemaaser sheni vahare hu mamon gavoah kemaaser. lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im netano boser. vedino bishar haddevarim leinyan achila ushetiyya ufediyya kemaaser: 
Vehappode kerem revai ratza podehu anavim ratza podehu yayin. vechen hazzetim. aval shear happerot en meshannin otan mibberiyyatan: 
Kerem revai en lo lo shichcha velo pea velo peret velo olelot. veen mafrishin mimmennu teruma umaasrot keshem sheen mafrishin mimmaaser sheni. ella kullo ole lirushalayim o nifde veyaalu haddamim veyeachlu birushalayim kemaaser: 
Anavim shel kerem revai hitkinu bet din sheyyihyu olin lirushalayim mahalach yom lechol tzad kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot. umishecharav bet hammikdash nifde afillu samuch lachoma. ushear kol happerot afillu bizman bet hammikdash nifdin samuch lachoma: 
Ketzad podin neta revai. meniach et hassal al pi shelosha veomdin kamma adam rotze lifdot lo bassela al menat sheyyotzi yetziot hashshomrim vehachamarim vehappoalim mibbeto. veachar shekkotzvin et hashshaar manniach et hammaot veomer kol hannilkat mizze mechullal al hammaot ellu mishshaar kach vechach sallim besela. uvashsheviit podehu beshavyo sheen sham lo shomrim velo poalim. veim haya hefker en lo ella sechar lekita bilvad: 
Mi shehaya lo neta revai bishnat hashshemitta sheyyad hakkol shava tzarich letzayyeno bekozazot adama kede sheyyakkiru bo. velo yochlu mimmennu ad sheyyippadu. veim haya betoch shene arla metzayyenin oto bacharasim kede sheyyifreshu mimmennu. sheim tziyyenu bekozazot adama shemma yitparru. sheissur arla chamur hu shehi asura bahanaya. vehatztzenuin hayu mannichin et hammaot bishnat shemitta veomrin kol hannilkat mipperot revai ellu mechullal al hammaot haellu shehare i efshar lifdoto bimchubbar kemo shebbearnu: 
Beechad betishre rosh hashshana learla velirvai. umeematay monin lahem mishsheat netia. veeno mone merosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella sheloshim yom beshana chashuvin shana. vehu shettiklot hannetia kodem sheloshim yom. vechamma hu setam hakkelita lechol hailanot shete shabbatot: 
Nimtzet lamed shehannotea 44 yom kodem rosh hashshana alta lo shana. veaf al pi chen en perot hannetia hazzot muttarot bearla ella birviit ad 15 bishvat shehu rosh hashshana lailanot: 
Ketzad. hannotea ilan maachol betv beav mishshana asirit bayyovel. hare hu betoch shene arla ad 15 bishvat mishshenat 13. vechol ma sheyyotzi hailan betoch zeman ze hare hu arla af al pi shennigmeru leachar kamma yamim. umitv bishvat mishshenat 13 beyovel ad 15 bishvat mishshenat 14 hu neta revai. vechol ma sheyyotzi betoch zeman ze hare hu revai vetzarich pidyon. veim nitabbera hashshana nitabbera laarla o larvai: 
Nitan beshishsha asar beav mishshenat eser lo alta lo shenat eser ella hare hu arla shenat 11 veyv veyg kullah. vahare hu neta revai merosh hashshana shel shenat 14 ad sofah: 
Nata hannetia merosh chodesh tishre ad 15 bishvat mone lah shalosh shanim miyyom leyom learla umiyyom leyom lirvai. veraiti laggeonim devarim becheshbon arla urevai en rauy lehaarich ulehashiv alehen uvevadday taut sofrim hem vehaemet kevar bearnu darkah: 
Healin vehallulavin ume gefanim vehassemadar muttarin bearla uvirvai. vehaanavim shesserafam hakkadim vehifsidan vehachartzannim vehazzaggin vehattemed shellahen ukelippe rimmon vehannetz shello ukelippe egozim vehaggarinim asurin bearla umuttarin birvai. vehannovlot kullan asurot:
Kol shehu chayyav bearla yesh lo revai. vechol sheppatur min haarla eno chayyav birvai shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim" vegomer uvashshana harviit:

Hannotea ilan maachol vedato alav sheyyihye seyag lagginna. o shennetao lekorot lo leferot. hare ze patur min haarla. netao lisyag vechazar vechashav alav lemaachol o shennetao lemaachol vechazar vechashav alav lisyag. kevan sheerev bo machshevet chiyyuv chayyav. netao shalosh shanim lisyag umikkan veelach lemaachol en lo revai. shekkol sheen lo arla en lo revai:

Nata ilan vechashav sheyyihye hatztzad happenimi shello lemaachol vehachitzon lisyag. o sheyyihye hatztzad hattachton lemaachol vehaelyon lisyag. ze shechashav alav lemaachol chayyav baarla. veze shechashav alav lisyag o leetzim patur. shehaddavar taluy bedato shel notea. vehatztzalaf chayyav bearla haevyonot bilvad aval hakkafrisin muttarot:
Hannotea larabbim betoch sadehu chayyav bearla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "unetatem" afillu larabbim. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval bechutza laaretz patur:
Hannotea birshut harabbim o bisfina. vehaole meelav birshut hayyachid. veakkum shennata ben leyisrael ben leatzmo. vehaggazlan shennata. chayyavin baarla uvirvai:

Haole meelav bimkom terashim patur. afillu hannotea bemakom sheeno yishshuv patur. vehu shello yihye ose kede tippul shemmetappel beferotav ad shemmevian layyishshuv. aval im haya ose kede tippulo chayyav bearla:
Hannotea lemitzva kegon shennata etrog lelulav o zayit lammenora chayyav baarla. hikdish veachar kach nata patur min haarla. nata veachar kach hikdish chayyav bearla:
Hannotea beatzitz sheeno nakuv chayyav bearla. af al pi sheeno keeretz lizraim hare hu keeretz leilanot:

Ilan shennetao betoch habbayit chayyav bearla. ze shennetao akkum ad shello bau avotenu laaretz patur. aval mishshebbau laaretz af ma shennatu akkum chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "ki tavou el haaretz unetatem". mishsheat bia:
Akkum shehirkiv ilan maachol al gabbe ilan serak chayyav bearla. veyesh laakkum neta revai. sheim ba linhog bemitzva zo hare hu kodesh keneta revai shel yisrael:

Echad hannotea garina o yichur min hailan o sheakar et kol hailan mimmekomo unetao bemakom acher hare ze chayyav bearla. umone mishsheat netiato. zizeo velo akaro veachar kach mille sevivotav beafar. im yachol lichyot illu lo mille sevivotav hare ze patur. veim lav hare ze kemo sheakar venata vechayyav:

Vechen ilan shenneekar venishar mimmennu shoresh echad. afillu kemachat shemmelappefin alav harokmin et hashshani vehechziro limkomo venata patur. mippene sheyyachol lichyot. neekar kullo veneekra hassela sheshsharashav bah immo vechazar unetao kema shehu bechol haadama shessevivot sharashav. im haya yachol lichyot meotah adama illu lo nata hare hu kemi shello neekar. veim lav chayyav:
Ilan shekkitztzetzo meim haaretz vehechlif chayyav bearla umonin lo mishsheat ketzitza:

Echad hannotea veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv chayyav. bamme devarim amurim beshechatach bad echad min hailan vehivricho baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher. aval im matach bad echad min hailan hazzaken vehivrich baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher veikkar habbad meore bailan hazzaken hare ze patur:

Gadal ze hayyeled shehivrich veasa perot. veachar kach pasak ikkaro shehu meore bailan hazzaken. mone mishshaa shennifsak. veotan happerot muttarin mippene sheggadlu behetter. veim hinnichan achar shennifsak haikkar ad shehosifu bematayim hare ellu asurin:
Yalda shessibbecha bizkena vehayu perot bayyalda afillu hosifu matayim hare ellu happerot shel yalda asurin. sheen giddule hetter maalin et haikkar haasur:

Ilan shehivrich mimmennu bad baaretz veachar kach neekar hailan kullo vahare hu chay min habbad shehivrich baaretz naasa oto ilan keillu atta nitta vechayyav bearla. umone lailan ulema shetztzamach min hahavracha mishshaa shenneekar:

Hare shehivrich bad baaretz vetzamach. vehivrich bad echad mimma shetztzamach baaretz vetzamach. vechazar vehivrich min hashshelishi afillu hen [mea] meorin ze baze hoil velo nifseku min haikkar harishon hakkol muttar. veim nifsak ikkar harishon mone lakkol mishshaa shennifsak:

Ilan hayyotze min haggeza patur min haarla. min hashsharashim chayyav. yalda pechuta mittefach chayyevet bearla kol shenoteha mippene shenniret kintia bat shenatah. bamme devarim amurim bintia achat o shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav. aval im haya hakkerem kullo pachot mittefach hare ze yesh lo kol umonin kederech shemmonin lishar hailanot:

Notin yichur shel arla veen notin egoz shel arla mippene shehu peri. uferot arla asurin bahanaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot. veim avar venata egoz shel arla hare hatztzomeach muttar kishar hailanot:

Vechen en markivin kafniyyot shel arla bidkalim mippene shehen kifri. avar vehirkiv muttar shekkol davar sheyyesh lo shene gormin echad asur veechad muttar hare ze hannigram mishshenehem muttar. lefichach hatztzomeach mipperot arla muttar shehare gorem litzmoach happeri haasur vehaaretz hammutteret:
Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot lifnoy Adonai achar shemmotziin kol hammattanot shebbezera haaretz vezehu hannikra vidduy maaser:

Veen mitvaddin vidduy ze ella achar hashshana shemmafrishin bah maasar ani shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "ki techalle laser" <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit":

Ematay mitvaddin. bemincha beyom tov haacharon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "ki techalle laser". beregel shekkol hammaasrot kalim bo. veen happesach maggia mishshana reviit ella kol perot shelishit nitasseru ben perot hailan ben perot haaretz:
En mitvaddin ella bayyom. vechol hayyom kasher levidduy hammaaser. uven bifne habbayit uven shello bifne habbayit chayyav levaer ulehitvaddot:

Vidduy ze neemar bechol lashon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha" bechol lashon sheatta omer. vechol echad veechad omro bifne atzmo. veim ratzu rabbim lehitvaddot keechad mitvaddin:
Umitzvato bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "lifne Adonai". veim hitvadda bechol makom yatza:

Eno mitvadde ad shello yishshaer etzlo achat min hammattanot. shekken hu omer bavvidduy <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit". veerev yom tov haacharon haya habbiur ulemachar mitvaddin:

Ketzad hu ose. im nishar etzlo teruma uterumat maaser notnah lakkohen. maaser rishon notno lelevi. maasar ani notno laaniyyim. nisharu etzlo perot maaser sheni shel vadday o neta revai o meot pediyyatan hare ze mevaaran umashlich layyam o soref. nishar etzlo maaser sheni shel demay eno chayyav levaaro. nishar etzlo bikkurim hare hen mitbaarin bechol makom:

Bamme devarim amurim shessoref umevaer keshennisharu etzlo perot sheeno yachol leechol kullan kodem sheyyikkanes yom tov. aval im nishar tavshil shel maaser sheni veneta revai eno tzarich levaaro shehattavshil kimvoar. vechen yayin vetavlin hare hen kimvoarin:
Perot shello higgiu leonat hammaasrot bishat habbiur en meakkevin oto lehitvaddot veeno chayyav levaaran:

Mi shehayu perotav rechokin mimmennu vehiggia yom habbiur hare ze kore shem lammattanot umezakke lahen levalehen al gav karka o lemi shezzoche lahen levaalehen umitvadde lemachar. shennetinat hammittaltelin al gabbe karka enah ella mattana sheyyesh bah chizzuk. aval eno yachol lehakenot lahem hammaaser bachalifin mippene shennire kimchira. vehammaasrot vehatterumot vehammattanot neemar bahen netina lo mechira:

Uminnayin sheeno yachol lehitvaddot ad sheyyotzi kol hammattanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit". hakkodesh ze maaser sheni veneta revai hakkaruy kodesh. min habbayit zo challa shehi hammattana shel kohanim babbayit. netattiv lallevi ze maaser rishon. vegam netattiv mikkelal shekkedamattu mattana acheret vehi teruma gedola uterumat maaser. lagger layyatom velaalmana ze maasar ani veleket shichcha ufea. af al pi sheen leket shichcha ufea meakkevin et havvidduy:

Vetzarich lehaferish hammattanot al hasseder veachar kach yitvadde shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "kechol mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani". ha im hikdim maaser sheni lerishon eno yachol lehitvaddot. nisraf tivlo eno yachol lehitvaddot shehare lo hifrish mattanot velo netanan levaalehen. uvizman shehayu notnin maaser rishon lakkohanim lo hayu mitvaddin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "vegam netattiv lallevi":

Mi sheen lo ella maaser sheni bilvad mitvadde. sheikkar havvidduy bammaaser hu. vechen im lo haya lo ella bikkurim bilvad mitvadde shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh". hakkodesh harishon shehu habbikkurim. aval mi sheen lo ella teruma bifne atzmah eno mitvadde sheen hatteruma teuna vidduy ella bichlal shear hammattanot:

<small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "lo avarti mimmitzvotecha" shello hifrish mimmin al sheeno mino. velo min hattalush al hamechubbar. velo min hamechubbar al hattalush. velo min hechadash al hayyashan. velo min hayyashan al hechadash. velo shachachti shello shachach millevarcho umillehazkir shemo alav. lo achalti veoni mimmennu ha im achalo baanino eno mitvadde. velo viarti mimmennu betame ha im hifrisho betuma eno mitvadde. velo natatti mimmennu lemet shello lakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin velo netano leonnim acherim. shamati bekol Adonai elohay shehevio levet habbechira. asiti kechol asher tzivvitani shessamach vesimmeach bo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta vechol hattov":

<small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim" ad <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udevash" zo bakkasha sheyyitten taam bapperot:

Yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim. aval lo gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim mippene sheen lahem chelek baaretz vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "veet haadama asher natatta lanu". kohanim uleviyyim mitvaddim sheaf al pi shello natlu chelek baaretz yesh lahem are migrash: seliku lehu hilchot maaser sheni veneta revai besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, First Fruits and other Gi:
Esrim vearba mattanot nittenu lakkohanim vechullan meforashin battora. veal kullan nichreta berit leaharon. vechol kohen sheeno mode bahen en lo chelek bakkohanim veen notnin lo mattana mehen: 
Vechol haochel mattana sheyyesh bah kedushsha mevarech asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu leechol kach vechach: 
Shemone mattanot mehem en ochlim otan hakkohanim ella bammikdash lefanim mechomat haazara. vechamesh mattanot en ochlin otan ella birushalayim lefanim mechomat hair. vechamesh mattanot en zochin bahen min hattora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad. vechamesh mattanot zochin bahen ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. umattana achat zochin bah min hammikdash: 
Ma hen hashshemone sheen neechalin ella bammikdash. besar hachattat echad chattat haof veechad chattat habbehema. uvesar haasham ben taluy ben vadday. vezivche shalme tzibbur. umotar haomer. usheyare menachot yisrael. ushete hallechem. velechem happanim. velog shemen shel metzora. ellu enan neechalin ella bammikdash: 
Uma hen hechamesh sheenan neechalin ella birushalayim. chaze veshok shel shelamim. vehammuram min hattoda. vehammuram meel nazir. uvechor behema tehora. vehabbikkurim. ellu enan neechalin ella birushalayim: 
Uma hen hechamesh shebbeeretz yisrael. hatteruma. uterumat maaser. vehachalla. ushelashtan kodesh. vereshit haggez. usede achuzza. ushenehen chullin. ellu enan zochin bahen min hattora ella beeretz yisrael. veen ochlin terumot vechallot shel eretz yisrael ella beeretz yisrael: 
Uma hen hechamesh shezzochin bahen hakkohanim bechol makom. hammattanot. ufidyon habben. ufeter chamor. vegezel hagger. vehacharamim. vachamishshetan chullin lechol davar: 
Vehammattana shezzochin bah min hammikdash hi orot haolot. vehu haddin lishar orot kadshe hakkadashim kullan lakkohanim: 
Hashshemone mattanot sheenan neechalin ella bammikdash kullan kadshe kadashim hen veenan neechalim ella lezichre kehunna kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. uvahen neemar <small>(Vayikra 6 22)</small> "kol zachar bakkohanim yochal oto" vegomer: 
Hechamesh shebbirushalayim hen kadashim kallim veneechalin lizcharim velinkevot uvahen neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 11)</small> "lecha netattim ulevanecha velivnotecha ittecha lechak olam". veaf al pi chen en nittanin ella lezichre kehunna shehare leanshe mishmar hen. vehabbechor makrivin chelbo vedamo veen makrivo ella ish. vechen orot kadshe hakkadashim. usede achuzza. vehacharamim. vegezel hagger. en zochin bahen ella anshe mishmar kemo sheyyitbaer. vechen pidyon habben lezichre kehunna shekken neemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 3 48)</small> "venatatta hakkesef leaharon ulevanav". ufeter chamor lezichre kehunna. sheddin habbechorot kullan shave lizcharim velo linkevot: 
Hinne lamadta shehammattanot shennittanin linkevot kizcharim chamesh mattanot. teruma. uterumat maaser. vechalla. umattenot behema. vereshit haggez. uminnayin atta omer shereshit haggez nittenet lakkohanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo". ma reshit dagan nittenet linkevot kizcharim af reshit haggez: 
Manu chachamim mattanot ellu al derech acheret veamru esrim vearba mattenot kehunna nittenu leaharon veellu hen. eser bammikdash. arba birushalayim. veeser baggevulin: 
Eser bammikdash. chattat behema. vechattat haof. asham. veasham taluy. zivche shalme tzibbur. velog shemen shel metzora. shete hallechem. velechem happanim. sheyare menachot. umotar haomer: 
Arba birushalayim. habbechor. vehabbikkurim. umuram mittoda veel nazir. veorot kadashim: 
Eser baggevulin. teruma. uterumat maaser. vechalla. vereshit haggez. vehammattanot. ufidyon habben. ufidyon peter chamor. sede charamim. usede achuzza. vegezel hagger. ulefi cheshbon ze chashshev kol hammuram mikkadashim kallim mattana achat. vehen chaze veshok hammuram mikkol zevach shelamim im hallechem hammuram immahem [im haya toda. im hazzeroa hammuremet meel nazir im hallechem hammuram immah] im chaze veshok. hoil ushelashtan shelamim hen chashov hammuram mehem mattana achat: 
Kol hammattanot shehen teluyot bakkarbanot titbaer kol achat veachat bimkomah behilchot karbanot. vechen gezel hagger yitbaer behilchot gezela. uchevar bearnu din sede achuzza vedin hacharamim behilchot erchin. vedin teruma uterumat maaser behilchot terumot. uvahalachot ellu avaer mishpete hammattanot sheen teluyin bekarbanot. vehen: habbikkurim. vehachalla. vehammattanot. vereshit haggez. ufidyon habben. ufeter chamor:

Mitzvat ase lehavi bikkurim lammikdash. veenam nohagin ella bifne habbayit uveeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha". umeviin bikkurim shel divrehem meare sichon veog umissureya. shehakkone besureya kakkone birushalayim. [aval ammon umoav uvavel] af al pi shehen chayyavin bitruma uvemaasrot middivrehem en meviin mehen bikkurim. veim hevi bikkurim michutz laaretz enan bikkurim: 
En meviin bikkurim ella mishshivat hamminin haamurim beshevach haaretz. vehem hachittim vehasseorim vehaanavim vehatteenim veharimmonim vehazzetim vehattemarim. veim hevi chutz mishshivat hamminin lo nitkaddeshu: 
En meviin lo mittemarim shebbeharim. velo mipperot shebbaamakim. velo mizzete shemen sheenan min hammuvchar. ella mittemarim shebbaamakim umipperot shebbeharim lefi shehen min hammuvchar [veim hevi shello min hammuvchar] kegon temarim shebbeharim uteenim surot umerukkavot vaanavim meubbakot umeushshanot lo nitkaddeshu: 
En meviin bikkurim mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "peri haadama" [velo mashke]. veim hevi mashkin en mekabbelin mimmennu: 
Hakkerovim lirushalayim meviin teenim vaanavim lachim. veharchokin meviin otan gerogarot vetzimmukin: 
En meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 16)</small> "vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha". veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu ella yannichem sham ad shettavo atzeret veyikra alehen. vechen en meviin bikkurim achar chanukka. shehabbikkurim shebbikkeru achar chanukka hen chashuvin mishshana habbaa. veyannichem ad achar atzeret: 
En meviin bikkurim lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash. ketzad. lo yavi mipperot shechantu kodem chamishsha asar bishvat al perot shechantu achar chamishsha asar bo. echad hannatua veechad haole meelav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "bikkure kol asher beartzam": 
Happerot shel shuttafin chayyavim bevikkurim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "bikkure kol asher beartzecha" [asher yaviu]: 
Haggadel beatzitz af al pi shehu nakuv vehaggadel bisfina eno mevi mimmennu kol ikkar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "beartzam". aval mevi min haggadel baggag o bachurba: 
Hannotea ilan betoch sadehu vehivricho letoch sede chavero o lirshut harabbim. o shehaya notea bisde chavero o birshut harabbim vehivricho betoch sadehu. o shehaya ikkaro betoch sadehu vehivrich ketzato betoch sadehu vederech harabbim o derech hayyachid mafseket baemtza ben haikkar vehatztzad hammuvrach. eno mevi bikkurim lo mimma shehotzi birshut zo velo min hatztzad shebbirshut haacharon shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "bikkure admatcha" ad sheyyihyu kol haggiddulin meadmatcha: 
Natan lo chavero reshut lehaverich betoch shello afillu leshaa hare ze mevi bikkurim. veim haya hailan samuch lemetzar chavero o note lisde chavero af al pi shechayyav leharechik hare ze mevi mimmennu vekore sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua et haaretz: 
Haarisin vehachachirin uvaale zeroa sheonsin et habbealim velokchin mehen artzotam befachot vehaggazlanin enan meviin bikkurim. vaafillu nityaashu habbealim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "bikkure admatcha": 
Hakkone ilan betoch sede chavero eno mevi lefi sheen lo karka. shelosha yesh lo karka veaf al pi sheen lo ella ilanot bilvad hare hu kemi shekkana karka. kana ilan echad vekarkao hare ze mevi: 
Hallokeach perot telushin velakach hakkarka hare ze mevi bikkurim shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha. machar lo perot chutz min hakkarka afillu mechubbarim. mocher eno mevi shehare en lo perot velokeach eno mevi shehare en lo karka. chazar hammocher velakach happerot min hallokeach hare ze mevi shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha: 
Hammocher sadehu leakkum vechazar ulekachah mimmennu hare ze mevi mimmenna bikkurim min hattora. sheenah nifkaat min hammitzva bekinyan haakkum kemo shebbearnu: 
Ashera shebbittelah en meviin mimmenna bikkurim shehabbikkurim kekadshe mikdash hen: 
Habbikkurim en lahem shiur min hattora aval middivrehem tzarich lehaferish echad mishshishshim. veharotze laasot kol sadehu bikkurim osehu: 
Hifrish bikkurav vechazar vehosif alehen o itteran hare hattosefet kevikkurim. bamme devarim amurim keshehevi meeretz yisrael. aval im hevi meever hayyarden o missureya enah kevikkurim. veaf al pi sheenah kevikkurim enah neechelet ella betohora. veen meatterin et habbikkurim bechol makom ella mishshivat hamminim: 
Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim. yored adam letoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera eshkol anavim shebbikkeru rimmon shebbikker koshran begemi veomer hare ellu bikkurim. vehem naasim bikkurim bimchubbar mishshekkara lahen shem. veaf al pi sheadayin lo bashlu kol tzarkan. umishsheyyiggamru veyitleshem min hakkarka eno tzarich lachazor velikrot lahem shem. lo hifrishan bimchubbar velo kara lahem shem utelasham hare ze mafrisham achar shennitleshu. veim nitmeu happerot kullan eno mafrish bikkurim betuma. ella mafrish min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla. veim en lo perot acherot lehaferish mehen yerae li sheeno mafrish betuma sheen mafrishin leibbud. vechen yerae li shehabbikkurim shennitmeu eno massik bahen hattannur kitruma temea mippene shehen kekadshe mikdash: 
Hammafrish bikkurav venamakku o nivzezu o avdu o shennignevu o shennitmeu chayyav lehaferish acherim tachtehem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "tavi bet Adonai elohecha" melammed shehu chayyav beachrayutan ad sheyyeviem lehar habbayit: 
Hammafrish bikkurav lehaalotan beyado lirushalayim lo yishlachem beyad shaliach. veim likketan mittechilla al menat leshallecham beyad shaliach hare ze muttar leshallecham:

Habbikkurim notnin [otan] leanshe mishmar vehen mechallekim otan benehen kekadshe hammikdash. uchevar bearnu shehen keruyin teruma. ulefichach zar sheachal bikkurim bechol makom chayyav mita bide shamayim. vehu sheyyochlem meachar shennichnesu lechomat yerushalayim: 
Hayu miktzatan bifnim umiktzatan bachutz. ze shebbifnim chayyavin alav mita vahare hu hekdesh lechol devarav. veze shebbachutz hare hu chullin lechol devarav: 
Kohen sheachal bikkurim chutz lirushalayim meachar shennichnesu lefanim min hachoma loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "uterumat yadecha" vehem habbikkurim kemo shebbearnu behilchot teruma. vechen im achalan hakkohen birushalayim kodem hannacha baazara loke min hattora kemi sheachalan bachutz lefi shehen teunin hannacha baazara shenneemar vehinnachto lifne mizbach Adonai elohecha: 
Umishsheyyanichem hammeviam baazara hutteru lakkohen veaf al pi sheadayin lo hitvadda alehen sheen hakkeria meakkevet achilatan. vbikkurim sheyyatzu chutz limchitztzatan vechazru muttarin baachila: 
Achilat bikkurim kaachilat teruma lechol devarav. yeter bevikkurim shehen asurin leonen uteunin havaat makom. vechohen tahor sheachal bikkurim temeim loke keshem shelloke yisrael tahor sheachal maaser sheni shennitma ma sheen ken bitruma: 
Uminnayin shehabbikkurim asurin leonen shehare neemar bahen <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta bechol hattov" mikkelal shehu chayyav leachlan besimcha lo baaninut. vehaochlan baaninut makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Habbikkurim teunin keli shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "vesamta vattene". umitzva min hammuvchar lehavi kol min umin bichli bifne atzmo. veim heviam bichli echad yatza. velo yeviem beirbuv ella seorim millematta vechittim al gabbehen vezetim al gabbehen utemarim al gabbehen verimmonim al gabbehen uteenim lemala min hakkeli. veyihye davar echad mafsik ben min vamin kegon hutzin vechelef o alin vechayyotze bahen. umakkif latteenim eshkolot shel anavim mibbachutz: 
Heviam bichle mattachot notel hakkohen habbikkurim vechozer hakkeli livalav. veim heviam bichle arava vechelef vechayyotze bahen hare habbikkurim vehassallim lakkohanim. veim nitmeu habbikkurim en hassallim lakkohanim: 
Keshehayu meviin et habbikkurim hayu meviin beyadam torin uvene yona. vechen hayu tolin mitztzidde hassallim torin uvene yona kede leatter et habbikkurim. ellu sheim hassallim hayu kerevim olot veellu shebbidehen hayu nittanin lakkohanim: 
Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot bammikdash al habbikkurim beshaa shemmeviam. matchil vekore <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha ki vati el haaretz" vegomer <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "arammi oved avi" ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha ad <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai". veen korin otah ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "veanita veamarta". ballashon hazzot: 
Barishona kol mi shehaya yodea likrot kore vechol mi sheeno yodea likrot makrin oto. nimneu ellu sheen yodin likrot millehavi kede shello yikkalmu. hitkinu bet din sheyyihyu makrin et mi shehu yodea kemi sheeno yodea: 
Hammevi et habbikkurim yesh lo reshut littenem leavdo ukerovo bechol hadderech ad shemmaggia lehar habbayit. higgia lehar habbayit notel hassal al ketefo hu beatzmo. vaafillu haya melech gadol shebbeyisrael. venichnas ad shemmaggia laazara vekore veodehu hassal al ketefo <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha" vegomer. umorid hassal meal ketefo veochazo bisfatav vehakkohen manniach yado tachtav umenif vekore <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "arammi oved avi vayyered mitzrayma" vegomer ad sheggomer kol happarasha umannicho betzad hammizbeach bekeren deromit maaravit bidromah shel keren veyishtachave veyetze. uminnayin shehen teunin tenufa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 4)</small> "velakach hakkohen hattene" miyyadecha lerabbot et habbikkurim litnufa. ucheshem shetteunin tenufa kach teunin karban shelamim [veshir] shenneemar bahen <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta bechol hattov" uvargalim omer <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha" ma simchat hechag bishlamim af kan bishlamim. veen hakkarban meakkevet: 
Veematay korin beshir alehen. mishsheyyaggiu laazara haleviyyim hayu matchilin vekorin <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani": 
Habbikkurim tiunim lina. ketzad. hevi bikkurav lammikdash vekara vehikriv shelamav lo yetze beoto hayyom mirushalayim lachazor limkomo ella yalin sham veyachazor lemachar leiro shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 7)</small> "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha". kol ponot sheatta pone min hammikdash lichshettavo lo lo yihyu ella babboker. nimtzeta omer shehabbikkurim teunin shiva devarim. havaat makom. ucheli. keria. vekarban. veshir. utenufa. velina:
Kol hammevi bikkurim taun karban veshir utenufa velina. aval havvidduy eno shave bakkol. lefi sheyyesh shechayyavin lehavi bikkurim veenan korin alehem:

Veellu meviin velo korin. haishsha vehattumtum vehaanderoginus lefi shehen sefek ishsha veenan yecholin lomar asher natatta li Adonai. vechen haappotroppin vehaeved vehashshaliach lefi sheenan yecholin lomar <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai":

Hagger mevi vekore shenneemar leavraham <small>(Bereshit 17 5)</small> "av hamon goyim netatticha" hare hu av kol haolam kullo shennichnasin tachat kanfe shechina. uleavraham hayta hashshevua techilla sheyyirshu banav et haaretz. vechen kohanim uleviyyim meviin vekorin mippene sheyyesh lahen are migrash:

Hakkone shene ilanot betoch [sade] shel chavero mevi veeno kore lefi shehaddavar safek im yesh lo karka o en lo. vechetzad ose. makdish otam techilla levedek habbayit mippene shehen sefek chullin veen machnisin chullin laazara vehakkohen pode otan miyyad hahekdesh veachar kach ochlan. umafrish mehen teruma umaaser mippene shehen sefek chullin venoten hammaasrot shellahen lakkohanim shemma bikkurim hem vaasurin lezarim. veeno mevi otan beatzmo ella meshallechan beyad shaliach kede shello teakkev otan hakkeria milleachlan. shekkol sheeno rauy likria mippene hassafek hakkeria meakkevet bo:

Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu mevi veeno kore. sheeno yachol lomar <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai" shehare en lo. vehallokeach eno chayyav lehaferish bikkurim acherim meoto hammin shekkevar hifrish mimmennu hammocher. veim hifrish mevi veeno kore. aval mimmin acher mafrish umevi vekore:

Hammocher sadehu leferot hallokeach mevi veeno kore shekkinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf. aval mevi adam minnichse ishto bikkurim vekore af al pi sheen lo guf hakkarka shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "asher natan lecha Adonai elohecha ulevetecha". af al pi shemmeta ishto achar shehifrish vehu badderech mevi vekore:

Hammocher sadehu o shemmachar ilanot vekarkaan bizman shehayyovel noheg hare ze mevi vekore beyovel rishon bilvad sheadayin lo samcha dato shel mocher shettachazor lo hakkarka. aval im chazar umecharah beyovel sheni hare ze mevi veeno kore shehare samcha dato sheen lo ella happerot vekinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf:

Hifrish bikkurim vechalla vahare hu mesukkan. ze sherauy leyarsho mevi veeno kore. hifrish bikkurav veshillechan beyad acher umet hashshaliach badderech af al pi shechazar hu vehevian eno kore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "velakachta" <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "uvata" ad shettihye lekicha vahavaa keachat:

Hifrish bikkurav veavdu kodem sheyyaggia lehar habbayit vehifrish acherim tachtehen mevi hashsheniyyim veeno kore. lefi sheeno yachol lomar et <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "reshit kol peri haadama" lefi sheenan reshit. veellu hashsheniyyim en chayyavim alehen chomesh kevikkurim:
Hevi bikkurav venitmeu baazara noftzam sham veeno kore:
Hevi bikkurav meechad min hamminim vekara vechazar vehevi bikkurim mimmin acher eno kore alehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom" paam achat beshana hu maggid velo shetayim:
Hifrish bikkurav veyavash hammayan o shenniktzatz hailan mevi veeno kore lefi shezze kemi sheen lo karka shehare avda:

Hammevi bikkurim meachar chag hassukkot vead chanukka af al pi shehifrishan kodem hechag mevi veeno kore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta vechol hattov" veen keria ella bishat simcha mechag hashshavuot ad sof hechag. ushear hammeviin chutz meellu meviin vekorin:

Habbikkurim vehatterumot vehachalla vehakkeren vehachomesh umattenot behema hem nichse kohen. yesh lo liknot mehen avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea uvaal chov notlan bechovo vehaishsha bichtubbatah. vekone bahen sefer tora:

Af al pi shehabbikkurim vehatterumot asur leheachel lezarim veaf al pi shehabbikkurim olin beechad umea kitruma im nitarvu bechullin birushalayim asurin bechol shehen beminam kemaaser sheni. mippene shehu mekom achilatan asaum kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin. veaf al pi shehabbikkurim asurim lezarim af birushalayim hare hen osrin bechol shehen. afillu zara habbikkurim achar shennichnesu lirushalayim hare haggiddulin asurin veosrin bechol shehen im nitarvu birushalayim. aval hazzorea bikkurim kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim haggiddulin chullin:

Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim. kol haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot leiro shel maamad kede shello yaalu yechidim shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 14 28)</small> "berav am haderat melech". uvaim velanim birchovah shel ir. velo yikkansu labbattim mippene ohel hattuma. uvashshachar hamemunne omer <small>(yirmeya lo 5)</small> "kumu venaale tziyyon el Adonai elohenu". vehashshor holech lifnehem vekarnav metzuppin zahav vaatara shel zayit berosho lehodia shehabbikkurim mishshivat hamminin. vehechalil makke lifnehem ad shehem maggiin karov lirushalayim vehem holchin bechol hadderech vekorin <small>(Tehillim 122 1)</small> "samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech". velo hayu mehallechin bayyom ella shete yadot bilvad. higgiu karov lirushalayim shalchu lifnehem sheluchin lehodia leanshe yerushalayim veitteru et bikkurehem ufirkesu otan. veim haya lahem lach veyavesh marin et hallach millemala. vehappachot vehasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzin likratan mirushalayim. lefi habbaim hem yotzin im bau anashim harebe yotzin likratan rabbim. veim meat meat. umishsheyyikkansu kullan beshaare yerushalayim yatchilu likrot <small>(Tehillim 122 2)</small> "omdot hayu raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim":

Kol baale ummanuyyot shebbirushalayim omdin mippenehem veshoalin bishloman. achenu anshe mekom peloni boachem beshalom. vehem mehallechin betoch yerushalayim vehechalil makke lifnehem ad shehem maggiim lehar habbayit. higgiu lehar habbayit notel kol echad veechad sallo al ketefo veomrin <small>(Tehillim 150 1)</small> "haleluyah halelu el bekadsho" vechulei ad <small>(Tehillim 150 6)</small> "kl hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah". vehem mehallechim behar habbayit vekorin ad shemmaggiin laazara. higgiu laazara dibberu haleviyyim beshir <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani" vegomer:

Mitzvat ase lehaferish teruma min haissa lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma". vereshit zo en lah shiur min hattora afillu hifrish kisora patar et haissa. vehaose kol issato challa lo asa kelum ad sheyyeshayyer miktzato: 
Umiddivre sofrim shemmafrishin echad mearbaa veesrim min haissa kede sheyyihye bah kede mattana lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo "ten lo davar harauy litteno mattana. vehannachtom haose limkor bashshuk mafrish echad mishshemona vearbaim. lefi sheissato merubba yesh beshiur ze kede mattana: 
Haose issa lemishte beno af al pi shehu merubbe mafrish echad meesrim vearbaa. shello lechallek beissat baal habbayit. vehannachtom sheasa issa ketanna echad mearbaim ushemone. shello lechallek beissat hannachtom: 
Nitmet haissa beshogeg o beones mafrish echad mearbaim ushemona. veim timmeah bezadon mafrish echad michd kede shello yihye chote niskar. vechalla temea [mutteret] (lakkohen) lehassaka kitruma temea: 
En chayyavin bechalla min hattora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz" vegomer. uvizman shekkol yisrael sham shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "bevoachem" biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem. lefichach challa bazzeman hazze afillu bime ezra beeretz yisrael enah ella middivrehem kemo shebbearnu bitruma: 
Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bechalla. uferot haaretz sheyyatzu chutza laaretz peturin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "asher ani mevi etchem shamma" shamma attem chayyavin ben al perot haaretz ben al perot chutza laaretz: 
Mafrishin challa bechutza laaretz middivre sofrim kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael. veen meviin challot chutza laaretz laaretz keshem sheen meviin teruma uvikkurim mishsham. veim hevi mannichah ad erev happesach vetissaref kitruma: 
Shelosha dinin lechalla beshalosh aratzot. kol haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel ad keziv mafrishin bah challa achat kashshiur vehi neechelet lakkohanim. ushear eretz yisrael shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim velo ole bavel shehi mikkeziv vead amana mafrishin bah shete challot haachat nisrefet vehaachat neechelet. umippene ma mafrishin bah shete challot mippene shehachalla harishona temea shehare lo nitkaddesha otah haaretz bime ezra. ukedushsha rishona batla mishsheggalu. vehoil vehi eretz yisrael mafrishin bah challa echad mearbaim ushemona vesorfin otah. umafrishin challa sheniyya venotnin otah lakkohen leachlah. kede shello yomru teruma tehora nisrefet shehare nisrefa harishona af al pi shello nitmea tuma yedua lakkol. vezo sheniyya en lah shiur ella kol sherotze mafrish mippene shehi middivrehem. vechol haaretz meamana velachutz ben besureya ben bishar haaratzot mafrishin shete challot. achat lisrefa kede shello yomru rainu teruma temea neechelet. veachat laachila kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael. vehoil vezo vezo middivrehem mutav lerabbot banneechelet lefichach shel serefa en lah shiur ella kol shehu. veshel achila echad mimch. umutteret lezavim ulezavot veen tzarich lomar lishar temeim: 
Bazzeman hazze sheen sham issa tehora mippene tumat hammet mafrishin challa achat bechol eretz yisrael echad mimch vesorfin otah mippene shehi temea veyesh lah shem min hattora. umikkeziv ad amana mafrishin sheniyya lakkohen laachila veen lah shiur, keshehaya haddavar mikkodem: 
Challat chutza laaretz af al pi shehi temea hoil veikkar chiyyuvah middivrehem enah asura baachila ella al kohen shettuma yotza alav miggufo vehem baale kerayin vezavim vezavot veniddot veyoldot umetzorain. aval shear hattemeim bemagga shear hattumot afillu temee met muttarim leachlah. lefichach im haya sham kohen katan bechutza laaretz ben besureya ben bishar aratzot veratza lehaferish challa achat mafrish echad mimch. veneechelet lekatan sheadayin lo raa keri o liktanna sheadayin lo raata nidda. veeno tzarich lehaferish sheniyya: 
Vechen im haya sham kohen gadol shettaval mishshichvat zaro o mizzivato af al pi shello heeriv shimsho veaf al pi shehu teme met hare ze muttar leechol hachalla harishona veeno tzarich lehaferish sheniyya bechutza laaretz. kol hammafrish challa mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehaferish challa ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. ucheshem shemmevarech al hattehora kach mevarech al hattemea. lefichach en haish erom mafrish challa sheeno yachol levarech. aval haishsha haaruma sheyyashva vechol paneha tuchot bakkarka mevarechet umafreshet challa: 
Hannidda vechayyotze bah mevarechet umafreshet challat chutza laaretz sheenah muzheret al maggaah ella al achilatah. veim haya sham kohen katan o kohen shettaval shehi mutteret lo laachila kemo shebbearnu hare ze muttar leachlah im hazzar al shulchan echad lefi sheenah medammaat. vaafillu nitarva shave beshave. venotnin otah lechohen am haaretz mippene shehi temea baavir eretz haammim [veen bah mishshum kohen hammesayyea bemattenotav shehu asur. veim ratza leechol techilla] veachar kach yafrish hachalla bechutz laaretz muttar sheen ikkarah ella middivrehem: 
Hachalla nikret teruma lefichach enah nittelet ella min hammukkaf kitruma. veenah nittelet min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla: 
Vechol sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom veim taram enah teruma kach bechalla. vechol sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom mizze al ze kach bechalla. vechol sheeno ochel teruma eno ochel challa. vechol haochel teruma ochel challa: 
Hassuma vehashshikkor mafrishin challa lechattechilla sheen beissa ra veyafe kede sheyyechavvenu veyafrishu min hayyafe:
Halokeach min hannachtom chayyav bechalla. umafrish min hachamma al hatztzonenet umin hatztzonenet al hachamma afillu middefusin harebe:

En chayyavin bechalla ella chamishsha mine tevua bilvad vehem hachittin vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "baachalchem millechem haaretz". veen karuy lechem ella pat hannaaset meellu aval haose pat orez o dochan vechayyotze bahen min hakkitniyyot enan chayyavin bechalla kelal:

Halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehahefker utevua shello hevia shelish af al pi shehen peturin min hatteruma chayyavin aleha bechalla. vechen maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolim shennittela terumato af al pi sheyyesh bo chelek teruma gedola umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu umotar haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim kesheyyippadu kol otan hammotarot hakkol chayyavin bechalla:
Issa shel maaser sheni birushalayim veissat sheviit usefek medumma chayyavin bechalla. aval hamedumma patur min hachalla:
Challot toda urekike nazir asaan leatzmo peturin min hachalla mippene shehen kodesh. lemachran bashshuk linzirim ulemakrive toda chayyavin bechalla. lefi shebbedato sheim lo timmacher yochlenna:
Issat hashshuttafin vehaose issa lerabbim chayyevet bechalla:

Haose issa min hattevel. ben shehikdim challa litruma ben shehikdim teruma lechalla ma sheasa asuy. veim hifrish hachalla techilla lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma uterumat maaser. veim hifrish techilla teruma lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha challa:
Haose issa lehaachil happat shellah livhema o lechayya petura. issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna chayyevet bechalla. issat haakkum petura:
Hayu yisrael veakkum shuttafin baissa im haya bechelek yisrael shiur issa hachayyevet bechalla hare zo chayyevet bechalla:

Akkum shehifrish challa afillu beeretz yisrael enah challa. ella modiin oto sheeno tzarich veteachel lezar. velamma lo chashashnu lah shemma issa shel yisrael hi vetala otah beyad akkum uchede lefatrah. sheim yirtze yisrael yiftor atzmo veyaase yisrael issato pachot mishshiur challa:

Hamearev kemach chittin vekemach orez veasa mehen issa im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura. afillu haya hasseor chittim letoch issat orez. im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura:

Issa shennillosha beyayin o shemen o devash o mayim rotchim o shennatan letochah tavlin o hirtiach hammayim vehishlich hakkemach letocho velasho. im afaah ben betannur ben bekarka ben al hammachavat vehammarcheshet. ben shehidbik et habbatzek bemachavat uvemarcheshet veachar kach hirtichan baesh millematta ad shenneefet happat. ben shehirtichah veachar kach hidbik habbatzek. kol ellu chayyavin bechalla. aval haose issa leyabbeshah bachamma bilvad o levashshelah bikdera hare hi petura min hachalla sheen maase chamma lechem ben shellashah bemayim ben shellashah bishar mashkin. vechen kali shellashin oto bemayim o bidvash veochlin oto belo afiyya patur sheen chayyevet ella issa shessofah leheafot lechem lemaachal adam:
Issa shellashah techilla laasotah maase chamma vehishlimah laasotah pat. o shehitchil bah leefot pat vehishlimah laasot maase chamma. vechen kali shellasho leefoto pat chayyavin bechalla:
Lechem heasuy lechutach maaseha mochichin aleha. asaah keachin chayyevet bechalla. asaah kelimmudin petura min hachalla:

Kamma shiur haissa shechayyevet bechalla. melo haomer kemach ben meechad mechamishsha minim ben mechamishtan kullam mitztarfin leshiur. vechamma hu shiur haomer shene kabbin pachot chomesh. vehakkav arbaa login. vehallog arba reviiyyot veharviit etzbaayim al etzbaayim berum etzbaayim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba. vechol haetzbaot hem rochav gudal etzbaot shel yad. nimtzeta lamed shehammidda sheyyesh bah eser etzbaot al eser etzbaot berum shalosh etzbaot uteshia etzba bekeruv hu haomer. vechen midda sheyyesh bah sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba al sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba berum sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba hi middat haomer. ushete hammiddot keechad hem olim. vechamma mechila midda zo kemo arbaim veshalosh betzim benoniyyot vechomesh betza vehem mishkal shishsha ushemonim selaim ushene shelishe sela mikkemach hachittim shebbemitzrayim. shehem mishkal chamesh meot veesrim zuz mizzuze mitzrayim bazzeman hazze. umidda shemmechila kammishkal hazze mikkemach hachittim hazze bah moddin lechalla bechol makom:

Asur leadam laasot issato pachot pachot mikkashshiur kede lefatrah min hachalla. vehammafrish challa meissa shehi pechuta mikkashshiur lo asa kelum vahare hi chullin keshehayta. asa issa pechuta mikkashshiur vaafaah venatan happat lassal. vechazar veafa pat acheret venatan lassal im nitkabbetz bassal shiur challa hassal metzarfan lechalla umafresh hachalla min happat. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz" melammed shehu mafrish min haafuy. veen hattannur metzarfan lechalla:

Hayu hakkikkarot noshchot zo bezo venitkabbetz min hakkol shiur challa chayyavin bechalla af al pi sheenan bassal. afa meat meat vekibbetz hakkol al luach sheen lo toch hare ze safek. veim challa shel divrehem hi eno chayyav lehaferish ad sheyyetzaref oto keli sheyyesh lo toch:

Kemach shello rikkedo ella lasho bassubbin shello. hoil veyesh bechol hakkemach omer chayyav bechalla. aval im natal hammursan min hakkemach vechazar vehishlim shiur haissa bammursan shehecheziro lakkemach eno chayyav bechalla:
Nachtom sheasa issa laasotah seor lechallekah chayyevet bechalla. sheim lo timmacher yaasenna pat. aval haose issa lechallekah batzek petura:
Nashim shennatnu kemach lenachtom laasot lahem seor. im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur af al pi sheyyesh bichlalan kashshiur petura:

Shete issot sheyyesh bishtehen shiur hachayyav bechalla veen beachat mehen kashshiur venagu zo bezo venashchu zo et zo im hayu shel shenayim afillu hen mimmin echad peturin min hachalla. shessetam shenayim makpidin. veim yadua sheenan makpidin al eruv haissot hare ellu mitztarfot: 
Hayu shetehen shel ish echad im hayu mimmin echad mitztarfin vechayyavot bechalla veim mishshene minin hayu en mitztarfin. shessetam echad eno makpid. veim haya makpid shello tigga issa zo bezo velo titarev immah afillu hayu mimmin echad en mitztarfot: 
Vechetzad mitztarfot. im hayu shel echad mimmin echad issat hachittim shennaga beissat hakkussemin mitztarfot. naga bishar hamminin en mitztarfot. vechen issat seorin shennaga beissat hakkussemin o shibbolet shual o shifon vechen issat kusmin veshel shibbolet shual veshel shifon shennaga kol achat mishshelashtan bachavertah hare ellu mitztarfot: 
Issat chadash enah mitztarefet leshel yashan af al pi shehen mimmin echad. kede shello yomru tormin min hechadash al hayyashan. velo yitrom meemtza shetehen ella yavi issa acheret chadash o yashan veyitztaref lahem lehashelim hashshiur. bamme devarim emurim beissa shennaga beissa acheret. aval habbolel kemach chameshet hamminin veose mehem issa achat hare chamishshetan mitztarfin leshiur issat challa kemo shebbearnu: 
Issa shehi pechuta mikkashshiur mikkan. veissa pechuta mikkashshiur mikkan. veissa sheenah chayyevet bechalla beemtza kegon issat orez o issat teruma o medumma o issat akkum. af al pi shennogot zo bazo enan mitztarfot shehare davar happatur min hachalla mavdil baemtza: 
Haya baemtza issa shehurema challatah mitztarfot shehaissa shebbenehen kevar hayta mechuyyevet bechalla. vechen im haya benehen issat hekdesh mitztarfot mippene sherauy lifdotah vetitchayyev bechalla. vechen im hayta benehen issat min acher o issat ish acher o issat chadash hare shete haissot shebbatztzedadin mitztarfot lechalla: 
Shete issot shekkol achat mehen pechuta mikkashshiur shehifrish challa mizzo vechalla mizzo vechazru venagu zo bazo vahare bishtehem kashshiur chayyavin lehaferish mehen challa shehachallot harishonot enan kelum: 
Shene akkum sheasu issa kashshiur vechillekuha veachar kach nitgayyeru. vehosif kol echad al chelko achar shennitgayyer ad shehishlimu lashshiur hare zo chayyevet. shello hayta lah sheat chova keshehayu akkum shehare pachot mikkashshiur haya beyad kol echad mehen: 
Aval shene yisreelim sheasu kach vechazar kol echad achar shechilleku vehosif al chelko ad shehishlimo lashshiur hare zo petura. shekkevar hayta lah sheat chova vehen hayu peturin beotah shaa mippene sheasauha lechallek: 
Hayta haissa beyad haakkum vehayyisrael beshuttafut vechilleku. veachar kach nitgayyer haakkum vehosif hagger al shello [veyisrael al shello] ad shehishlim kol echad issato lashshiur shel yisrael chayyevet veshel akkum petura: 
Hannotel seor meissa shello hurema challatah unetano letoch issa shehurema challatah hare ze mevi issa sheniyya sheyyihye bah im seor ze shiur issa shechayyevet bechalla venotnah betoch haissa shehurema challatah. umafresh min haissa hashsheniyya shiur challa aleha veal hasseor kede sheyyittol min hammukkaf. veim en lo issa sheniyya naaset zo kullah tevel umafrish challa al hakkol shehattevel bemino oser bechol shehu: 
Issa hattevula lechalla enah kechalla. vahare hi kechullin leinyan hattuma. sheen hashsheni ose shelishi bechullin kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. umuttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael. lefichach shete issot achat temea veachat tehora notel kede challat shetehem meissa shello hurema challatah venotno baemtza samuch laissa hattehora umoshech min hattemea lattehora kede betza kede litrom min hammukkaf: 
Ose adam issa tehora veeno mafrish challatah umannichah o manniach mikketzatah lihyot mafrish aleha veholech challot shel issot acherot. vaafilu nitmeu haissot ad shettease haissa shehinniach kullah challa veyittenenna lakkohen. vehu shello tippasel meochel adam. aval mishshettisrach eno mafrish aleha. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu otam haissot shemmafrish alehen safek im hurema challa mehen o lo hurema shechallat demay nittelet min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla veshello min hammukkaf:

Hammafrish challato kemach enah challa vegezel beyad kohen. ushear haissa chayyevet bechalla. veoto hakkemach shehifrish leshem challa im yesh bo omer veosehu issa hare ze mafrish mimmennu challa kishar kol kemach chullin: 
Ematay mafrishin challa. kesheyyitten et hammayim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim mafrish hachalla mittechillat davar shennillosh shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "reshit arisotechem". vehu shello yishshaer sham baareva kemach shello nitarev bammayim shiur omer. veim amar hare ze challa al haissa veal hasseor veal hakkemach shennishtayyer velichshettease kullah issa achat titkaddesh zo shebbeyado leshem challa hare ze muttar: 
Hinniach haissa ad shellash hakkol veervah veachar kach hifrish en bechach kelum. veim lo hifrish hachalla batzek ella afa hakkol hare ze mafrish min happat kemo shebbearnu: 
Meematay titchayyev haissa bechalla mishshettiggalgel bechittim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim. o shettittamtem bisorim vetease kullah guf echad. veochlin aray min haissa ad shettitgalgel bechittim vetittamtem bisorim. vehakkussemin kechittim veshibbolet shual vehashshifon kisorim: 
Nitgalgela bechittim venittamtema bisorim haochel mimmenna kodem haferashat challa chayyav mita mippene shehi tevel. lefichach im hayta haissa chayyevet bechalla min hattora haochel mimmenna loke kechol ochel tevel. veim hayta chayyevet middivrehem makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Issa shennidmea ad shello titgalgel petura. mishshettiggalgel chayyevet. vechen hammakdish issato o hammafkir otah kodem shennitgalgela ufedaah o zacha bah veachar kach gilgelah o hikdishah o hifkir otah achar shennitgalgela ufedaah o zacha bah hare zo chayyevet bechalla: 
Hikdishah kodem shettitgalgel venitgalgela beyad hahekdesh veachar kach pedaah petura shebbishat chovatah hayta petura: 
Vechen akkum shennatan leyisrael laasot lo issa unetanah lo bemattana ad shello gilgelah chayyevet umeshsheggilgelah petura: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo issa. nitgalgela ad shello nitgayyer petura. veim mishshennitgayyer chayyevet. veim safek chayyevet bechalla lefi shehu avon mita. vezar sheachal challat safek zo vechayyotze bah en chayyav aleha chomesh: 
Issa shennolad bah sefek tuma kodem shettitgalgel yaasenna betuma lefi shemmuttar letamme chullin shebbeeretz yisrael vetissaref challatah. nolad lah achar shennitgalgela sefek tuma shevvaddaah metamme et hachullin min hattora yigmerenna betohora. shekkol shevvaddaah metamme et hachullin gazru al sefeko bechullin hattevulim lechalla shello yetammeu otan hoil venitbelu lechalla. vetihye hachalla teluya lo neechelet velo nisrefet: 
Lo yaase adam issato betuma lechattechilla ella yizzaher veyishtaddel veyithar hu vechelav kede lehaferish challa tehora. haya beno uven hammayim yeter al arbaa milin yaasenna betuma veyafrish challa temea: 
En osim challat am haaretz betohora. aval osim issat chullin betohora. ketzad. megabbel haissa ze hechaver umafresh mimmenna kede challatah umannichah bichle gelalim o kele avanim o bichle adama sheen mekabbelin tuma uchesheyyavo am haaretz notel et shetehen et haissa veet hachalla veomrim lo hizzaher shello tigga bachalla shemma tachzor letivlah. umippene ma hittiru lo ze mishshum kede chayyav shel gabbal: 
Eshet chaver merakkedet uvoreret im eshet am haaretz. aval mishshettattil mayim baissa lo tesayyea otah mippene shehi osa issatah betuma. vechen hannachtom sheose betuma lo lashin velo orchin immo sheen machazikin yede ovre avera ella molichin immo pat lefalter: 
Hallokeach minnachtom am haaretz besureya veamar lo hifrashti challa eno tzarich lehaferish challa missafek. keshem shello nechshedu kol yisrael baaretz al teruma gedola kach lo nechshedu besureya al hachalla: 
Hallokeach bechutza laaretz min hannachtom tzarich lehaferish challa missafek. aval hallokeach mibbaal habbayit veen tzarich lomar hammitareach etzlo eno tzarich lehaferish challa missafek:

Mitzvat ase litten kol zoveach behema tehora lakkohen hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim". veellu hem hannikraim bechol makom mattanot. umitzva zo noheget tamid ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. uvechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. uvechullin aval lo bemukdashin: 
Kol hakkadashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bemattanot. veim kadam mum over lehekdeshan o shehikdishan temimim veachar kach nolad bahem mum venifdu hare ellu peturin min hammattanot: 
Sefek bechor chayyav bemattanot mikkol tzad. sheim bechor hu kullo lakkohen veim eno bechor mattenotav lakkohen. veim nistappek bishnayim velakach hakkohen haechad missafek hare hashsheni patur min hammattanot. asauhu kemi shezzacha bo hakkohen unetano bemumo livalav. aval sefek maaser patur mikkol makom shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Behemat kadashim shennifsela bemumah veenah chayyevet bemattanot shennitarva bivhemot acherot afillu achat bemea bizman shekkol behema mehen leacher kullan peturin. shekkol echad veechad safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. haya echad hu hashshochet et kullam poter mattenot achat mehen bilvad: 
En chayyav bemattanot ella behema tehora bilvad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "im shor im se". kilayim habba mikkeves veez chayyav bemattanot. vehakkevi af al pi shehu safek mafrishin mimmennu kol hammattanot. tzevi habba al haez veyalda havvalad chayyav bachatzi mattanot shenneemar im se afillu miktzat se. tayish habba al hatztzeviyya havvalad patur min hammattanot: 
Echad hashshochet laachilat akkum o laachilat kelavim o lirfua chayyav bemattanot: 
Behemat shuttafin chayyevet shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "zovche hazzevach": 
Hallokeach behema mipperot sheviit chayyav bemattanot. kohanim uleviyyim peturim min hammattanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "meet haam" vesafek hem haleviyyim im hem bichlal haam o lo. lefichach en notlin mehem veim natal hakkohen lo yachzir: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshochet leatzmo. aval kohen tabbach sheshshochet umocher bashshuk mamtinin lo shetayim veshalosh shabbatot. mikkan veelach motziin mimmennu mattanot venotnin otam lechohanim acherim. veim kava bet mitbachayim limkor en mamtinin lo ella motziin mimmennu miyyad. veim nimna millitten menaddin oto ad sheyyitten: 
Hashshochet leakkum ulechohen patur min hammattanot. vehammishtattef im hakkohen tzarich sheyyirshom chelko kede sheyyanniach hammattanot bechelek hakkohen. sheim lo tziyyen chelko chayyav bemattanot mippene sheen hakkol yodin shehakkohen shuttaf lo. lefichach im haya hakkohen omed immo bammitbachayim venose venoten immo eno tzarich lirshom. vehammishtattef im haakkum eno tzarich lirshom shessetam akkum marbe devarim umodia lakkol shehu shuttaf veaf al pi sheeno immo bishat mechira: 
Hitna hakkohen immo shehu shuttaf chutz min hammattanot hare hammattanot lakkohen. kevan sheamar lo chutz hare shiyyer lo hakkohen chelek bammattanot ulefichach hem shello. aval im amar lo hakkohen al menat shehammattanot shelli hare hammattanot shel yisrael ze venotnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze. af al pi shehitna immo shehen shello lo niftar min hammattanot. shehaomer al menat lo shiyyer lo beatzman shel mattanot kelum hoil velo shiyyer lo bahen shuttafut lo kenaan bitnay ze: 
Haya hakkohen shuttaf barosh patur min hallechi. shuttaf bayyad patur min hazzeroa. shuttaf bivne meayim patur min hakkeva. amar lo hakkohen hare habbehema kullah shelli veharosh shellecha chayyav bilchi. shehaddavar hachayyav hare hu shel yisrael: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo behema shechuta. im nishchata ad shello nitgayyer patur. veim achar shennitgayyer chayyav. veim safek patur vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Behema shello huremu mattenoteha muttar leechol mimmenna sheenah doma letevel shehare mattenot kehunna muvdalin vehammattanot atzman asur leyisrael leachlan ella birshut kohen. avar vaachalan o hizzikan o mecharan eno chayyav leshallem. mippene shehu mamon sheen lo tovea yadua. vehakkone otam af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze muttar leachlan mippene shemmattenot kehunna nigzalot: 
Amar lattabbach mechor li bene meeha shel para vehayu bah mattanot notnan lakkohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lekacham mimmennu bemishkal notnam lakkohen umenakke lattabbach min haddamim: 
Hameshalleach basar lachavero vehayu bah mattanot eno choshesh shemma avar ze ugezalan. makom sheen bo kohen maale hammattanot bedamim veochlan mippene hefsed kohen veyitten haddamim lechol kohen sheyyirtze: 
Harotze litten hammattanot lechohen echad noten. veim ratza lachlok otan lo yitten chatzi keva laechad o chatzi zeroa ella zeroa laechad vekeva laechad ulechayayim lishnayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo" sheyyihye bah kede mattana. veim hayu shel shor cholek otan chatichot vehu sheyyihye bechol chaticha kede mattana: 
E zehu hazzeroa. zeroa shel yamin min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yado shehen shene evarim ze meore baze. vehallechayayim min happerek shel lechi vead pika shel gargeret tabbaat gedola im hallashon shebbenehen hakkol lakkohen: 
En molgin otan veen mafshitin otan ella yittenu lo beoran uvetzimran. vehakkeva bachelev shealeha uvachelev shebbetochah. uchevar nahagu hakkohanim lehanniach chelev hakkeva labbealim: 
Hakkohenet ochelet hammattanot af al pi shehi nesua leyisrael mippene sheen bahen kedushsha. velo od ella habbaal ochel mattanot biglal ishto. aval chalala enah ochelet. sheen chalalim bichlal kohanim. veim ratza hakkohen limkor hammattanot o littenan bemattana afillu leakkum o lehaachilam lichlavim maachilam sheen bahen kedushsha kelal: 
Kohen shehayu lo chaverim shennotnim lo hammattanot im ratza lezakkot bahen leyisrael chavero hare ze mezakke lo. veaf al pi shello bau leyado. veyihyu otam hachaverim zovchim venotnin hammattanot leze hayyisrael shezzacha bahen. vehu sheyyihye hayyisrael ze bedochak veen lo liknot basar. veyihye hakkohen shezzacha lo chavero. aval im haya hakkohen shammasho shel yisrael ze o sechiro o lekito eno mezakke lo ad sheyyavou leyado shemma yezakke beal karcho: 
Lo yachtof hakkohen hammattanot velo yishal befiv ella im ken notnin lo bechavod notel. uvizman shehem rabbim bevet hammitbachayim hatztzenuim moshchin yedehem vehaggargeranim notlin. veim haya kohen tzanua veen makkirin oto shehu kohen hare ze notel kede sheyyivvada lakkol shehu kohen. veen hakkohanim ochlin hammattanot ella tzali bechardal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 29)</small> "lemashcha" kederech sheochlim hammelachim:

Mitzvat ase litten lakkohen reshit haggez shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo". uleviyyim bichlal yisrael bemitzva zo. veen lereshit haggez zo shiur min hattora. umiddivre sofrim shello yifchot meechad mishshishshim. veenah noheget ella baaretz ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit kereshit haddagan. venoheg bechullin aval lo bemukdashin: 
Ketzad. hare shehikdish behemot levedek habbayit ugezazan yachol yihye chayyav lifdot velitten lakkohen. o hikdish behema chutz miggizzatah yachol yihye chayyav bereshit haggez. talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "tzoncha". en ellu tzono: 
Kol hakodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bereshit haggez. aval im kadam hekdeshan et muman o shekkadam mum over lehekdeshan veachar kach nolad lahen mum kavua venifdu peturim mereshit haggez: 
En chayyavin bereshit haggez ella hakkevasim bilvad. zecharim kinkevot shehatztzemer shellahen hu harauy livgadim. haya tzimran kashe veeno rauy lilvisha peturin mereshit haggez. sheen mattana zo lakkohen ella kede lilbosh mimmenna: 
Kevan shezzikka lo hakkadosh baruch hu bitrumot shehen lachmo veyeno. vezikka lo bemattenot behema vekadshe mikdash shehabbasar shello. zikka lo bereshit haggez lilvusho. uvegezel hagger vehacharamim usede achuzza ufidyon bechorot lehotzaotav ushear tzerachav. shehare en lo chelek benachala uvabbizza: 
Haya hatztzemer shellahen adom o shachor o shachum chayyavot bereshit haggez. aval im gazaz hatztzemer utzevao kodem sheyyitten niftar mereshit haggez. hilbino kodem sheyyitten chayyav lehaferish achar shellibbeno. hattolesh tzemer rechelim beyado velo gazaz chayyav bereshit haggez: 
Reshit haggez noheg bechilayim uvichvi uvitrefa. aval haggozez et hammeta patur: 
Hammafrish reshit haggez veavad chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyitten lakkohen. haomer kol gizzotay reshit devarav kayyamin: 
Hallokeach gez tzono shel akkum achar sheggezazan haakkum patur mereshit haggez. lakach hatztzon legizzatan chayyav af al pi sheggadla haggizza birshut haakkum. veaf al pi shechozrin hatztzon leakkum achar geziza. hoil vehaggozez yisrael vehaggezizot shello chayyav sheen hachiyyuv ella bishat haggizza: 
Hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero im shiyyer hammocher meat mitztzono lehiggazez hammocher chayyav lehaferish min hammeshoar al hakkol. veaf al pi shello hitchil hammocher ligzoz. chazaka en adam mocher mattenot kehunna. veim lo shiyyer kelum hallokeach chayyav lehaferish: 
Hayu shene mine gizza kegon gizza levana vegizza shechuma o gizzat zecharim vegizzat nekevot. umachar min ze vehinniach hammin haacher. ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo. [ze noten leatzmo] al ma shellakach veze noten leatzmo al ma sheshshiyyer: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayu lo gizzot veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer nigzezu o mishshennitgayyer hare ze patur. vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Kamma tzon yihye lo veyihyu chayyavot bereshit haggez. en pachot mechamesh. vehu sheyyihye baggizza shellahen en pachot mimmishkal shishshim sela. vetihye gizzat kol achat mechamishshetan en pachot mimmishkal 12 sela. hayta achat mehem gozezet pachot miv sela af al pi shechamishshetan gozzot shishshim sela o yeter hare ellu peturin mereshit haggez: 
Hashshuttafin chayyavin bereshit haggez. vehu sheyyihye bechelek kol echad mehen kashshiur. aval chamesh tzon bilvad shel shene shuttafin peturin: 
Reshit haggez mitzvatah battechilla veim hifrish ben baemtza ben bassof yatza. hayu lo chamesh tzon vegazaz achat mehen bilvad umachar gizzatah. veachar kach gozez sheniyya umachar gizzatah. veachar kach gozez shelishit umachar gizzatah. hakkol mitztarfot lereshit haggez. vechayyav afillu leachar kamma shanim. veyesh lo lehaferish min hechadash al hayyashan umizze al ze. aval im hayta rachel achat ugezazah vehinniach gizzatah veachar kach kana sheniyya ugezazah vehinniach gizzatah enan mitztarfot: 
Mi shehayu lo gizzot rabbot shel reshit haggez verotze lechallek lakkohanim. lo yitten lechol echad veechad pachot mimmishkal chamesh selaim melubban kede beged katan. lo sheyyelabbeno veachar kach yitten lo ella yitten lo mitztzemer haggizza keshehu tzoi. kede sheyyihye bo achar hallibbun chamesh selaim o yeter shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo" sheyyihye bo kede mattana hammoelet: 
Reshit haggez chullin lechol davar. lefichach ani omer shennotnim oto lechohenet af al pi shehi nesua leyisrael kemattenot behema. veyerae li sheddin shenehen echad hu:

Mitzvat ase lifdot kol ish miyyisrael beno shehu bechor leimmo hayyisreelit shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 19)</small> "kol peter rechem li". veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam": 
Veen haishsha chayyevet lifdot et benah. shehachayyav lifdot et atzmo hu shechayyav lifdot et beno. avar haav velo padahu kesheyyigdal yifde et atzmo: 
Haya hu lifdot uveno lifdot yifde atzmo techilla veachar kach beno. veim en lo ella kede pidyon echad yifde atzmo: 
Haya beno lifdot vehiggia et laalot laregel veen lo kede laze velaze. pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "kl bechor banecha tifde" veachar kach <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "velo yerau fanay rekam": 
Happode et beno mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon habben. vechozer umevarech shehecheyaynu. veachar kach noten happidyon lakkohen. veim pada atzmo mevarech lifdot habbechor umevarech shehecheyaynu: 
Mitzva zo noheget bechol makom uvechol zeman. uvechamma podehu bechamesh selaim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 16)</small> "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde". ben bechesef ben bishve kesef min hammittaltelin sheggufan mamon keinyan hashshekalim. lefichach en podin bekarkaot velo baavadim mippene shehen kekarkaot velo bishtarot lefi sheen gufan mamon. veim padahu bahen eno paduy: 
Katav haav lakkohen shehu chayyav lo chamishsha selaim chayyav litten lo uveno eno paduy. natan lo keli sheeno shave bashshuk chamishsha selaim vekibbelo hakkohen bachamishsha selaim hare beno paduy. natan chamishsha selaim laasara kohanim ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze yatza: 
Ratza hakkohen lehachezir lo happidyon machzir. velo yitten lo hu vedato sheyyachzir. veim asa ken vehechzir lo en beno paduy ad sheyyigmor belibbo litten lo mattana gemura. veim ratza hakkohen achar kach lehachezir yachzir. vechen im peresh venatan lo al menat lehachezir hare beno paduy: 
Kohanim uleviyyim peturim mippidyon habben mikkal vachomer. im patru shel yisrael bammidbar din hu sheyyifteru atzman: 
Yisrael habba min hakkohenet umin halleviyya patur. sheen haddavar taluy baav ella baem shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael: 
Leviyya hameubberet meakkum benah patur. vechohenet hameubberet meakkum benah chayyav shehare nifsela immo min hakkehunna bivilat haakkum: 
Kohen shennolad lo ben chalal. met haav betoch sheloshim yom habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. shello zacha haav befidyono. met achar sheloshim yom eno chayyav habben lifdot et atzmo. shehare zacha haav befidyono: 
Hashshifcha shennishtachrera vechutit shennitgayyera keshehen meubbarot veyaldu. af al pi shehorato shello bikdushsha hoil venolad bikdushsha chayyav. shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael vahare peter verechem beyisrael. en yadua im kodem shennitgayyera yalda o achar shennitgayyera yalda hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Hakkutit vehashshifcha sheyyaldu veachar kach nitgayyeru venishtachreru veyaldu valad acher hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 12)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "peter rechem" veen ze peter rechem. vechen habba achar hannefalim kol nefel sheimmo temea leda habba acharav eno peter rechem. vechol nefel sheen immo temea leda kemo hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim o hammappelet yom arbaim vechayyotze bahen habba acharav bechor lakkohen vechayyav lifdot: 
Chatach haubbar bemeeha vehotzio evar evar habba acharav eno peter rechem. ben shemona chodashim shehotzi rosho vehu chay vehecheziro vamet. vechen ben tisha shemmet veyatza rosho vehecheziro veachar kach yatza achiv veyalda. ze sheyyalda eno peter rechem. shehare niftar berosho shel rishon. umishshettetze paddachto poter habba acharav: 
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav kedarko shenehem peturim. harishon lefi shello yatza min harechem vehashsheni mippene shekkedamo acher: 
Meematay yitchayyev befidyon. mishsheyyashlim sheloshim yom shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 16)</small> "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde". met habben betoch sheloshim vaafillu beyom sheloshim. vechen im naasa terefa. eno chayyav bachamishsha selaim. veim hikdim venatan lakkohen yachzir lo happidyon. [veim met achar sheloshim yom chayyav befidyon] veim lo natan yitten: 
Mi sheppada beno betoch sheloshim yom im amar lo meachshav en beno paduy. veim amar lo leachar sheloshim yom beno paduy veaf al pi sheen hammaot kayyamin leachar sheloshim yom: 
Mi shehu safek im chayyav befidyon o lo hare ze patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. met haav betoch sheloshim yom hare habben bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyavi reaya meaviv sheppadahu kodem sheyyamut. met haav leachar sheloshim yom hare hu bechezkat paduy ad sheyyodiuhu shello nifda: 
Mi shello bikkera ishto veyalda zachar unekeva veen yadua e ze mehen yatza rishon en kan lakkohen kelum. yalda shene zecharim af al pi sheen yadua e ze mehen habbechor noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. met haav ben betoch sheloshim yom ben achar sheloshim yom. ben shello chalku haachim ben shechalku. yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim lakkohen shekkevar nitchayyevu hannechasim: 
Shete nashav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten asara selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom im lechohen echad natan yachzir lo chamishsha selaim. veim lishne kohanim natan eno yachol lehotzi mehen shehare lo tziyyen pidyon ze al ben ze. vechol echad mehen yachol lomar hachazir mechaveri: 
Shete nashav shello bikkeru sheyyaldu zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. shei efshar shello yihye zachar echad mehen peter rechem: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar. o shene zecharim ushete nekevot. veen yadua e ze nolad rishon. en kan lakkohen kelum sheani omer nekeva nolda techilla veachareha zachar: 
Shete nashav achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu. noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. met echad mehem betoch sheloshim yom haav patur. met haav yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim: 
Yaldu zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum. sheani omer zo shello bikkera yalda nekeva techilla veachareha zachar vezo shebbikkera yalda zachar: 
Shete nashim shel shene anashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu ze noten chamishsha selaim veze noten chamishsha selaim. natnu veachar kach met echad min habbanim betoch sheloshim yom. im lishne kohanim natnu enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadan. veim lechohen echad natnu kotev echad mehen lachavero hareshaa veyelech ze behareshaa veyachzir min hakkohen chamishsha selaim: 
Yaldu zachar unekeva venitarvu haavot peturin vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. vechen mevakkeret shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon shenehen peturin. vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shete nekevot ushene zecharim en kan lakkohen kelum: 
Shete nashim shel shene anashim achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim. ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. yaldu zachar unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum: 
Yaldu shene zecharim unekeva ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamishsha selaim. shello niftar ella bishne sefekot im ishto yalda zachar bilvad chayyav veim hi yalda hazzachar vehannekeva chayyav ella im ken yalda nekeva techilla. vehoil vehaddavar rachok yitten pidyono:

Mitzvat ase lifdot kol dam miyyisrael peter chamor bese. veim lo ratza lifdoto mitzvat ase learfo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "ufeter chamor tifde vese veim lo tifde vaarafto". ushete mitzvot ellu nohagot bechol makom uvechol zeman. umitzvat pediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa: 
Hasse sheppodin bo notno lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "kol peter rechem" vegomer: 
<small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde" behema temea haamura kan hi hachamor bilvad: 
Peter chamor asur bahanaa ad sheyyippade. veim mecharo kodem pidyon damav asurim. veim met kodem pidyon o shearafo yikkaver. mippene shehu asur bahanaa af leachar arifa hoil velo nifda. lefichach im lo padahu venatan peter hachamor beatzmo lakkohen. asur lakkohen lehishtammesh bo ad sheyyifdehu bese. veyikkach hasse leatzmo o yaarfennu veyikkaver. vehakkohanim chashudim al davar ze lefichach asur leyisrael litten peter chamor lakkohen ella im ken padahu hakkohen befanav: 
Hifrish pidyon peter chamor umet hasse kodem sheyyittenennu lakkohen eno chayyav beacharayuto. veyitten hannevela lakkohen lehanot bah. met peter hachamor achar sheppadahu. yitten hattale lakkohen umuttar behanayato shekkevar nifda: 
Meematay chayyav lifdoto mishsheyyivvaled vead sheloshim yom. umeachar sheloshim yom im ratza learfo orfo. im ratza lifdoto pode veen kan ella mitzvat ikkuv bilvad: 
Lo ratza lifdoto orfo bekofitz meachorav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 13)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "veim lo tifde vaarafto". veen memitin oto lo bemakkel velo bekane velo bekordom velo bimgera ella bekofitz. velo yachnisennu lecheder veyinol haddelet befanav ad sheyyamut shenneemar vaarafto: 
En podin lo beegel velo bechayya velo bese shachut velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bichvi. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 13)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "tifde bese" veen karuy se ella kevasim veizzim chayyim bilvad: 
En podin bese haddome [lemin] leacher. veim pada paduy. ufodin beven pekua. aval lo bifsule hammukdashin shehare neemar bahen <small>(Devarim 12 15)</small> <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "katztzevi vechaayyal". ma tzevi veayyal en podin bo af pesule hammukdashin en podin bahem: 
Podin bese ben zecharim ben nekevot ben temimim ben baale mumim ben ketannim ben gedolim:
