Se shellekacho middeme sheviit en podin bo et havvadday. aval podin bo et hassafek. im en lo se lifdoto podehu beshavyo venoten damav lakkohen. lo amra tora se lehachemir alav ella lehakel alav. sheim haya lo peter chamor sheshshave eser selaim yesh lo lifdoto bese sheve dinar. velo yihye ze chamur min hahekdesh shennifde bechesef beshavyo: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu deme peter chamor mishshelosha zuzim ulemala. aval im hayu damav pachot mishlosha zuzim en podin oto ella bese o bishlosha zuzim. veayin yafa lo yifchot missela. veayin raa bachatzi sela. uvenonit bishlosha zuzim: 
Vhappode peter chamor shel chavero hare ze paduy. vehachamor livalav: 
Kohanim uleviyyim peturin mippeter chamor shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde". kol sheyyeshno bivchor adam yeshno bivchor behema temea. vehappatur mibbechor adam patur mibbechor behema temea: 
Hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel akkum o hammocher ubbar chamoro leakkum af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze patur min habbechora. veen konsin oto al davar ze. haya haakkum shuttaf baem o babbechor afillu lo haya lo ella echad meelef bo hare ze patur. haya lo bo o beimmo evar echad kegon yado o raglo afillu azno kol sheillu yechatech yihye baal mum hare ze patur min habbechora. veim kesheyyechatech chelek haakkum lo yihye baal mum lammizbeach hare ze chayyav. vechen hamekabbel chamor min haakkum lihyot metappel bah vehavvalad benehem o akkum shekkibbel miyyisrael hakkol patur min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "peter rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema" ad sheyyihye hakkol beyisrael: 
Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda chamoro o achar shennitgayyer hare ze chayyav laarof o lifdot. veim pada bese hasse shel ger shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Akkum shehifrish peter chamor modiin oto sheeno chayyav vahare hu muttar begizza vaavoda: 
Para sheyyalda kemin chamor o chamor sheyyalda kemin sus patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "ufeter chamor tifde vese" ufeter chamor shete peamim ad sheyyihye hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor. veim yesh bo miktzat simane chamor chayyav bivchora: 
Chamoro shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim noten tale lakkohen. yalda zachar unekeva mafrish tale echad kede lehafekia kedushsha mimmennu ad sheyyihye muttar bahanaya. shemma hazzachar nolad techilla. vetale ze shehifrish labbealim veeno lakkohen shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Shete chamorav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten shene telaim lakkohen. zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva noten tale echad lakkohen: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot en kan lakkohen kelum. veeno tzarich lehaferish tale leatzmo lefi sheyyesh kan sefekot harebe shemma haachat yalda zachar vehashsheniyya yalda shete nekevot. o shemma zo yalda nekeva vehaacheret zachar veacharav nekeva o nekeva veachareha zachar. vechen sefekot harebe yesh bishne zecharim ushete nekevot. achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva mafrish tale echad leatzmo veeno notno lakkohen mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Vechen hallokeach chamor min haakkum veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda zachar pode oto bese vehu labbealim. mippene shehu safek: 
Mi shehayu lo asara telaim kol echad mehen hifrisho al sefek peter chamor hare hen kechullin lechol davar umitasserin kishar habbehema. umafresh echad mehen maaser vehashshear shello keshehayu: 
Yisrael shehayu lo asara pitre chamorim vaddain betoch beto shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen veoto avi immo hakkohen naflo lo mibbet avi immo yisrael hare ze mafrish alehen asara seyin vehen shello vechayyavin bemaaser: seliku lehu hilchot bikkurim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Sabbatical Year and the J:
Mitzvat ase lishbot meavodat haaretz vaavodat hailan beshana sheviit shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 2)</small> "veshavta haaretz shabbat laAdonai" veneemar <small>(Shemot 34 21)</small> "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot". vechol haose melacha meavodat haaretz o hailanot beshana zo bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 4)</small> "sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor": 
Eno loke min hattora ella al hazzeria o al hazzemira veal hakketzira o al habbetzira. veechad hakkerem veechad shear hailanot: 
Uzemira bichlal zeria uvetzira bichlal ketzira. velamma pertan hakkatuv lomar lecha al shete toladot ellu bilvad hu chayyav veal shear hattoladot shebbaavodat haaretz im shear haavot shello nitparshu beinyan ze eno loke alehen. aval makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Ketzad. hachofer o hachoresh letzorech hakkarka o hamesakkel o hamezabbel vechayyotze bahen mishshear avodat haaretz. vechen hammavrich o hammarkiv o hannotea vechayyotze bahen meavodat hailanot. makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehen: 
En notin bashsheviit afillu ilan serak. velo yachtoch hayyibbolet min hailanot. velo yefarek healin vehabbaddim hayeveshim. velo yeabbek et tzammarto baavak. velo yeashshen tachtav kede sheyyamut hattolaat. velo yasuch et hannetiot bedavar sheyyesh lo zohama kede shello yochal oto haof keshehu rach. velo yasuch et happaggin. velo yinkov otan. velo yichroch et hannetiot. velo yiktom otam. velo yefasseg et hailanot. vechen shear kol avodat hailan. veim asa achat meellu bashsheviit makkin oto makkat mardut: 
En metzitin et haur beishat hakkanim mippene shehi avodat karka. veen melammedin et happara lachrosh ella bechol. veen bodkin et hazzeraim beatzitz male afar aval bodkin otan beatzitz male gelalim. veshorin et hazzeraim bashsheviit kede lezaran bemotzae sheviit. umekayyemin hailuye berosh haggag aval en mashkin oto: 
Sokrin et hailan besikra. vetoanin oto baavanim veodrin tachat haggefanim. vehamekashkesh bezetim im lehaverot et hailan asur veim listom et happetzimim muttar: 
Mashkin bet hashshelachin bashsheviit vehi sede hazzeria shetztzemea beyoter. vechen sede hailanot im hayu meruchakin ze mizze yeter meeser levet sea moshchin et hammayim meilan leilan. aval lo yashku et kol hassade. veim hayu mekoravin ze laze eser levet sea mashkin kol hassade bishvilan. vechen afar hallavan marbitzin oto bemayim bashsheviit bishvil hailanot shello yippasdu: 
Veosin ugiyyot laggefanim. veosin et ammat hammayim kattechilla umemallein et hannekaim mayim: 
Umippene ma hittiru kol elle. sheim lo yashke tease haaretz melecha veyamut kol etz shebbah. vehoil veissur haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahem middivrehem lo gazru al ellu sheen asur min hattora ella otan shene avot ushete toladot shellahem kemo shebbearnu: 
Mishsherabbu haannasin vehittilu malche akkum al yisrael laasot machanot lechelotehen hittiru lizroa bashsheviit devarim shetztzerichin lahem avde hammelech bilvad. vechen mi shekkefao annas laasot bashsheviit bechinnam kemo avodat hammelech vechayyotze bahen hare ze ose: 
Hannotea bashsheviit ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor. mippene sheyyisrael chashudin al hashsheviit. im tomar beshogeg yekayyem yomar hammezid shogeg hayiti: 
Hachoresh et sadehu o narah o zibbelah bashsheviit kede shettihye yafa lizria bemotzae sheviit konsin oto velo yizraenna bemotzae sheviit. veen chochrin otah mimmennu kede lezarah ella tehi bura lefanav. veim met yizraenna beno: 
Hammaavir kotzim meartzo bashsheviit kede letakkenah lemotzae sheviit. o shessikkel mimmenna avanim af al pi sheeno rashshay lo kansu oto umuttar lo lezarah bemotzae sheviit: 
Hattomen lefet utzenonot vechayyotze bahen bashsheviit im hayu miktzat healin megullin eno choshesh veim lav asur. hattomen et halluf vechayyotze bahen lo yifchot mearba kabbim al gova tefach vetefach afar al gabbav. vetomno bimkom derisat haadam kede shello yitzmach. umuttar lemares beorez bashsheviit aval lo yechasseach: 
Barishona hayu omrim melakket adam etzim vaavanim vaasavim mittoch sadehu. vehu sheyyittol haggas haggas kede shello yitkavven lenakkot haaretz. aval missede chavero notel ben dak ben gas. mishsherabbu ovre avera shemmitkavvenin lenakkot veomrin haggas haggas anu notlin. asru littol adam missadehu ella mittoch sede chavero vehu shello yelakket betova. shello yomar lo ree kamma tov asiti lecha shehare nikketi sadcha: 
Hayta behemto omedet betoch sadehu melakket umevi lefaneha. shebbehemto mochachat alav. vechen im hayta sham kirato melakket hakkol umadlik. shekkirato mochachat alav: 
Hakkotzetz ilan o shenayim leetzim hare ze muttar lesharshan. katzatz shelosha o yeter ze betzad ze lo yesharesh. shehare metakken et haaretz. ella kotzetz meal haaretz umanniach sharashav baaretz. bamme devarim amurim mittoch shello. aval missede chavero muttar lesharesh: 
Hammavkia bezayit littol etzim lo yechappe mekom habbikkua beafar mippene shehi avoda aval mechasse baavanim o bekash: 
Hamezannev baggefanim vehakkotzetz kanim hare ze kotzetz kedarko bekardom uvemaggal uvimgera uvechol ma sheyyirtze: 
En kotztzin betulat shikma bashsheviit kederech shekkotztzin bishar hashshanim mippene shekketzitzatah avodat ilan. shebbiktzitza zo tigdal vetosif. veim tzarich leetzeha kotzetz otah shello kederech avodatah: 
Ketzad kotztzah. meim haaretz o lemala measara tefachim. ilan shennifshach koshrin oto bashsheviit. lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif:

Lo yotzi adam zevalim mechatzero veyitten betoch sadehu bashsheviit mippene shennire kimzabbel sadehu shettihye yafa lizria. veim hotzi veheemid mimmennu ashpa muttar. velo yaase ashpa betoch sadehu ad sheyyaavor zeman shemmezabbelin bo laavodat haaretz vehu mishsheyyikshor hammatok. velo yaase ashpa pechuta mimmea vachamishshim sea shel zevel kede shettihye nikkeret shehi ashpa. veim yirtze lehosif mosif. haya lo davar muat mosif alav veholech. velo yaase bechol bet sea yeter mishshalosh ashpattot: 
Veharotze laasot kol sadehu shalosh shalosh ashpattot letoch bet sea ose. veharotze laasot zivlo otzar ose: 
Haya maamid hazzevel al hassela o sheheemik baaretz shelosha tefachim veheerim hazzevel o shebbana al haaretz gova shelosha veheemid alav hazzevel. eno tzarich shiur. afillu asa ken kamma ashpattot letoch bet sea ben gedolot ben ketannot muttar. shehare haddavar nikkar sheenan laavodat haaretz ella lichnisat hazzevel: 
Muttar leadam lehotzi zevel min hassahar shel tzon venoten letoch sadehu kederech kol machnise zevel. vehaose dir betoch sadehu bashsheviit lo yaasehu yeter al bet satayim veyachnis hatztzon letocho. uchesheyyezabbelu et kol haddir meniach dofen echad middafne haddir veose dir acher betziddo. nimtza mezabbel betoch sadehu bet arbaat sein: 
Hayta kol sadehu bet arbaat sein meshayyer mimmenna miktzat mippene marit haayin. kede sheyyedu hakkol shehatztzon hetilu bah veniddayyra. velo yomru zibbel ze kol sadehu bashsheviit: 
Lo yiftach adam mechtzav battechilla letoch sadehu bashsheviit shemma yomru letakken sadehu nitkavven sheyyasir mimmenna hassela. veim hitchil mikkodem sheviit ufitztzel mimmenna sheva veesrim avanim beribbua shalosh al shalosh al rum shalosh kol even mehen amma al amma berum amma o gedolot mizzo hare ze muttar lenakker mimmennu bashsheviit kol ma sheyyirtze: 
Gader shel avanim sheyyesh begavho asara tefachim o yeter veratza littol kol avanav im hayu bo eser avanim o yeter kol achat mehen massoy shenayim o gedolot mizzo hare ze notel sheharoe yodea shelletzorech haavanim hu notel. haya pachot measara o shehayu pachot meeser avanim o shehayu avanav ketannot mimmassoy shenayim notel ad sheyyanniach tefach samuch laaretz: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshennitkavven letakken sadehu (o) shehitchil littol bashsheviit. aval im lo nitkavven letakken sadehu o shehitchil mikkodem sheviit notel bashsheviit kol ma sheyyirtze mikkol makom ugomem ad laaretz. vechen im haya notel missede chavero af al pi shehu kibbelan gomem ad laaretz: 
Avanim sheruyot shettezazea otan hammacharesha o shehayu mechussot venitgallu. im yesh bahen shetayim shel massoy shenayim shenayim hare ze muttar littol otan. hayu ketannot mizze lo yinnatlu: 
Hamesakkel sadehu bashsheviit mippene shehu tzarich laavanim notel et haelyonot umanniach et hannogot baaretz. vechen im haya lo besadehu garger shel tzerorot o gal shel avanim notel et haelyonot umanniach et hannogot baaretz. veim yesh tachtehen sela o kash yittol et kullan: 
Lo yemalle adam gay afar o yetakkenennu beafar mippene shemmetakken et haaretz. aval ose hu chayitz al pene haggay. vechol even sheyyachol lifshot et yado velittelah vehu omed al sefat haggay hare zo tinnatel: 
Avne katef vehem hannittalot shetayim shalosh al hakkatef muttar lahavian mikkol makom ben missede chavero ben missadehu. vechen hakkabbelan mevi mikkol makom vaafillu avanim gedolot ben missade shekkibbelah ben missade shello kibbelah: 
Pirtza shehi suga beafar im enah machshelet et harabbim asur livnotah. veim hayta machshelet et harabbim o shello hayta suga beafar ella petucha lirshut harabbim muttar livnotah: 
Asur lo livnot gader bashsheviit ben sadehu lisde chavero. aval bone gader beno uven reshut harabbim. umuttar lehaamik ad hassela umotzi et heafar vetzovro betoch sadehu kederech kol maamidin zevel. vechen im chafar bor veshiach umeara bashsheviit tzover heafar betoch sadehu kederech kol hachofrim:

Avodat haaretz beshana shishshit sheloshim yom samuch lashsheviit asura halacha lemoshe missinay. mippene shehu metakkenah lashsheviit. vedavar ze bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam hu shenneesar mippi hashshemua. vegazru chachamim shello yihyu chorshim sede hailan erev sheviit bizman hammikdash ella ad haatzeret. usede hallavan ad happasach. uvazzeman sheen mikdash muttarin baavodat haaretz ad rosh hashshana kedin tora: 
E zo hi sede hailan. kol shelosha ilanot levet sea. echad ilan serak veachad ilan maachol vaafillu hen shel shelosha anashim roin otan keillu hem teenim. im reuyin laasot kikkar devela shel shishshim mane chorshin kol bet sea bishvilam. vehu sheyyihye rachok ben kol echad veechad kede sheyyihye habbakar yachol laavor bechelav: 
Hayu pachot mishshelosha levet sea. o shehayu shelosha veechad rauy laasot shishshim mane o yeter vehashshenayim enan reuyin laasot. o shenayim reuyin laasot afillu mea mane veechad eno ose. en chorshin lahen ella letzarkam vehu melo haore vesallo chutza lo: 
Hayu mishlosha vead tisha ureuyin laasot shishshim mane chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan veaf al pi sheyyesh bahem mi sheeno rauy laasot: 
Hayu asara ilanot letoch bet sea o yeter ben osin ben enam osin chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan. eser netiot mefuzzarot letoch bet sea chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan ad rosh hashshana vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Hayu asuyot shura achat (o) mukkafot atara en chorshin lahen ella tzarkan lechol echad veechad. vehaddilluin im hannetiot mitztarfot laasara: 
E zo hi netia ze hailan hakkatan kol zeman shekkorin lo netia: 
Ilan shenniktzatz vehotzi chalifin im niktzatz mittefach ulemala hare hu keilan. mittefach ulematta hare hu kintia: 
Vechol haddevarim haellu bizman hammikdash kemo sheamarnu. aval bazzeman hazze muttarin baavodat haaretz ad rosh hashshana. af bizman hammikdash muttar lesakkel ulezabbel hassadot velaador hammikshaot vehammidlaot uvet hashshelachin ad rosh hashshana. umezabbelin umefarkin umeabbekin umeashshenin umekarsemin umezardin umefasselin umezahamin et hannetiot vechorchin vekotmin otan. veosin lahem battim umashkin otam. vesachin et happaggin. umenakkevin otan. kol avodot ellu muttarot beerev sheviit ad rosh hashshana shel sheviit vaafillu bizman hammikdash: 
Pagge erev sheviit shennichnesu lishviit veshel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit lo sachin velo menakkevin. uvizman hammikdash en bonin madregot al pi haggeayot erev sheviit mishsheyyippasku haggeshamim. mippene shehu metakkenan lashsheviit: 
Af bazzeman hazze en notin ilanot veen markivin veen mavrichin erev sheviit ella kede shettiklot hannetia vetishhe achar hakkelita sheloshim yom kodem rosh hashshana shel sheviit. usetam kelita shete shabbatot. vedavar ze asur leolam mippene marit haayin shemma yomar haroe bashsheviit nitteu. nimtzeta omer shehannotea o hammavrich o hammarkiv erev sheviit kodem rosh hashshana bemd yom yekayyem. pachot mikken yaakor. veim lo akar happerot muttarin. veim met kodem sheyyaakor mechayyevin et hayyoresh laakor:

Kol shettotzi haaretz beshana sheviit. ben min hazzera shennafal bah mikkodem sheviit. ben min haikkarim shenniktzeru mikkodem vechazru veasu ushenehem nikreu safiach. ben min haasavim vehayerakot shealu mealehen veen lahen zera. hakkol muttar leachlo min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem leachla". vaafillu sade shennittayba bashsheviit vetzamcha peroteha muttarin baachila. veze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 5)</small> "et sefiach ketzircha lo tiktzor" shello yiktzor kederech shekkotzer bechol shana. veim katzar kederech hakkotzrin loke. kegon shekkatzar kol hassade veheemid keri vedash babbakar. o shekkatzar laavodat haaretz kemo shebbearnu. ella kotzer meat meat vechovet veochel: 
Umiddivre sofrim sheyyihyu kol hassefichim asurin baachila. velamma gazru alehem mippene ovre avera. shello yelech veyizra tevua vekitniyyot vezerone ginna betoch sadehu basseter. uchesheyyitzmach yochal mehem veyomar sefichim hen. lefichach asru kol hassefichim hatztzomchim bashsheviit: 
Ha lamadta sheen ochlin mipperot sheviit ella perot hailanot vehaasavim sheen zorin otam rov haadam kegon happegam vehayyarbuzin hashshotim vechol kayyotze bahen. aval hayerakot shedderech rov haadam lezaram bagginnot umine tevua vekitniyyot kol hatztzomeach mehen asur middivrehem. vehamelakketan makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Sefichim haolim bisde bur uvisde nir uvisde kerem uvisde zera muttarin baachila. umippene ma lo gazru alehem lefi sheen adam zorea mekomot ellu. sede bur en adam nifne lesham. usede nir rotze hu betikkunah. usede kerem eno oser karmo. usede zera hassefichin mafsidin otah. vechen hatteven shel sheviit muttar bechol makom velo gazru alav: 
Sefichin shel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit asurin baachila veen tolshin otan bayyad ella choresh kedarko. uvehema roa kedarkah: 
Vead matay asurin sefiche sheviit bemotzae sheviit merosh hashshana vead chanukka umechanukka veelach hen muttarin. vehazzorea sefiche sheviit achar sheviit haggiddulin muttarin: 
Betzalim sheyyatzu mishsheviit lemotzae sheviit im asu kayyotze bahen muttarin veim lav asurin. vechen shear happerot en lokchim otam bemotzae sheviit ella mishsheyyeasu kayyotze bahen mipperot motzae sheviit. asa habbakkir huttar haafil umuttar likkach yarak bemotzae sheviit miyyad: 
Meematay motar adam likach luf bemotzae sheviit mesheyyirbe hechadash:
Beechad betishre rosh hashshana lishmittin uleyovlot. perot shishshit shennichnesu lashsheviit im hayu tevua o kitniyyot o perot hailan vehiggiu leonat hammaasrot kodem rosh hashshana hare ellu muttarin. veaf al pi sheosef otam bashsheviit hare hen keferot shishshit lechol davar. veim lo bau leonat hammaasrot ella achar rosh hashshana hare hen keferot sheviit: 
Hattevua vehakkitniyyot asurin baachila mishshum sefichim. uferot hailan ochlin otan bikdushshat sheviit: 
Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagim vehashshumshemin ufol hammitzri shezzerao lezera holchin bahen achar gemar peri. im nigmar piryam kodem rosh hashshana hare ellu muttarin bashsheviit keferot shishshit. veim nigmeru achar rosh hashshana af al pi shehishrishu kodem rosh hashshana hare ellu asurim mishshum sefichim: 
Hayyarak bishat lekitato. vehaetrog afillu haya kefol kodem rosh hashshana venaasa kechikkar bashsheviit chayyav bemaasrot keferot shishshit. vaafillu haya kechikkar bashshishshit hoil venilkat bashsheviit hare hu keferot sheviit. umitasser keferot shishshit lehachamir: 
Vechen perot sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit bitvua vekitniyyot veilanot holchin achar onat hammaasrot. vhapperagin vehashshumshemin vehaorez vehaddochan ufol hammitzri shezzerao lezera achar gemar happeri. vehayyarak achar lekitato: 
Pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera bashshishshit venigmar piryo kodem rosh hashshana shel sheviit. ben yarak shello ben zera shello muttar bashsheviit. veim zara leyarak venichnesa alav sheviit ben yerako ben zaro asur kisfiche sheviit. vechen im zerao lezera uleyarak asur: 
Avar uzerao bashsheviit veyatza lashsheminit im zerao lezera ben zaro ben yerako asur bemotzae sheviit kishar hassefichim. veim zerao leyarak hoil venilkat bashsheminit ben yerako ben zaro muttar. zerao lezera uleyarak zaro asur mishshum sefichim virako muttar: 
Benot shuach hoil vehen nigmarot leachar shalosh shanim im bau leonat hammaasrot kodem rosh hashshana shel sheminit hare hen neechalot beshana sheniyya min hashshavua betorat sheviit: 
Habbetzalim hassarisim ufol hammitzri shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom kodem rosh hashshana. veshel baal shemmana mehem shalosh onot lifne rosh hashshana hare ellu mipperot shishshit. pachot mikken hare hem kisfiche sheviit: 
Haddeluin shekkiyyeman lezera im hukshu lifne rosh hashshana venifselu milleechol adam muttar lekayyeman bashsheviit shehen mipperot shishshit. veim lav asurin kisfiche sheviit. vechen hayerakot kullan shehukshu lifne rosh hashshana muttar lekayyeman bashsheviit veim hayu rakkim asur lekayyeman mishshum sefichim. en mechayyevin oto lesharesh et halluf ella mannicho baaretz kemot shehu. im tzamach lemotzae sheviit muttar. veen mechayyevin oto lesharesh et hakkundas ella gozez bealin veim tzamach lemotzae sheviit muttar: 
Luf shel erev sheviit vechen betzalim shel erev sheviit hakkitzonim ufua shennigmeru lifne sheviit muttar leakran bashsheviit bekardummot shel mattechet. veen baze mishshum avodat haaretz: 
Habbetzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim bashsheviit vetzamchu kol zeman shehealin shellahen yerukkin hare ellu muttarin. veim hishchiru hare hen kintuin baaretz veotan healin asurin mishshum sefichin. uven kach uven kach habbetzalim atzman behetteran omdin: 
Batzal sheakaro bashsheviit unetao bashsheminit verabbu giddulav al ikkaro heelu giddulav et ikkaro vehuttar hakkol hoil usheviit asura al yede karka kach netilatah al yede karka: 
Happerot sheyyotzi hailan bashsheviit lo yaasfem kederech sheosef bechol shana shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 5)</small> "veet inneve nezirecha lo tivtzor". veim batzar laavodat hailan o shebbatzar kederech habbotzrim loke: 
Vechetzad ose. teenim shel sheviit en kotzin otan bemuktze aval meyabbeshan becharava. velo yidroch anavim baggat aval dorech hu baareva. velo yaase zetim bevayit habbad. aval kotesh hu umachnis letoch bad katan beyoter vetochen bevet habbad uvakkotev umachnis levad ketanna. vechen bishar haddevarim kol sheyyachol leshannot meshanne: 
Mitzvat ase lehashemit kol ma shettotzi haaretz bashsheviit shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 11)</small> "vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah". vechol hannoel karmo o sag sadehu bashsheviit bittel mitzvat ase. vechen im asaf kol perotav letoch beto. ella yafkir hakkol veyad hakkol shavin bechol makom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 11)</small> "veachlu evyone ammecha". veyesh lo lehavi letoch beto meat kederech shemmeviin min hahefker. chamesh kadde shemen chamishsha asar kadde yayin. veim hevi yeter mizze muttar: 
En sheviit noheget ella beeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 2)</small> "ki tavou el haaretz" vegomer. venoheget ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit: 
Kol shehechziku bo ole bavel ad keziv asur baavoda vechol hassefichin shetztzomchin bo asurin baachila. vechol shello hecheziku bo ella ole mitzrayim bilvad shehu mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amna. af al pi shehu asur baavoda bashsheviit. hassefichin shetztzomchin bo muttarim baachila. umehannahar umeamana vahala muttar baavoda bashsheviit: 
Sureya af al pi sheen sheviit noheget bah min hattora gazru aleha shettihye asura baavoda bashsheviit keeretz yisrael. kede shello yanichu eretz yisrael veyelchu veyishtakkeu sham. aval ammon umoav umitzrayim veshinar af al pi shehem chayyavot bemaasrot middivrehem en sheviit noheget bahen: 
Ever hayyarden sheviit noheget bah middivrehem. usefiche sureya veever hayyarden muttarin baachila. lo yihyu aratzot ellu chamurin meeretz yisrael shehechziku bah ole mitzrayim: 
Akkum shekkana karka baaretz yisrael uzeraah bashsheviit peroteha muttarin. shello gazru al hassefichin ella mippene ovre avera. vehaakkum enan metzuvvin al hashsheviit kede shennigzor alehem: 
Ayarot eretz yisrael hassemuchot lassefar moshivim alehem neeman kede shello yafutzu akkum veyavozzu perot sheviit:
Perot sheviit nittenu laachila velishtiyya ulesicha ulehadlakat hanner velitzvia. mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Vayikra 25 7)</small> "tihye" af lehadelakat ner velitzboa bah tzeva:
Laachila velishtiyya ketzad. leechol davar sheddarko leechol. velishtot davar sheddarko lishtot. kedin teruma umaaser sheni:

Velo yeshanne perot mibberiyyatan kederech sheeno meshanne bitruma umaaser sheni. davar sheddarko leechol chay lo yochlennu mevushshal. vedavar sheddarko leheachel mevushshal en ochlin oto chay. lefichach en sholkin ochole behema veeno metappel leechol tavshil shennifsad vehappat sheippesha kederech sheeno ochel bitruma umaaser:
Veen mevashshelin yarak shel sheviit beshemen teruma shello yeviennu lide pesul. veim bishshel meat vaachalo miyyad muttar shehare lo hinnichan kede lavo lide pesul:

Perot hameyuchadin lemaachal adam en maachilin otan livhema lechayya uleofot. halcha habbehema meeleha letachat hatteena veachla en mechayyevin oto lehachezirah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 7)</small> "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah leechol":
Lesicha ketzad. lasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen. velo yefattem et hashshemen. velo yasuch bammerchatz aval sach hu mibbachutz venichnas:

Shemen shel sheviit en chosmin bo tannur vechirayim. veen sachin bo minal vesandal. veen sachin oto beyadayim temeot. nafal al besaro meshafshefo beyadayim temeot. velo yasuch raglo betoch hamminal. aval sach hu raglo velovesh hamminal. vesach gufo umitaggel al gabbe katavliya:

Lehadelakat hanner ketzad. shemmadlik et hanner beshemen sheviit atzmo. mecharo velakach bo shemen acher o shehechlif shemen beshemen shenehem asurim behadelaka. sheen madlikin bidme sheviit. velo yitten hashshemen letoch hammedura ella madliko bener:

Litzvia ketzad. devarim sheddarkan litzboa bahen af al pi shehen maachle adam tzovin bahen leadam. aval en tzovin livhema mipperot sheviit afillu maachle behema. sheen kedushshat sheviit chala al tzive behema:

Mine kibbusim kegon borit veahal kedushshat sheviit chala alehen umechabbesin bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem" lechol tzarchechem. aval en mechabbesin beferot sheviit veen osin mehem melugema shenneemar vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem leachla velo limlugema velo lezilluf velo lehaki velo lemishra velo lichvisa:

Kelal gadol amru beferot sheviit. kol shehu meyuchad lemaachal adam kegon chittim teenim vaanavim vechayyotze bahen en osin mimmennu melugema o retiyya vechayyotze bo afillu leadam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "lachem leachla" kol shehu meyuchad lachem yihye leachla velo lirfua. vechol sheeno meyuchad lemaachal adam kegon kotzin vedardarin harakkim osin mehen melugema leadam aval lo livhema. vechol sheeno meyuchad lo laze velo laze kegon hassea vehaezov vehakkoranit hare hu taluy bemachashavto. chashav alav leetzim hare hu keetzim. laachila hare hu keferot. lemaachal adam ulemaachal behema notnin alav chumre maachal adam, sheen osin mehen melugema. vechumre maachal behema sheen sholkin oto:

Muttar limkor ochole adam veochole behema velikkach bahem ochole adam. aval en mochrin ochole behema likkach bahem ochole behema acheret. veen tzarich lomar sheen mochrin ochole adam likkach bahem ochole behema. veim lakach bahen o hechlif bahen ochole adam beochole behema hare hen keochole adam sheen osin mehen melugema laadam:

Perot sheviit en motziin otan mehaaretz lechutza laaretz vaafillu lesureya. veen maachilin otan lo leakkum velo lesachir. veim haya sechir shabbat o sechir shana o sechir chodesh o shekkatzatz mezonotav alav hare hu keanshe beto umaachilin oto. umaachilin et haachsanya perot sheviit:
En bet din poskin leishsha perot sheviit. mippene shezze kimshallem chov mipperot sheviit. aval nizzonet hi mishshel balah:

En osfin perot sheviit keshehen boser shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 12)</small> "tochlu et tevuatah" enah neechelet ad shettease tevua. aval ochel mehen meat bassade keshehem paggin kederech sheochel bishar shene shavua. velo yachnis leechol betoch beto ad sheyyaggiu leonat hammaasrot:

Umeematay yihye muttar leechol perot hailan bassade bashsheviit. happaggin shel teenim mishsheyyazrichu ochel bahen pitto bassade. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. habboser mishsheyyotzi mayim veochlo bassade. vechen kol kayyotze bo. hazzetim mishsheyyichnesu sea shel zetim reviit shemen potzea veochel bassade. hichnisu chatzi log kotesh vesach bassade. hichnis shelish muttar lehachenis leveto shehare higgiu leonat hammaasrot:

Muttar lakotz ilanot leetzim bashsheviit kodem sheyyihye bahen peri. aval mishsheyyatchil laasot peri lo yakotz oto shehare mafsid haochel veneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "lachem leachla" velo lehefsed. veim hotzi perot vehiggiu leonat hammaasrot muttar lakotz oto shehare hotzi perotav uvatel din sheviit mimmennu:

Umeematay en kotztzin hailan bashsheviit. hecharuvin mishsheyyeshalshelu. vehaggefanim mishsheyyiggaru. vehazzetim mishsheyyanetztzu. ushear kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu boser. veen kotztzin et hakkafniyyot bashsheviit mippene shehu hefsed peri. veim en darkan leheasot temarim ella shitzin muttar lakotz otan kafniyyot:
En sorfin teven vekash shel sheviit mippene shehu rauy lemaachal behema. aval massikin begefet uvezaggin shel sheviit:

Merchatz shehusseka beteven uvekash shel sheviit muttar lirchotz bah besachar. veim adam chashuv hu asur shemma yassiku bah devarim acherim bishvilo kede sheyyihye rechah nodef. venimtzeu mafsidin perot sheviit:
Hakkelippin vehaggarinin shemmuttarin bitruma lezarim en kedushshat sheviit chala alehem vahare hen keetzim ella im ken reuyin litzvia. vehakkor kedushshat sheviit chala alav:
Hatztzorer tavlin shel sheviit venoten letoch hattavshil. im batel taman hare ellu muttarin lechol davar. veim nishar bahen taam adayin hem bikdushshat sheviit:

En notnin teven vekash shel sheviit lo letoch hakkar velo letoch hattit. veim natan hare ze kimvoar. tannur shehissikuhu beteven uvekash shel sheviit yutzan. umishshettered revia sheniyya bemotzae sheviit nehenin vesorfin beteven uvekash shel sheviit:

En osin sechora beferot sheviit. veim ratza limkor meat mipperot sheviit mocher. veotan haddamim hare hen keferot sheviit veyillakach bahen maachol veyeachel bikdushshat sheviit. veoto happeri hannimkar hare hu bikdushshato keshehaya: 
Lo yihye lokeach yarkot sade umocher. velo yitzba mikkelippe sheviit besachar. mippene shezze ose sechora beferot sheviit. lakach yerakot leechol vehotir muttar limkor hammotar vehaddamim sheviit. vechen im likket yerakot leatzmo velakach mehen beno o ben bitto umachar hare ze muttar vehaddamim deme sheviit: 
Keshemmochrin perot sheviit en mochrin otan lo bemidda velo bemishkal velo beminyan. kede shello yihye kesocher perot bashsheviit. ella mocher hameat shemmocher achsara lehodia shehu hefker velokeach haddamim liknot bahen ochel acher: 
Veoged devarim sheddarkan leheaged labbayit limkor bashshuk achsara kederech sheogdin lehavi labbayit lo kederech sheogdin lashshuk. kede shello yihye kemocher betzimtzum. udevarim sheen darkan leheaged ella lashshuk lo yeegod otan: 
Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz lo yihyu nimkarim bemidda o bemishkal o beminyan. ella keferot haaretz achsara. veim hayu nikkarin shehem michutza laaretz muttar: 
Chomer bishviit mibbehekdesh. shehappode et hahekdesh yatza hekdesh lechullin veyittafsu haddamim tachtav. vehashsheviit enah ken. ella hammocher perot sheviit yittafsu haddamim veyeasu keferot sheviit. vehapperot atzman lo nitchallelu venaasu keferot shear shanim. shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 25 7)</small> "tihye" bahavayatah tehe leolam. ulefi shennikret <small>(Vayikra 25 12)</small> "kodesh" tofeset dameha. nimtzeta omer haacharon nitpas bashsheviit vehapperi atzmo hu kemo shehaya: 
Ketzad. lakach beferot sheviit o bidmehen basar naasa habbasar keotan happerot veochlo keferot sheviit. vetzarich levaer otan bishat biur hashsheviit. lakach beoto basar o bedamav dagim yatza habbasar venitpesu haddagim. lakach baddagim o bidmehen shemen yatzu dagim venitpas shemen. lakach bashshemen o bedamav devash yatza shemen venitpas devash. vetzarich levaer happerot harishonot im haddevash haacharon kederech shemmevaarin perot sheviit. veen osin mishshenehem melugema velo mafsidin otan, kishar perot sheviit: 
En sheviit mitchallelet ella al derech mikkach. bamme devarim amurim bifri rishon. aval bifri sheni mitchallel ben derech mikkach ben derech chillul: 
Ucheshemmechallelin peri hannilkach shenit en mechallelin oto al behema chayya veof chayyim. shemma yannichem vigaddel mehem adarim. veen tzarich lomar sheviit atzmah. aval mechallelin otan happerot al hashshechutim: 
Deme sheviit en porin mehem et hachov. veen osin bahen shoshvinut. veen meshallemin mehen tagmulin. veen poskin mehen tzedaka laaniyyim bevayit hakkeneset. aval meshallechin mehen devarim shel gemilut chasadim vetzarich lehodia. vechen en lokchin mehem avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea veim lakach yochal kenegdan kederech sheose bemaaser sheni. veen meviin mehen kinne zavim vezavot veyoldot vechattaot vaashamot. veim hevi yochal kenegdan. veen sachim kelim veorot beshemen shel sheviit. veim sach yochal kenegdan: 
En notnin mehen lo levallan velo lesappar velo lesappan velo lishar haummanin. aval noten hu lemi sheddole mayim min habbor lehashekoto mayim. umuttar litten mipperot sheviit o middemehen laummanin mattenat chinnam: 
Haomer lefoel he lecha isar ze velakket li yarak hayyom secharo muttar veeno kidme sheviit. ella motzio bechol ma sheyyirtze. velo kansu happoel lihyot secharo kidme sheviit. veim amar lo lakket li bo hayyom yarak hare ze kidme sheviit veeno motzio ella baachila ushetiyya keferot sheviit: 
Hachammarim haosim beferot sheviit melechet sheviit haasura. kegon sheheviu yoter midday. hare secharan kidme sheviit. vedavar ze kenas lahem. umippene ma kansu bischar hachammarim velo kansu bischar happoel. mippene shessecharo meat lo kansu bo mishshum kede chayyav: 
Hallokeach min hannachtom kikkar befunedyon veamar lo bishat lekicha keshealakket yerakot sade avi lecha bo hare ze muttar. veoto hakkikkar hare hu keferot sheviit. veim lakach mimmennu setam lo yeshallem lo middeme sheviit. sheen porin chov mehen: 
Ochlin perot sheviit betova veshello betova. betova ketzad. sheyyitten lo perot sheviit kemo sheasa immo tova shennatan lo. o sheyyachniso leginnato leechol kemi sheasa lo tova. vmi shennatnu lo perot sheviit bemattana o shennaflu lo birushsha hare ze ochlam kederech sheochel perot sheosef otan hu beatzmo min hassade:

Perot sheviit en ochlin mehen ella kol zeman sheoto hammin matzuy bassade shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 7)</small> "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah leechl". kol zeman shechayya ochelet mimmin ze min hassade atta ochel mimma shebbabbayit. kala lachayya min hassade chayyav levaer oto hammin min habbayit vezehu biur shel perot sheviit:
Ketzad. hare shehayu lo gerogarot sheviit betoch beto ochel mehen kol zeman shehatteenim bailanot bassade. kalu hatteenim min hassade asur leechol meotan shebbabbayit ella mevaer otan:

Hayu lo perot merubbin mechallekan mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. veasur leechol achar habbiur ben laaniyyim ben laashirim. veim lo matza ochlin bishat habbiur soref baesh o mashlich leyam hammelach umeabbedan lechol davar shemmeabbed:

Hayu lo tzimmukin shel sheviit. vechalu haanavim min hassade min haggaggot vehappardesim shehen hefker. af al pi sheadayin yesh anavim baggefanim shebbetoch hachatzerot eno ochel min hatztzimmukin mippene anavim ellu shebbechatzer. lefi sheenan metzuyin lachayya. aval im yesh anavim kashim beyoter sheenan nigmarin ella besof hashshana hare ze ochel min hatztzimmukin bishvilan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ilan sheose perot shete peamim beshana vehayu lo mipperotav harishonot hare ze ochel mehen kol zeman shepperot sheniyyot metzuyot bassade. shehare meoto hammin bassade. aval perot hassetav en ochlim bishvilan. mippene sheddomin lapperot shel shana acheret:

Hakkovesh shelosha kevashim bechavit achat. kol shekkala mino min hassade yevaer mino min hechavit. veim hitchil bah hare hakkol kimvoar. ucheshem shemmevaer ochole adam kach mevaer ochole behema min habbayit. veeno maachilan livhema im kala oto hammin min hassade:

Ucheshem shemmevaarin et happerot kach mevaarin et haddamim. ketzad. hare shemmachar rimmonim shel sheviit vahare hu ochel bidmehen. vechalu harimmonim min hailanot shebbassade venishar etzlo min haddamim shemmachar bahen chayyav levaaran:
Ketzad ose. kone bahen. maachalot umechallekan mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. o yashlichem leyam hammelach im lo matza ochlin:

Shalosh aratzot leviur. eretz yehuda kullah hahar vehashshefela vehaemek eretz achat. ever hayyarden kullo shiflat lud vehar shiflat lud umibbet choron im hayyam eretz achat. vehaggalil kullo haelyon vehattachton utechum teverya eretz achat. veochlin bechol achat veachat mishshelashtan ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbah:
Ketzad. hayu lo perot beeretz yehuda. ochel mehen kol zeman sheyyesh meoto hammin bechol eretz yehuda kullah. vechen im hayu lo perot galil. vechen beever hayyarden:

Veshalosh aratzot ellu kullan chashuvot keeretz achat lecharuvin ulezetim velitmarim. veochlin battemarim ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbetzoar. veematay hu kale. ad happurim. veochlin bezetim ad haatzeret. uvaanavim ad happesach shel motzae sheviit. uvigrogrot ad hachanukka:

Hammolich perot sheviit mimmakom shekkalu lemakom shello kalu o mimmakom shello kalu lammakom shekkalu chayyav levaer. lefi shennotnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. uferot haaretz sheyyatzu lechutza laaretz mitbaarim bimkoman velo yaavirem mimmakom lemakom:

Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit kol shehu maachal adam o maachal behema o mimmin hatztzovin im eno mitkayyem baaretz yesh lo uledamav sheviit vechayyav beviur hu vedamav. kegon ale halluf hashshote vaale haddandanna vehaelshin maachal adam. uchegon hachochim vehaddardarin maachal habbehema. uchegon istis vekotza mimmin hatztzovin. veim haya mitkayyem baaretz kegon happua veharichpa mimmin hatztzovin af al pi sheyyesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit en lahem biur velo lidmehem shehare mitkayyem baaretz ella nehenin vetzovin bo ad rosh hashshana:

Vechol sheeno meyuchad lo lemaachal adam velo lemaachal behema veeno mimmin hatztzovim. hoil veeno leetzim yesh lo uledamav sheviit. aval en lahem biur af al pi sheeno mitkayyem baaretz ella nehenin bo o bedamav ad rosh hashshana kegon ikkere halluf hashshote veikkar haddandanna vehaakrevanin:

Kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello kelippe egozim vehaggarinin yesh lahem sheviit velidmehem sheviit aval en lahem biur velo lidmehem. luleve zeradim vehecharuvim yesh lahem velidmehem sheviit uviur. luleve haela vehabbatna vehaatadin yesh lahen velidmehen sheviit aval en lahem biur. aval lealim shellahen yesh biur:
Ezo hi sheat biur healin beet sheyyibbolu venoshrin meilanotehen. ale zetim vaale kanim vaale charuvin en lahem biur lefi sheenan novlot vechalot:
Vead matay yihye adam rashshay lilkot asavim lachin bashsheviit ad sheyyivash hammatok vigabbev. asavim yeveshim ad shettered revia sheniyya bemotzae sheviit:
Vead matay yihyu haaniyyim muttarin lehikkanes befardesot bemotzae sheviit leissuf perot sheviit. ad shettered revia sheniyya:
Havvered vehakkofer vehallotem yesh lahen velidmehen sheviit. hakketaf vehu saraf hayyotze mehailanot min healim umehaikkarim en lo sheviit. vehayyotze min happaggim yesh lo uledamav sheviit:
Bamme devarim amurim beilan maachol. aval beilan serak af hayyotze min healin umin haikkarim kifri shellahen veyesh lo uledamav sheviit:

Hakkovesh vered sheviit beshemen shel shishshit yelakket et havvered vehashshemen muttar. kevasho beshemen shel motzae sheviit chayyav levaer hashshemen shehare havvered yavesh hu uchevar nitchayyev beviur:

Charuvin shel sheviit shekkevashan beyen shishshit o beyen motzae sheviit chayyav levaer hayyayin. shehare taam perot sheviit bo. ze hakkelal perot sheviit shennitarvu beferot acherot min bemino bechol shehu veshello bemino benoten taam:

Kederech sheasur laavod haaretz bashsheviit kach asur lechazzek yede yisrael sheovdin otah. o limkor lahen kele avoda. lefi sheasur lechazzek yede ovre avera: 
Veellu kelim sheen haumman rashshay lemachran bashsheviit lemi shechashud al hashsheviit. machresha vechol keleha haol vehammazzere vehaddeker. ze hakkelal kol shemmelachto meyuchedet limlacha sheasura bashsheviit asur lemachro lechashud. velimlacha sheefshar shettihye asura vetihye mutteret muttar lemachro lechashud: 
Ketzad. mocher hu lo hammaggal vehaagala vechol keleha. sheim yiktzor bo meat veyavi al haagala meat hare ze muttar. veim yiktzor kederech hakkotzrin o yavi kol perot sadehu asur: 
Umuttar limkor setam lemi sheeno chashud afillu davar shemmelachto meyuchedet limlacha haasura bashsheviit. shehare efshar shekkana bashsheviit laasot lo melacha leachar sheviit: 
Hayyotzer mocher chamesh kade shemen vachamishsha asar kadde yayin. umuttar limkor leakkum yeter mizze veeno choshesh shemma yimkor leyisrael. umocher kaddim rabbim leyisrael bechutza laaretz veeno choshesh shemma yeviem laaretz: 
Umocher lechashud para choreshet bashsheviit shehare efshar leshochotah. umocher lo sadehu shehare efshar sheyyovirah. aval lo yimkor lo sede hailan ella im ken pasak immo al menat sheen lo bailan. umashilo sea limdod bah af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo goren shehare efshar sheyyimdod bah betoch beto. uforet lo maot af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo poalim. vechullan beferush asurim: 
Vechen mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit nafa uchevara rechayim vetannur. aval lo tavor velo titchon immah: 
Machazikin yede akkum bashsheviit bidvarim bilvad. kegon sheraahu choresh o zorea omer lo titchazzek o tatzliach vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. mippene sheenam metzuvvin al shevitat haaretz. aval lo yesaaddenu bayyad. umuttar lirdot immahen hakkavveret vechochrin mehen nirin lefi sheenan bene chiyyuv kede liknos otan: 
Muttar laasot besureya betalush aval lo bamchubbar. ketzad. dashin vezorin vedorchin umeammerin. aval lo kotzrin velo botzrin velo moskin. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Keshem sheasur laasot sechora beferot sheviit o leshamran kach asur likkach meam haaretz. lefi sheen mosrin deme sheviit leam haaretz. vaafillu kol shehu. shemma lo yochal otan bikdushshat sheviit: 
Hallokeach lulav meam haaretz bashsheviit noten lo etrog mattana. veim lo natan lo mavlia lo deme etrog bidme lulav: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehaya mocher perot shekkemotan beshamur kegon teenim verimmonim vechayyotze bahen. aval haya mocher perot shechezkatan min hahefker kegon happegam vehayyarbuzin vehashshotim vehachalaglogot vehakkusbar shel harim vechayyotze bahen hare ze muttar likkach mimmennu meat kidme shalosh seuddot bilvad mishshum kede chayyav shel mocher: 
Vechol davar sheeno chayyav bemaasrot kegon shum baal bechi uvatzal shel richpa ugerisin hakkilkiyyot vaadashim hammitzriyyot vechen zerone ginna sheenan neechalot kegon zera lefet utzenon vechayyotze bahen hare ellu nilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit: 
Bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz setam. aval mi shehu chashud laasot sechora beferot sheviit o lishmor perotav velimkor mehen en lokchin mimmennu davar sheyyesh alav zikkat sheviit kelal. veen lokchin mimmennu pishtan afillu saruk. aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy veshazur: 
Hechashud al hashsheviit eno chashud al hammaasrot. vehechashud al hammaasrot eno chashud al hashsheviit. sheaf al pi shezze veze min hattora. maaser taun havaat makom ma sheen ken bashsheviit. usheviit en lah pidyon ma sheen ken bemaaser: 
Hechashud al hattohorot eno chashud lo al hammaaser velo al hashsheviit. shehaochel hattame hazze shemmecharo bechezkat tahor eno metamme acherim ella middivre sofrim. vehechashud ledivre sofrim eno chashud ledivre tora: 
Kol hechashud al davar af al pi sheeno neeman al shel atzmo neeman hu al shel acherim chazaka en adam chote laacherim. lefichach hechashud al haddavar dano umeido: 
Hakkohanim chashudin al hashsheviit lefi shehem omrim hoil vehatterumot muttarot lanu af al pi shehen asurin al hazzarim bemita kal vachomer perot sheviit. lefichach sea teruma shennafla lemea sea shel perot sheviit taale. nafla lefachot mimmea yerakvu hakkol velo yimmachru lakkohanim kechol medumma lefi shehem chashudin al hashsheviit: 
Hatztzavanin vehappattamin lokchin mursan mikkol makom. veenan choshshin shemma missefiche sheviit hu: 
Gabbae kuppa bashsheviit lo yihyu medakdekin bachatzerot shel ochlin sheviit. veim natnu lahen pat mutteret veen choshshin lah shemma missefiche sheviit hu. shello nechshedu yisrael lihyot notnin ella o meot sheviit o betzim hannilkachot bidme sheviit. umuttar lilvot min haaniyyim perot sheviit umachzirin lahen perot beshana sheminit:

Mitzvat ase lehashemit hammalve bashsheviit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "shamot kol baal mashshe yado". vehattovea chov sheavra alav sheviit avar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggosho et reehu veet achiv": 
En shemittat kesafim noheget min hattora ella bizman shehayyovel noheg sheyyesh sham shemittat karka. shehare yashuv hakkarka livalav belo kesef. vedavar ze kabbala hu. amru chachamim bizman sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. uvizman sheen sham shemittat karka en atta meshammet kesafim bishviit afillu baaretz: 
Umiddivre sofrim shettehe shemittat kesafim noheget bazzeman hazze bechol makom veaf al pi sheen hayyovel noheg kede shello tishtakkeach torat shemittat hakkesafim miyyisrael: 
En sheviit meshammetet kesafim ella besofah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 1)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim taase" shemitta veze devar hashshemitta vesham hu omer <small>(Devarim lo 10)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot". ma sham achar sheva af hashematat kesafim achar sheva. lefichach hilva et chavero bashsheviit atzmah gove chovo kol hashshana. ucheshettishka chamma belele rosh hashshana shel motzae sheviit avad hachov: 
Shachat et happara vechillekah al daat shehayyom rosh hashshana shel motzae sheviit venitabber elul venimtza oto hayyom sof sheviit avdu haddamim. shehare avra sheviit al hachov: 
Sheviit meshammetet et hammilve vaafillu milve shebbishtar sheyyesh bo acharayut nechasim hare ze meshammet. veim siyyem lo sade behalevaato eno mashmit. vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" mikkol makom lo leshallem velo lehishshava: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishvuat haddayyanin vechol kayyotze bah middevarim sheim yode bahen sheviit meshammattan. aval shevuat hashshomrin vehashshuttafin vechayyotze bahen mishshavuot sheim yode yeshallem hare ze yishshava achar hashshemitta: 
Hilvahu utevao vechafar bo. vehiggia hashshemitta vehu bichfirato. vehoda achar sheavra sheviit. o shebbau alav edim achar hashsheviit en hashsheviit meshammetet: 
Hammalve et chavero vekava lo zeman leeser shanim eno meshammet. af al pi shehu ba lide <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" hare hu atta eno yachol lingosho. hitna immo shello yitbaennu sheviit meshammetet: 
Hammalve et chavero vehitna immo shello teshammetennu sheviit hare ze nishmat sheeno yachol levattel din hashsheviit. hitna immo shello yeshammet hu chov ze vaafillu bashsheviit tenao kayyam. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam. venimtza ze chiyyev atzmo bemamon shello chiyyevattu tora shehu chayyav: 
Hakkafat hachanut enah nishmetet. veim asaah milve nishmetet. sechar sachir eno nishmat. veim zekafo alav bemilve nishmat: 
Kenasot shel ones veshel mefatte vehammotzi shem ra enam nishmatin. veim zekafan bemilve nishmatim. umeematay nizkafin bemilve mishsheat haamada baddin: 
Hamegaresh et ishto kodem hashshemitta en ketubbatah nishmetet. veim pegamtah o zekaftah alav bemilve nishmetet: 
Hammalve al hammashkon eno mashmit. vehu sheyyihye hachov keneged hammashkon. veim haya yeter mashmit hayyeter: 
Hammoser shitrotav levet din veamar lahem attem gevu li chovi ze eno nishmat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 3)</small> "vaasher yihye lecha et achicha" veze bet din tovin oto. vechen bet din shechatchu et haddin vechatvu ish peloni atta chayyav litten laze kach vechach eno nishmat. shezze kegavuy hu ucheillu ba leyado veeno kemilve: 
Kesheraa hillel hazzaken shennimneu millehalvot ze et ze veovrin al hakkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar" vegomer hitkin perozbul kede shello yishshamet hachov ad sheyyalvu ze et ze. veen happerozbul moil ella bishmittat kesafim bazzeman hazze shehi middivre sofrim. aval shemitta shel tora en happerozbol moil bah: 
En kotvin perozbul ella chachamim gedolim beyoter kevet dino shel rabbi ammi verabbi assi shehen reuyin lehafekia mamon bene adam. aval shear batte dinin en kotvin: 
Zehu gufo shel perozbul. mosrani lachem peloni ufeloni haddayyanin shebbemakom peloni shekkol chov sheyyesh li sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze. vehaddayyanin o haedim chotmin millematta: 
En kotvin perozbul ella al hakkarka. im en karka lallove mocher lo hammalve kol shehu betoch sadehu afillu kelach shel keruv. hishilo makom letannur o lechira kotvin alav perozbul. hayta lo sade memushkenet kotvin aleha perozbul: 
Kotvin leish al nichse ishto velitomim al nichse appatroppus. en lo karka velaarev yesh lo karka kotvin aleha perozbul. haya lo chov al chavero veyesh lachavero karka hoil vehu tachat shibudo kotev alav perozbul: 
Echad shellava mechamishsha tzerichim perozbul lechol echad veechad. vachamishsha shellavu meechad dayyo perozbul echad lechullan: 
Katav happerozbul techilla veachar kach hilva eno moil. ella mashmit ad sheyyichtov happerozbul achar shehilva. nimtzeta omer shekkol milve hakkodemet lifrozbul enah nishmetet bifrozbul ze. veim happerozbul kodem lammilve nishmetet bifrozbul ze: 
Lefichach perozbul hammukdam kasher. vehameuchar pasul. ketzad. ketavo benisan vehikdim zemanno meadar kasher. shehare hura kocho sheeno mashmit ella ad adar. aval im icher zemanno uchetavo meiyyar pasul shehare meyappe kocho sheeno mashmit ad iyyar shello kaddin. sheen dino shello yashmit ella ad nisan bishat mesirat haddevarim levet din: 
Hammotzi shetar chov achar sheviit veen immo perozbul avad chovo. veim amar haya li veavad neeman. shemmizzeman hassakkana veelach baal chov gove shello bifrozbul. velo od ella kesheyyavi baal chov et shetaro o kesheyyavo litboa bemilve al pe omrim lannitba shallem lo. veim taan hannitba veamar ayye perozbul shello. omrim lattovea haya lecha perozbul veavad im amar hen neeman. veim hoda shello katav perozbul avad chovo. vehayetomim enan tzerichin perozbul: 
Hotzi perozbul vetaan hannitba veamar milve zo shehu tovea achar perozbul ze hayta vehattovea omer kodem perozbul hayta hattovea neeman. sheillu amar haya li veavad neeman veaf al pi sheen anu yodin zeman happerozbul sheavad: 
Taan hannitba veamar milve yesh lo etzli. vehattovea omer lo ki ella hakkafat chanut hi sheenah nishmetet shehare lo zakafti milve hare ze neeman. shehare im yirtze yomar milve hayta uferozbul haya li veavad. shekkevan shettikkenu chachamim perozbul chazaka hi sheen adam manniach davar muttar veochel davar asur: 
Talmide chachamim shehilvu ze et ze umasar devarav letalmidim veamar mosrani lachem shekkol chov sheyyesh li sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze eno tzarich lichtov perozbul. mippene shehen yodim shehashematat kesafim bazzeman hazze middivrehem uvidvarim bilvad hi nidchet: 
Kol hammachazir chov sheavra alav sheviit ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. vetzarich hammalve lomar lammachazir mashmit ani uchevar niftarta mimmenni. amar lo af al pi chen retzoni shettekabbel yekabbel mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" vahare lo nagas. veal yomar lo bechovi ani noten lecha ella yomar lo shelli hem uvemattana ani noten lecha: 
Hechezir lo chovo velo amar lo ken. mesabbev immo bidvarim ad sheyyomar lo shelli hem uvemattana netattim lecha. veim lo amar lo yekabbel mimmennu ella yittol meotav veyelech lo: 
Mi shennimna millehalvot et chavero kodem hashshemitta shemma yitacher hachov shello veyishshamet avar belo taase shenneemar hishshamer lecha vegomer. vechet gadol hu shehare hizhira alav tora bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen" vegomer. vechol makom shenneemar hishshamer o pen o al hare ze mitzvat lo taase. vehattora hikpida al machashava raa zo ukeraattu <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "beliyyaal". vahare hosif hakkatuv lehazehir uletzauot shello yimmana ella yitten shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 10)</small> "naton titten lo velo yera levavcha betittecha lo" vegomer. vehivtiach hakkadosh baruch hu bischar mitzva zo baolam hazze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 10)</small> "ki biglal haddavar hazze yevarechcha" vegomer:

Mitzvat ase lispor sheva sheva shanim ulekaddesh shenat hachamishshim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 8)</small> "vesafarta lecha sheva shabbetot shanim" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 25 10)</small> "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim". ushete mitzvot ellu mesurin levet din haggadol bilvad: 
Vmeematay hitchilu limnot. meachar arba esre shana mishshennichnesu laaretz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 3)</small> "shesh shanim tizra sadecha veshesh shanim tizmor karmecha" [ad sheyyihye kol echad makkir et artzo. vesheva shanim asu] bechibbush haaretz vesheva shanim bechilluk. nimtzeta omer bishnat shalosh vachamesh meot vealpayim laytzira merosh hashshana meachar molad adam harishon shehi shana sheniyya laytzira hitchilu limnot. veasu shenat eser vachamesh meot laytzira shehi shenat achat veesrim mishshennichnesu laaretz shemitta. umanu sheva shemittot vekiddeshu shenat hachamishshim shehi shenat arba veshishshim mishshennichnesu laaretz: 
Shiva asar yovlim manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu. veshana sheyyatzu bah shecharav habbayit barishona motzae sheviit hayta ushenat shesh usheloshim bayyovel hayta. shearba meot shana veeser shanim amad bayit rishon. kevan shecharav habbayit batal minyan ze. mishshebbatla nishara haaretz chareva shivim shana venivna bayit sheni. vearba meot veesrim shana amad. uvashshana hashsheviit mibbinyano ala ezra vehi habbia hashsheniyya. umishshana zo hitchilu limnot minyan acher. veasu shenat 13 levinyan bayit sheni shemitta. umanu sheva shemittot vekiddeshu shenat hachamishshim. af al pi shello hayta sham yovel bevayit sheni monin hayu oto kede lekaddesh shemittot: 
Nimtzeta lamed shehashshana shecharav bah habbayit baacharona shettechillatah mittishre sheachar hachurban kishne chodashim shehare mittishre hu hamminyan lishmittim uleyovlot otah hashshana motzae sheviit hayta. ushenat 15 min hayyovel hatteshii hayta. ulefi cheshbon ze shana zo shehi shenat elef umea vesheva lachurban shehi shenat shemonim veshiva veelef vearba meot leminyan shetarot shehi shenat shesh usheloshim utesha meot vearbaat alafim laytzira hi shenat shemitta vehi shenat achat veesrim min hayyovel: 
Aval kol haggeonim amru shemmasoret hi bidehem ish mippi ish shello manu beotan hashshivim shana shebben churban bayit rishon uvinyan bayit sheni ella shemittot bilvad belo yovel. vechen mishshecharav baacharona lo manu shenat hachamishshim ella sheva sheva bilvad mittechillat shenat hachurban. vechen ole baggemara avoda zara cheshbon ze shehu kabbala: 
Ushenat hashshemitta yedua hi umefursemet etzel haggeonim veanshe eretz yisrael. vechullan lo manu ella lishne churban mashlichin otan sheva sheva. ulefi cheshbon ze tehi shana zo shehi shenat sheva umea veelef lachurban motzae sheviit. veal ze anu somchin. uchefi hacheshbon ze anu morin leinyan maasrot usheviit vehashematat kesafim shehakkabbala vehammaase ammudim gedolim behoraa uvahen rauy lehittalot: 
Shenat yovel enah ola mimminyan shene hashshavua. ella shenat tesha vearbaim shemitta ushenat chamishshim yovel. ushenat chamishshim veachat techillat shesh shanim shel shavua vechen bechol yovel veyovel: 
Mishsheggala shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet menashshe batlu hayyovlot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 10)</small> "ukeratem deror baaretz lechol yshveha" bizman shekkol yoshveha aleha. vehu shello yihyu meurbavin shevet beshevet ella kullan yoshvin ketiknan. bizman shehayyovel [noheg baaretz] noheg bechutza laaretz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 10 12)</small> "yovel hi" bechol makom ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit: 
Uvizman shehayyovel noheg noheg din eved ivri. vedin batte are choma. vedin sede charamim vedin sede achuzza. umekabbelin ger toshav venoheget sheviit baaretz vehashematat kesafim bechol makom min hattora. uvizman sheen hayyovel [noheg] eno noheg echad mikkol ellu chutz mishsheviit baaretz. vehashematat kesafim bechol makom middivrehem kemo shebbearnu: 
Mitzvat ase litkoa bashshofar baasiri letishre bishnat hayyovel. umitzva zo mesura levet din techilla (shenneemar 0 "vehaavarta shofar terua") vechol yachid veyachid chayyav litkoa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 9)</small> "taaviru shofar". vetokin bashshofar tesha kederech shettokin berosh hashshana. umaavirin shofar bechol gevul yisrael: 
Shofar shel yovel veshel rosh hashshana echad hu lechol davar. veechad rosh hashshana veechad hayyovel lattekiot. ella shebbayyovel tokin ben bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh ben bevet din shello kiddeshu bo et hachodesh. vechol yachid veyachid chayyav litkoa kol zeman shebbet din yoshvin veshello bifne bet din: 
Uverosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat lo hayu tokin ella bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh. veen kol yachid veyachid tokea ella bifne bet din: 
Shelosha devarim meakkevin bayyovel. tekia veshilluach avadim vehachezarat sadot levaalehen. vezo hi shemittat karka: 
Merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim lo hayu avadim niftarim levattehen velo mishtabedin laadonehen. velo hassadot chozrot levaalehen. ella avadim ochlin veshotim usemechim veatrotehem berashehem. kevan shehiggia yom hakkippurim taku bet din bashshofar nifteru avadim levattehen vechazru sadot levaalehen: 
Din hayyovel bishvitat haaretz vedin hashshemitta echad hu lechol davar. kol sheasur bashsheviit meavodat haaretz asur bishnat yovel. vechol shemmuttar bashsheviit muttar bayyovel. umelachot shellokin alehen bashsheviit lokin alehen bayyovel. vedin perot shenat yovel baachila uvammechira uvabbiur kedin perot sheviit lechol davar: 
Yetera sheviit al hayyovel shehashsheviit meshammetet kesafim velo yovel. veyoter yovel al hashsheviit shehayyovel motzi avadim umashmit karka. vezehu din mechirat sadot haamurot battora vehi mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 24)</small> "geulla tittenu laaretz". yovel meshammet karka bitchillato usheviit enah meshammetet kesafim ella besofah kemo shebbearnu:

Eretz yisrael hammitchalleket lishvatim enah nomkeret litzmitut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 23)</small> "vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut". veim machar litzmitut shenehem ovrin belo taase. veen maasehen moilin ella tachazor hassade livaleha bayyovel: 
Vehammocher sadehu leshishshim shana enah yotza bayyovel sheen chozer bayyovel ella davar hanimkar setam o hanimkar litzmitut: 
Lo yimkor adam beto o sede achuzzato af al pi shehem chozrin achar zeman ella im ken heeni shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 25)</small> "vechi yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato". aval limkor ulehanniach haddamim bechiso o laasot bahen sechora o likkach bahen kelim o avadim uvehema eno rashshay ella limzonot bilvad. veim avar umachar mikkol makom hare ellu mechurin: 
Vedanin bevayit din batte are choma uvesade din sede achuzza. din mocher sede achuzzato lechashshev et haddamim lefi hashshanim hannisharot layyovel. uvechol et sheyyirtze lifdot mechashshev im hallokeach al hashshanim sheachal. vegorea middeme hammocher umachazir lo hashshear: 
Ketzad. hare hannishar layyovel eser shanim umachar lo sade bemea dinar. achalah hallokeach shalosh shanim veratza hammocher ligl noten lo shivim dinar umachazir sadehu. vechen im achalah shesh shanim noten lo arbaim dinar umachazir lo sadehu. lo gealah ella hinnichah beyad hallokeach ad shenat hayyovel tachazor labbealim belo damim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach": 
Mecharah lo vehi melea perot uleachar shete shanim gealah eno yachol lomar lo hachazirenna li melea perot kemo shemmacharti lecha. lefichach im mecharah lo melea perot lifne rosh hashshana ugealah achar shete shanim hare ze ochel shalosh tevuot bishte hashshanim veeno mechashshev immo ella lefi shete shanim bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 18)</small> "al pi hashshanim" lo al pi hattevuot: 
Hakkanim vehazzemorot uferot shikma shebbetochah hare hen shel lokeach kishar happerot shellah. aval ilan shennichsach o sheyyavash shenehen asurin bo. ketzad yaase. yimmacher veyillakach bedamav karka vehallokeach ochel peroteha ad shettiggael hassade miyyado: 
Hallokeach sede achuzza unetaah ilanot vehishbicha keshehi chozeret bayyovel shamin shevach hailanot shebbetochah. venoten baal hassade deme hashshevach lallokeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 33)</small> "veyatza mimkar bayit" mimkar chozer velo hashshevach: 
Hammocher et sadehu bizman shehayyovel noheg kemo shebbearnu eno muttar ligl lefachot mishshete shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach". vaafillu ratza hallokeach asur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shanim achar hayyovel tikne meet amitecha". en pachot mishshete shanim meet leet miyyom hammechira: 
Vetzarich sheyyochal hallokeach shete tevuot bishte shanim veachar kach yigal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "shene tevuot". lefichach im hayta achat mishshete hashshanim sheviit o shenat shiddafon o yerakon enah ola min hamminyan: 
Hinnichah hallokeach bura shana vaachalah shana. o achalah shana venarah shana velo zeraah hare ellu olin lamminyan. mecharah bishnat yovel atzmah enah nimkeret vehaddamim chozrin labbealim: 
Mecharah shana achat lifne hayyovel hare hallokeach ochel otah shana sheniyya achar hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "shene tevuot": 
Machar nekaim meleim mayim o selaim sheenam reuyin lizria hare ze pode befachot mishshete shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot". sade harauy lattevua hi sheenah nigelet ella achar shete shanim. veim lo gealah af al pi sheenah reuya lizria chozeret labbealim bayyovel: 
Machar ilanot en nigalin lefachot mishshete shanim shehare reuyim litvuot. veim lo gealan enan chozrin labbealim bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 27 28)</small> "veshav laachuzzato" velo lailanot: 
Machar sadehu lerishon verishon machar lesheni vesheni lishlishi afillu mea ze achar ze bishnat hayyovel tachazor laadon harishon. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 24)</small> "bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto laasher lo achuzzat haaretz": 
Mecharah lerishon bemea dinar verishon lesheni bematayim veratza haadon ligl eno mechashshev ella im harishon shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 27)</small> "laish asher machar lo". mecharah lerishon bematayim verishon lesheni bemea hare ze mechashshev im haacharon. vechen im machar bemea vehishbicha beyad hallokeach vahare hi reuya lehimmacher bematayim mechashshev lefi ma shemmachar. veim mecharah bematayim vehichsifa vahare hi reuya lehimmacher bemea mechashshev lefi ma shehi. uleolam meyappim koach mocher sede achuzza umerein koach hallokeach: 
Hammocher sede achuzzato vehayu lo sadot acherot umachar meotam hassadot kede ligl sade shemmachar en shomin lo. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "umatza kede geullato" ad sheyyimtza davar sheeno matzuy lo beshaa shemmachar. vechen im lava ligl en shomin lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "vehissiga yado" lo sheyyilve: 
Matza meat veratza ligl chatzi hassade shemmachar en shomin lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "kede geullato". o goel et kullah o eno goel. veim ratzu kerovav ligl goalim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 25)</small> "uva goalo hakkarov elav": 
Hannoten sadehu mattana hare zo chozeret lo bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 13)</small> "tashuvu ish el achuzzato" lerabbot et hammattana: 
Haachin shechalku kelakochot hen umachzirin ze laze chelko bayyovel. lo tibbatel chalukatan mikkemot shehayta. vechen habbechor vehameyabbem eshet achiv machazir bayyovel chelek shennatal venotel hachelek shekkenegdo: 
Aval hayyoresh et ishto af al pi sheyyerushshat habbaal middivrehem asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora veeno machazir bayyovel. veim yarash mimmenna bet hakkevarot yachazir livne mishpacha mishshum pegam mishpacha veyittenu lo dameha umenakkin lo deme kever ishto shehare chayyav bikvuratah:

Hammocher bayit betoch ir hammekkefet choma hare ze goalah kol 12 chodesh miyyom shemmachar bechol et sheyyirtze. vaafillu bayyom shemmachar. uchesherotze lifdot noten kol haddamim shellakach veeno gorea lallokeach kelum: 
Veen hakkerovim podin otah ella hammocher atzmo im hissiga yado. veyesh lo limkor minnechasav velifdoto. aval lo yalve veyigal. velo yigal lachatzain: 
Met hallokeach yifde miyyad beno. vechen im met hammocher yesh livno lifdotah kol 12 chodesh: 
Machar larishon verishon lashsheni betoch hashshana monin larishon. kevan sheshshalma shana rishona huchlat habbayit beyad hashsheni. shehammocher machar lashsheni kol zechut shettavo leyado. higgia 12 chodesh velo gealah hare zo nechletet beyad hallokeach. vechen im natan habbayit mattana velo gealo kol 12 chodesh hare ze nechlat beyad ze shennatan lo mattana: 
Hayta shana meubberet eno nechlat ad sofah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "ad melot lo shana temima" lehavi chodesh haibbur: 
Machar shene battim echad bachatzi adar rishon veechad berosh adar sheni. ze shemmachar berosh adar sheni kevan shehiggia echad baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana. veze shemmachar bachatzi adar rishon lo alta lo shana ad chatzi adar shel shana habbaa mippene sheyyarad hallokeach bechodesh haibbur: 
Higgia yom 12 chodesh velo nimtza hallokeach lifdot mimmennu hare ze manniach meotav bevet din veshover et haddelet venichnas leveto. veematay sheyyavo hallokeach yavo veyittol meotav: 
Hammakdish bet ir choma ugealo acher miyyad hahekdesh kevan shealta lo shana mishshaa shennigal miyyad hahekdesh velo gealo bealav nechlat beyad haggoel. sheen hahekdesh cholet ella hallokeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "lakkone oto ledorotav": 
Machar bet ir choma vehiggia yovel betoch shenat hammecher eno chozer beyovel. ella yihye beyad hallokeach ad sheyyirtze hammocher ligl kol shenat hammecher o timmale shana veyachlot: 
Hammocher bayit bevatte chatzerim o beir sheenah mukkefet choma karauy hare ze nigal bechoach yafe shebbedin hassade veshebbedin habbattim hammukkafin choma. ketzad. im ratza ligl miyyad goel kedin habbattim. higgia 12 chodesh velo gaal hare ze goel ad shenat hayyovel kedin hassadot. uveet sheggoel mechashshev im hammocher vegorea lo ma sheachal. higgia yovel velo gaal chozer habbayit belo damim kedin hassadot: 
Kol shehu lefanim min hachoma kegon hagginnot vehammerchatzaot vehashshovachot hare hu kevattim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "asher bair". aval hassadot shebbetoch hair nigalin kedin hassadot shechutz lair shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "vekam habbayit asher bair". bayit vechol haddome levayit lo hassadot: 
Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno nechlat kevate are choma. virushalayim en habbayit nechlat bah. uvayit habbanuy bachoma eno kevatte are choma: 
Ir sheggaggoteha chomatah o shehayyam chomatah enah kemukkefet choma: 
En hammakom nikra are choma ad sheyyihye bo shalosh chatzerot o yeter uvechol chatzer mehen shene battim o yeter veyakkifuha choma techilla veachar kach yivnu hachatzerot betocho. aval makom sheyyashav veachar kach hukkaf o shello hayu bo shalosh chatzerot shel shene battim eno <small>(Vayikra 25 29)</small> "ir choma" ella battim shebbo kevatte hachatzerim: 
En somchin ella al choma hammukkefet bishat kibbush haaretz. ketzad. ir shello hayta mukkefet choma beshaa shekkavash yehoshua et haaretz af al pi shemmukkefet atta hare hi kevatte hachatzerim. veir shehayta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua af al pi sheenah mukkefet atta hare hi kemukkefet. vechevan sheggalu bechurban rishon batla kedushshat are choma shehayu bime yehoshua. kevan sheala ezra babbia hashsheniyya nitkaddeshu kol hearim hammukkafot choma beoto haet mippene shebbiatan bime ezra shehi bia sheniyya keviatan bime yehoshua. ma biatan bime yehoshua manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayyevu bemaaser. af biatam bime ezra manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayyevu bemaaser: 
Vechen leatid lavo bevia shelishit beet sheyyikkansu laaretz yatchilu limnot shemittin veyovlot vikaddeshu batte are choma veyitchayyev kol makom sheyyichbeshuhu bemaasrot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30 5)</small> "veheviacha Adonai elohecha el haaretz asher yarshu avotecha virishtah". makkish yerushshatcha lirushshat avotecha. ma yerushshat avotecha atta noheg [bah] bechiddush kol haddevarim haellu af yerushshatcha atta noheg bah bechiddush kol haddevarim haellu:

Shevet levi af al pi sheen lahem chelek baaretz kevar nitztauu yisrael litten lahem arim lashevet umigreshehem. vehearim hem shesh are miklat vaalehen shetayim vearbaim ir. ucheshemmosifin are miklat acherot bime hammashiach hakkol lalviyyim:

Migreshe hearim kevar nitparshu battora shehem sheloshet alafim amma lechol ruach mikkir hair vechutza shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 4)</small> "mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv". ulehallan hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la 5)</small> "umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma" vegomer. elef harishonim migrash vealpayim shemmoddin chutz lammigrash lesadot ucheramim:

Venotnin lechol ir bet hakkevarot chutz litchum ze. sheen kovrin metehem litchum arehem shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 3)</small> "umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam velirchusham ulechol chayyatam" lechayyim nittenu velo likvura:
En osin beare haleviyyim ir migrash velo migrash ir velo migrash sade velo sade migrash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher":

Vmippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "lo yimmacher" lo yeshune ella hassade vehammigrash vehair kol echad mishshelashtan kemot shehu leolam. vechen bishar are yisrael:
Lo yistor adam et beto laasoto ginna velo yitta churbato ginna shello yacharivu eretz yisrael:

Kohanim uleviyyim shemmachru sade missede arehem o bayit mibbatte are choma shellahen en goalin kasseder hazze. ella mochrin hassadot vaafillu samuch layyovel vegoalin miyyad. veim hikdishu sade goalim miyyad hahekdesh leachar hayyovel. vegoalim batte are choma kol zeman sheyyirtzu afillu achar kamma shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim":
Yisrael sheyyarash et avi immo levi hare ze goel kilviyyim af al pi sheeno levi hoil vehearim o hassadot shel leviyyim goel leolam. sheddin ze taluy bimkomot ellu velo babbealim:
Velevi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael goel keyisrael velo kilviyyim shello neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim" ella beare haleviyyim:

Kol shevet levi muzharin shello yinchalu beeretz kenaan. vechen hen muzharin shello yittelu chelek babbizzah beshaa shekkovshin et hearim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 1)</small> "lo yihye lakkohanim haleviyyim kol shevet levi chelek venachala im yisrael". chelek babbizza venachala baaretz. vechen hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 18 20)</small> "beartzam lo tinchal vechelek lo yihye lecha betocham" babbizza. uven levi o kohen shennatal chelek babbizza loke. veim natal nachala baaretz maavirin otah mimmennu:

Yerae li sheen haddevarim amurim ella baaretz shennichreta aleha berit leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov virashuha benehem venitchalleka lahem. aval shear kol haaratzot shekkovesh melech mimmalche yisrael hare hakkohanim vehaleviyyim beotan haaratzot uvevizzatan kechol yisrael:

Velamma lo zacha levi benachalat eretz yisrael uvevizzatah im echav mippene shehuvdal laavod et Adonai lesharto ulehorot derachav hayesharim umishpatav hatztzaddikim larabbim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 10)</small> "yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vetoratcha leyisrael". lefichach huvdelu middarche haolam lo orchin milchama kishar yisrael velo nochalin velo zochin leatzman bechoach gufan. ella hem chel hashshem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 11)</small> "barech Adonai chelo". vehu baruch hu zoche lahem shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 20)</small> "ani chelkecha venachalatcha":

Velo shevet levi bilvad ella kol ish veish mikkol bae haolam asher nadva rucho oto vehevino maddao lehibbadel laamod lifne Adonai lesharto uleavdo ledea et Adonai vehalach yashar kemo sheasahu haelohim ufarak meal tzavvaro ol hacheshbonot harabbim asher bikkeshu bene haadam hare ze nitkaddesh kodesh kadashim veyihye Adonai chelko venachalato leolam uleolme olamim veyizke lo baolam hazze davar hammaspik lo kemo shezzacha lakkohanim lalviyyim. hare david alav hashshalom omer <small>(Tehillim 16 5)</small> "Adonai menat chelki vechosi atta tomich gorali":
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 1:
Mitzvat ase laasot bayit laAdonai muchan lihyot makrivim bo hakkarbanot. vechoggin elav shalosh peamim bashshana shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 8)</small> "veasu li mikdash". uchevar nitparesh battora mishkan sheasa moshe rabbenu. vehaya lefi shaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 9)</small> "ki lo vatem ad atta" vegomer:
Kevan shennichnesu laaretz heemidu hammishkan baggilgal arba esre shana shekkavshu veshechilleku. umishsham bau leshilo uvanu sham bayit shel avanim ufarsu yeriot hammishkan alav velo hayta sham tikra. veshst shana amad mishkan shilo ucheshemmet eli charav uvau lenov uvanu sham mikdash. ucheshemmet shemuel charav uvau legivon uvanu sham mikdash. umiggivon bau levet haolamim. vime nov vegivon sheva vachamishshim shana:
Kevan shennivna hammikdash birushalayim neesru kol hammekomot kullan livnot bahen bayit laAdonai ulehakriv bahen karban. veen sham bayit ledore haddorot ella birushalayim bilvad uvehar hammoriyya shebbah neemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 22 1)</small> "vayyomer david ze hu bet Adonai haelohim veze mizbeach leola leyisrael" veomer <small>(Tehillim 132 14)</small> "zot menuchati ade ad":
Binyan shebbana shelomo kevar meforash bimlachim. vechen binyan heatid lehibbanot af al pi shehu katuv bichezkel eno meforash umevoar. veanshe bayit sheni keshebbanu bime ezra banuhu kevinyan shelomo umeen devarim hameforashim bichezkel:
Veellu hen haddevarim shehen ikkar bevinyan habbayit. osin bo kodesh vekodesh hakkadashim veyihye lifne hakkodesh makom echad vehu hannikra ulam. ushelashtan nikrain hechol. veoshin mechitztza acheret saviv lahechol rechoka mimmennu keen kale hechatzer shehayu bammidbar. vechol hammukkaf bimchitza zo shehu keen chatzar ohel moed hu hannikra azara vehakkol nikra mikdash:
Veosin bammikdash kelim. mizbeach laola velishar hakkarbanot. vechevesh sheolim bo lammizbeach. umekomo lifne haulam mashuch ledarom. vechiyyor vechanno lekaddesh mimmennu hakkohanim yedehem veraglehem laavoda. umekomo ben haulam velammizbeach mashuch ledarom shehu semol hannichnas lammikdash. umizbeach lakketoret umenora veshulchan ushelashtan betoch hakkodesh lifne kodesh hakkadashim:
Hammenora baddarom missemol hannichnas veshulchan miyyamin shealav lechem happanim. ushenehem betzad kodesh hakkadashim mibbachutz umizbach hakketoret mashuch mibben shenehem lachutz. veosin betoch haazara gevulin ad kan leyisrael ad kan lakkohanim. uvonim bah battim lishar tzarche hammikdash kol bayit mehem nikra lishka:
Keshebbonin hahechol vehaazara bonin baavanim gedolot. veim lo matzu avanim bonin bilvenim. veen mefatztzelin et avne habbinyan behar habbayit ella mefatztzelin otan umesattetin otan mibbachutz veachar kach machnisin otan labbinyan. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 5 lo)</small> "avanim gedolot avanim yekarot leyassed habbayit avne gazit". veomer <small>(Melachim 1 6 7)</small> "umakkavot vehaggarzen kol keli varzel lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto":
Veen bonin bo etz bolet kelal ella o baavanim o bilvenim vesid. veen osin achsadrot shel etz bechol haazara ella shel avanim o levenim:
Umeratztzefin et kol haazara baavanim yekarot. veim neekra even af al pi shehi omedet bimkomah. hoil venitkalkela pesula veasur lakkohen haoved laamod aleha bishat haavoda ad shettikkava baaretz:
Umitzva min hammuvchar lechazzek et habbinyan ulehagbiho kefi koach hatztzibbur shenneemar <small>(Ezra 9 9)</small> "uleromem et bet elohenu". umefaarin oto umeyappin kefi kochan im yecholin latuach oto bezahav ulehagdil bemaasav hare ze mitzva:
En bonin et hammikdash ballayla shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 15)</small> "uveyom hakim et hammishkan" bayyom mekimin lo ballayla. veoskin babbinyan mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim. vehakkol chayyavin livnot ulesaed beatzman uvemamonam anashim venashim kemikdash hammidbar. veen mevattelin tinokot shel bet rabban labbinyan. veen binyan bet hammikdash doche yom tov:
Hammizbeach en osin oto ella binyan avanim (gazit) veze shenneemar battora <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "mizbach adama taase li" sheyyihye mechubbar baadama shello yivnuhu lo al gabbe kefin velo al gabbe mechillot. veze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "veim mizbach avanim" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno reshut ella chova:
Kol even shennifgema kede shettachgor bah hatztzipporen kesakkin shel shechita hare zo pesula lakkevesh velammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 6)</small> "avanim shelemot tivne et mizbach Adonai". umehechan hayu meviin avne mizbeach min betulat hakkarka chofrin ad shemmaggiin lemakom hannikkar sheeno mekom avoda uvinyan umotziin mimmennu haavanim. o min hayyam haggadol. uvonin mehen. vechen avne hahechol vehaazarot shelemot hayu:
Avne hechol vaazarot shennifgemu o shennigmemu pesulin veen lahen pidyon ella nignazim. kol even shennaga bah habbarzel af al pi shello nifgema pesula levinyan hammizbeach uvinyan hakkevesh shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechalleha". vehabbone even shennaga bah barzel bammizbeach o bakkevesh loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "lo tivne ethen gazit". vehabbone even pagum over baase:
Even shennifgema o shennaga bah barzel achar shennivnet bammizbeach o bakkevesh otah haeven pesula vehashshear kesherot. umelabbenin et hammizbeach paamayim beshana bappesach uvechag. ucheshemmelabbenin otan melabbenin bemappa. aval lo bechafis shel barzel shemma yigga baeven veyifsol:
En osin madregot lammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 23)</small> "lo taale vemaalot al mizbechi". ella bonin kemo tel bidromo shel mizbeach mitmaet veyored merosh hammizbeach ad haaretz vehu hannikra kevesh. vehaole bemaalot al hammizbeach loke. vechen hannotetz even achat min hammizbeach o mikkol hahechol o mibben haulam velammizbeach derech hashechata loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "venittatztem et mizbechotam" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 4)</small> "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem":
Hammenora vecheleha vehashshulchan vechelav umizbach hakketoret vechol kele sharet en osin otan ella min hammattechet bilvad. veim asaum shel etz o etzem o even o shel zechuchit pesulin:
Hayu hakkahal aniyyim osin otan afillu shel bedil veim heeshiru osin otan zahav afillu hammizrakot vehashshippudin vehammaggerefot shel mizbach haola vehammiddot im yesh koach batztzibbur osin otan shel zahav afillu shaare haazara mechappin otan zahav im matza yadam:
En osin kol hakkelim mittechillatan ella leshem hakkodesh. veim naasu mittechillatan lehedyot en osin otan legavoah. ucheli gavoah ad shello nishtammesh bahen gavoah rashshay lehishtammesh bahen hedyot. umishshennishtammesh bahen gavoah asurin lehedyot. avanim vekorot shechatzavan mittechilla levet hakkeneset en bonin otan lehar habbayit:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 2:
