Hammizveach mekomo mechuvvan beyoter. veen meshannin oto mimmekomo leolam. shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 22 1)</small> "ze mizbach leola leyisrael". uvammikdash neekad yitzchak avinu shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 22 2)</small> "velech lecha el eretz hammoriyya". veneemar bedivre hayyamim <small>(divrei hayamim 2 3 1)</small> "vayyachel shelomo livnot et bet Adonai birushalayim behar hammoriyya asher nira ledavid avihu asher hechin bimkom david begoren arnan hayevusi":
Umasoret beyad hakkol shehammakom shebbana bo david ushelomo hammizbeach begoren aravna hu hammakom shebbana bo avraham hammizbeach veakad alav yitzchak. vehu hammakom shebbana bo noach kesheyyatza min hatteva. vehu hammizbeach shehikriv alav kayin vehevel. uvo hikriv adam harishon karban keshennivra umishsham nivra. amru chachamim adam mimmekom kapparato nivra:
Middot hammizbeach mechuvvanot harebe vetzurato yedua ish meish. umizbeach shebbanu bene haggola keen mizbeach sheatid lehibbanot asuhu veen lehosif al middato velo ligroa mimmenna:
Ushelosha neviim alu immahem min haggola. echad heid lahen al mekom hammizbeach. veechad heid lahen al middotav. veechad heid lahen shemmakrivin al hammizbeach hazze kol hakkarbanot af al pi sheen sham bayit:
Mizbeach sheasa moshe vesheasa shelomo vesheasu bene haggola vesheatid leheasot kullan eser ammot gova kol echad mehen. veze hakkatuv battora <small>(Shemot 27 1)</small> "veshalosh ammot komato" mekom hammaaracha bilvad. umizbeach sheasu bene haggola vechen heatid lehibbanot middat arko verachbo 32 ammot al 32 ammot:
Eser ammot shel gova hammizbeach mehen beamma bat chamishsha tefachim umehen beamma bat shishsha tefachim. ushear kol ammot habbinyan beamma bat shishsha tefachim. vegova kol hammizbeach 58 tefachim:
Vechach hayta middato vetzurato. ala chamishsha tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu yesod. nimtza rochav sheloshim amma ushene tefachim al rochav sheloshim amma ushene tefachim. ala sheloshim tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu sovev [ala 18 tefachim zehu mekom hammaaracha] nimtza rachbo shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim al shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim [ala 18 tefachim vechones lekeren zavit shel haych binyan chalul merubba lechol arba keranot] umekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze saviv. vechen mekom ragle hakkohanim amma saviv. nimtza mekom hammaaracha rachbo esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim al esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim:
Gova kol keren vekeren chamishsha tefachim. veribbua kol keren amma al amma. vearba hakkeranot chalulot hayu mittochan. vegova mekom hammaaracha 18 tefachim. nimtza chatzi gova hammizbeach 29 tefachim missof hassovev ulematta:
Vechut shel sikra haya choger beemtza hammizbeach [keshishsha tefachim missof hassovev ulematta] lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim. venimtza gavho min haaretz ad mekom hammaaracha tesha ammot pachot tefach:
Yesod hammizbeach lo haya makkif mearba ruchotav kemo hassovev. ella haya hayesod mashuch keneged kol ruach tzafon umaaravi veochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat. vekeren deromit mizrachit lo haya lah yesod:
Uvekeren maaravit deromit hayu shene nekavim kemin sheni chotamin dakkin. vehen hannikrain shitin shehaddamim yordin bahen umitarvin beotah hakkeren baamma veyotzin lannachal kidron:
Ulematta baritzpa beoto hakkeren haya mekom amma al amma vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat kevua bah shebbo yordin lashshitin umenakkin oto:
Vechevesh haya banuy lidromo shel mizbeach. arko sheloshim ushetayim amma al rochav 16 amma vehaya ochel baaretz sheloshim amma mitztzad hammizbeach. uforeach mimmenna amma al hayesod veamma al hassovev. vaavir meat haya mafsik ben hakkevesh lammizbeach kede litten haevarim lammizbeach bizrika. vegova hakkevesh tesha ammot pachot shetut ad keneged hammaaracha:
Ushene kevashim ketannim yotzim mimmennu shebbahem ponim laysod velassovev umuvdalin min hammizbeach kimlo nima. vechallon hayta bemaaravo shel kevesh amma al amma urevuva hayta nikret. shebbah notnin pesule chattat haof ad shettaavor tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa:
Ushene shulchanot hayu bemaarav hakkevesh echad shel shayish shennotnin alav et haevarim veechad shel kesef shennotnin alav kele hashsharet:
Keshebbonin hammizbeach bonin oto kullo atum kemin ammud veen osin bo chalal kelal. ella mevi avanim shelemot gedolot uketannot umevi sid vezefet vekuneya umemache veshofach letoch malben gadol kemiddato uvone veole. venoten betoch habbinyan guf shel etz o even bekeren deromit mizrachit kemiddat hayesod. vechen noten betoch kol keren vekeren ad sheyyashlim habbinyan veyasir haggufim shebbetoch habbinyan kede shettishshaer keren deromit mizrachit belo yesod veyishshaaru hakkeranot chalulin:
Arba keranot shel mizbeach visodo veribbuo meakkevin. vechol mizbeach sheen lo keren yesod vechevesh veribbua hare hu pasul shearbatan meakkevin. aval middat arko umiddat rachbo umiddat komato enan meakkevin. vehu shello yifchot meamma al amma berum shalosh ammot keshiur mekom hammaaracha shel mizbach midbar:
Mizbeach shennifgam mibbinyano im nifgam mibbinyano tefach pasul pachot mittefach kasher vehu shello yihye bannishar even peguma:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 3:
Hammennora meforeshet tzuratah battora. vearbaa geviim ushene kaftorim ushene perachim hayu bikne hammenora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 34)</small> <small>(Shemot 37 20)</small> "uvammenora arbaa geviim meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha". veod perach shelishi haya samuch lirechah shel menora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 8 4)</small> "ad yerechah ad pirchah": 
Veshalosh raglayim hayu lah. ushelosha kaftorim acherim hayu bikne hammenora shemmehen yotzim sheshet hakkanim. shelosha mitztzad ze ushelosha mitztzad ze. uvechol kane vekane mehen shelosha geviim vechaftor vaferach. vehakkol meshukkadim kemo shekedim baasiyyatan:
Nimtzeu kol haggeviim shenayim veesrim. vehapperachim tisha. vehakkaftorim achad asar. vechullan meakkevin ze et ze vaafillu chaser echad min hashshenayim vearbaim meakkev et kullan:
Bamme devarim amurim besheasauha zahav. aval shear mine mattachot en osin bah geviim kaftorim uferachim. vechen menora habbaa zahav tihye kullah kikkar im neroteha vetihye kullah miksha min haashatot. veshel shear mine mattachot en makpidin al mishkalah. veim hayta chalula keshera:
Veen osin otah leolam min haggerutaot ben shehayta shel zahav ben shehayta shel shear mine mattachot:
Hammelkachayim vehammachtot uchele hashshemen enan mikkelal hakkikkar shehare neemar bammenora <small>(Shemot 25 lo)</small> <small>(Shemot 37 17)</small> "zahav tahor" vechazar veamar umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor. velo neemar neroteha zahav tahor mippene shehannerot kevuin bammenora vehem mikkelal hakkikkar: 
Shivat kene hammenora meakkevin ze et ze. veshivat neroteha meakkevin ze et ze ben shehayta shel zahav ben shehayta shel shear mine mattachot. vechol hannerot kevuim bakkanim:
Sheshet hannerot hakkevuim besheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min hammenora kullan penehem lanner haemtzai sheal kene hammenora veze hanner haemtzai panav keneged kodesh hakkadashim vehu hannikra ner maaravi:
Haggeviim domin lechosot alekkesanderia sheppihen rachav veshulehen katzar. vehakkaftorim kemin tappuchim kerutiyyim shehen arukkin meat kevetza sheshshene rasheha kaddin. vehapperachim kemo pirche haammudim shehen kemin keara usefatah kefula lachutz:
Gova hammenora haya shemona asar tefach. haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim. ushene tefachim chalak. vetefach shebbo gavia kaftor vaferach. utefachayim chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzin mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachim veolin keneged gova hammenora. vetefach chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged gova hammenora. vetefach chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged gova hammenora. utefachayim chalak. nishtayyeru shelosha tefachim shebbahen shelosha geviim kaftor vaferach:
Veeven hayta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot shealeha kohen omed umetiv et hannerot umanniach aleha kele shamnah umalkacheha umachtoteha bishat hatava:
Hashshulchan haya arko shenem asar tefach verachbo shishsha tefachim. vehaya munnach arko leorech habbayit verachbo lerochav habbayit. vechen shear kol hakkelim shebbammikdash arkan learko shel bayit verachban lerochav habbayit chutz min haaron shehaya arko lerochav habbayit. vechen nerot hammenora keneged rochav habbayit ben hatztzafon uven haddarom:
Arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu lashshulchan mefutztzalin berashehen shehayu somchin bahen shete hammaarachot shel lechem happanim. shenayim misseder ze. ushenayim misseder ze. vehem hanneemarim battora <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "ukesotav":
Ushemona veesrim kanim shel zahav kol echad mehen kachatzi kane chalul hayu lo. arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze. vehem hannikraim <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "menakkiyyotav". ushene habbezichin shemmannichin bahen hallevona al hashshulchan betzad hammaarachot hen hannikrain <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "kappotav". vehaddefusin sheosin bahem lechem happanim hem hannikraim <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "kearotav":
Ellu haarbaa asar kanim noten hachalla harishona al atzmo shel shulchan venoten ben rishona usheniyya shelosha kanim. vechen ben kol challa vechalla shelosha kanim. uven shishshit vachamishit shene kanim bilvad lefi sheen al hashshishshit acheret. nimtzeu arbaa asar bechol maaracha umaaracha:
Ushene shulchanot hayu baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit. echad shel shayish notnin alav lechem happanim bichnisato. veechad shel zahav notnin alav lechem bitziato. shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin:
Mizbach hakketoret haya merubba amma al amma. vehu natun bahechol mechuvvan ben hatztzafon laddarom mashuch ben hashshulchan vehammenora lachutz. ushelashtan hayu munnachin mishshelish hahechol velifnim keneged happarochet hammavdil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim:
Hakkiyyor hayu lo shenem asar dad kede sheyyihyu kol hakkohanim haoskim battamid mekaddeshim mimmennu keechad. umucheni asu lo sheyyihyu bah hammayim tamid. vehi chol kede shello yihyu hammayim shebbah nifsalin belina shehakkiyyor mikkele hakkodesh umekaddesh vechol davar sheyyitkaddesh bichli kodesh im lan nifsal:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 4:
Even hayta bekodesh hakkadashim bemaaravo shealeha haya haaron munnach. ulefanav tzintzenet hamman umatte aharon. uveet shebbana shelomo et habbayit veyada shessofo lecharev bana bo makom lignoz bo haaron lematta bematmoniyyot amukot vaakalkallot veyoshiyyahu hammelech tzivva ugenazo bammakom shebbana shelomo shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 la 3)</small> "vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechol yisrael hakkedoshim laAdonai tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem" vegomer. venignaz immo matte aharon vehatztzintzenet veshemen hammishcha vechol ellu lo chazru bevayit sheni. veaf urim vetummim shehayu bevayit sheni lo hayu meshivin beruach hakkodesh. velo hayu nishalin bahen shenneemar <small>(Ezra 2 63)</small> <small>(Nechemya 7 65)</small> "ad amod kohen leurim vetummim". velo hayu osin otan ella lehashelim shemona begadim lechohen gadol kede shello yehe mechussar begadim: 
Bevayit rishon haya kotel mavdil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim avyo amma. vechevan shebbanu habbayit sheni nistappek lahem im ovi hakkotel haya mimmiddat hakkodesh o mimmiddat kodesh hakkadashim lefichach asu kodesh hakkadashim avyo esrim amma temimot veasu hakkodesh arbaim amma temimot vehinnichu amma yetera ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim velo banu kotel bevayit sheni ella asu shete parochot achat mitztzad kodesh hakkadashim veachat mitztzad hakkodesh uvenehen amma keneged ovi hakkotel shehaya barishon. aval bemikdash rishon lo hayta sham ella farochet achat bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 26 33)</small> "vehivdila happarochet lachem" vegomer:
Hahechol shebbanu bene gola haya mea amma al mea amma al rum mea. vechen hayta middat rumo. banu gova shesh ammot atum satum kemo yesod lo. verum katle habbayit arbaim amma verum hakkiyyur shebbattikra amma veal gabbav gova shete ammot panuy sheyyikkanes bo haddelef vehu hannikra bet dilfa. voovi hattikra sheal gabbe bet dilfa amma. umaaziva gova amma. vaaliyya benuya al gabbav gova ketaleha arbaim amma. uvegaggah gova amma kiyyur veammatayim gova bet dilfa veamma tikra veamma maaziva vegova hammaake shalosh ammot vetas shel barzel kemo sayif gavho amma al gabbe hammaake saviv kede shello yanuchu alav haofot vehu hannikra kale orev. hare hakkol mea amma:
Min hammaarav lammizrach mea amma vezehu cheshbonan. arbaa ketalim ze lefanim mizze uvenehen shelosha mekomot penuyin. ben hakkotel hammaaravi uven hakkotel shellefanim mimmennu chamesh ammot uven kotel sheni ushelishi shesh ammot uven kotel shelishi urevii shesh ammot. veellu hammiddot hen shel ovi hakkotel im hammakom happanuy shebben shene ketalim. veorech kodesh hakkadashim esrim amma. uven shete happarochot hammavdilot beno uven hakkodesh amma. veorech hakkodesh arbaim amma. voovi hakkotel hammizrachi shebbo hashshaar shesh ammot vehaulam achat esre amma. voovi kotel haulam chamesh ammot. nimtza hakkol mea amma:
Min hatztzafon laddarom mea amma. ovi kotel haulam chamesh ammot. umikkotel ulam ad kotel hakkodesh eser ammot. vechatle hakkodesh shishsha ketalim ze lefanim mizze uvenehen chamishsha mekomot penuyin. ben kotel chitzon uven hashsheni chamesh ammot. uven sheni ushelishi shalosh ammot. vechamesh ben shelishi urevii. uven revii vachamishi shesh. uven chamishi vechotel happenimi shesh. nimtza hakkol arbaim amma mitztzad ze vearbaim amma mitztzad shekkenegdo verochav habbayit mibbifnim esrim. hare mea amma:
Happishpash vehu shaar hakkatan. ushene pishpashin hayu lahechol mitztzidde hashshaar haggadol shebbeemtza. echad batztzafon veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam meolam vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel <small>(Yechezkel 44 2)</small> "hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach". veshebbatztzafon bo nichnasin. umehallech ben sheni hakketalim ad shemmaggia lemakom patuach lakkodesh missemolo venichnas letoch hahechol umehallech ad shaar haggadol ufotcho:
Hashshaar haggadol haya rachbo eser ammot vegavho esrim amma. vearba daltot hayu lo shetayim bifnim ushetayim bachutz. hachitzonot niftachot letoch happetach lechassot avyo shel kotel vehappenimiyyot niftachot letoch habbayit lechassot achore haddelatot:
Pitcho shel ulam haya gavoah arbaim amma verochav esrim. velo haya lo shearim. vechamesh malteriyyot shel mila hayu al gabbe pitcho millemala. hattachtona odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze. vechol achat mechamishtan odefet al shellematta mimmenna amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtzet haelyona sheloshim amma. venidbach shel avanim haya ben kol achat veachat:
Hahechol haya binyano rachav millefanav vetzar meachorav kemo ari. vitziim hayu makkifin labbayit kullo missaviv chutz lechotel hammesibba. veyatzia hattachtona chamesh veroved al gabbah shesh veyatzia emtzait shesh veroved al gabbah sheva vehaelyona sheva shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 6 6)</small> "hayyatzia hattachtona" vegomer. vechen hayu hashshalosh yetziim makkifim labbayit mishshelosha ruchotav vechen saviv lechatle haulam millematta ad lemala kach hayu amma achat chalak veroved shalosh ammot. veamma chalak veroved shalosh ammot ad lemala. venimtzeu harvadin mukkafin lakketalim. rochav kol roved shalosh ammot ad lemala. uven kol roved veroved amma. veroved haelyon haya rachbo arba ammot:
Kol ellu hammekomot happenuyim shebben hakketalim hem hannikraim taim. nimtzeu hattaim hammukkafin lammikdash chamishsha min hatztzafon vachamishsha min haddarom ushelosha min hammaarav. veshalosh deyotot hayu deyota al gabbe deyota. nimtzeu 15 taim baddarom chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha vachamishsha al gabbehen vechen batztzafon chamishsha asar. ushemona taim hayu bammaarav shelosha al gabbe shelosha ushenayim al gabbehen bidyota achat hakkol 38 taim:
Shelosha petachim hayu lechol echad veechad min hattaim. echad latta min hayyamin. veechad latta min hassemol. veechad latta sheal gabbav. uvekeren mizrachit tzefonit batta shebbaddeyota haemtzait hayu chamishsha petachim. echad latta miyyamin. veechad latta sheal gabbav. veechad lammesibba. veechad latta sheyyesh bo happishpash. veechad lahechol:
Umesibba hayta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit shebbah hayu olin legaggot hattaim. haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav halach et kol pene hatztzafon ad shehu maggia lammaarav. higgia lammaarav hafach panav laddarom halach et kol pene hammaarav ad shehu maggia laddarom. higgia laddarom hafach panav lammizrach vehaya mehallech laddarom ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya sheppitchah shel aliyya haya patuach laddarom:
Uvefitchah shel aliyya hayu shete kelunesot shel erez shebbahen olin legaggah shel aliyya. verashe pispesin hayu mavdilin baaliyya ben gag hakkodesh legag kodesh hakkadashim. velulin hayu petuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkadashim shebbahen meshalshelin et haummanin betevot kede shello yazunu enehem mibbet kodesh hakkadashim. ufaam achat beshana mippesach lefesach melabbenin et hahechol:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 5: Har habbayit vehu har hammoriyya haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma vehaya mukkaf choma. vechefin al gabbe kefin hayu benuyot mittachtav. mippene ohel hattuma. vechullo haya mekore setav lefanim missetav:
Vachamishsha shearim hayu lo. echad min hammaarav veechad min hammizrach veechad min hatztzafon ushenayim min haddarom. rochav kol shaar eser ammot vegavho esrim. veyesh lahem daltot:

Lefanim mimmennu soreg makkif seviv gavho asara tefachim ulefanim min hassoreg hachel [gavho] eser ammot. vealav hu omer bakkinot <small>(Eicha 2 8)</small> "vayyaavel chel vechoma" zo chomat haazara:

Lefanim min hachel haazara. vechol haazara hayta orech 187 al rochav 135. veshiva shearim hayu lah. shelosha min hatztzafon hassemuchin lammaarav. ushelosha min haddarom semuchin lammaarav. veechad bammizrach mechuvvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim baemtza:

Kol shaar mehen haya rachbo eser ammot vegavho esrim amma. vehayu lo delatot mechuppot zahav. chutz mishshaar mizrachi shehaya metzuppe nechoshet doma lezahav. veshaar ze hu hannikra shaar haelyon vehu shaar nikanor:

Haazara lo hayta mechuvvenet beemtza har habbayit. ella rechoka midderom har habbayit yeter mikkol haruchot ukerova lammaarav yeter mikkol haruchot. uvenah uven hatztzafon yeter mimma shebbenah uven hammaarav. uvenah uven hammizrach yeter mimma shebbenah uven hatztzafon:

Velifne haazara bammizrach hayta ezrat hannashim. vehi hayta orech mea amma vachamishsha usheloshim al rochav 135. vearba leshachot hayu bearba miktzeoteha shel arbaim arbaim amma velo hayu mekorot vechen atidin lihyot:

Uma hem meshammeshot. deromit mizrachit lishkat hannezirim sheshsham mevashshelin et shalmehem umegallechin et saaram. mizrachit tzefonit lishkat dir haetzim sheshsham kohanim baale mumin matliim baetzim. shekkol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul. tzefonit maaravit lishkat hametzoraim. maaravit deromit bah hayu notnin yayin veshemen vehi hayta nikret lishkat bet shamnayya:

Ezrat hannashim hayta mukkefet gezuzetra kede sheyyihyu hannashim root millemalan vehaanashim millemattan kede shello yihyu meerbavin. uvayit gadol haya betzad haazara bitzfonah mibbachutz ben haazara vehachel vehaya banuy kippa umukkaf revadin shel even vehu haya nikra bet hammoked. ushene petachim hayu lo echad patuach laazara veechad patuach lachel:

Vearba leshachot hayu bo. shetayim kodesh ushetayim chol. verashe pispesin mavdilin ben hakkodesh vehachol. uma hayu meshammeshot maaravit deromit lishkat hattelaim. uderomit mizrachit lishkat ose lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit bah ganzu bet chashmonay avne mizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan. tzefonit maaravit bah yordin levet hattevila:

Hayyored levet hattevila millishka zo haya holech bammesibba haholechet tachat hammikdash kullo vehannerot dolkot mikkan umikkan ad shemmaggia levet hattevila. umedura hayta sham. uvet hakkisse shel kavod. vezehu kevodo, metzao naul beyadua sheyyesh sham adam:

Orech haazara min hammizrach lammaarav 187 vezehu cheshbonan. mikkotel maaravi shel azara ad kotel hahechol achat esre amma. veorech hahechol kullo mea amma. ben haulam velammizbeach shetayim veesrim. hammizbeach shetayim usheloshim. mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim vehu hannikra ezrat kohanim achat esre amma. mekom derisat ragle yisrael vehu hannikra ezrat yisrael achat esre amma:

Verochav haazara min hatztzafon laddarom mea usheloshim vechamesh vezehu cheshbonan. mikkotel tzefoni ad bet hammitbachayim shemone ammot. bet hammitbachayim 12 ammot umechetza. vesham tolin umafshitin et hakkadashim betziddo:

Mekom hashshulchanot shemone ammot uvo shulchanot shel shayish shemmannichin alehen hannetachim umedichin et habbasar levashshelo. ushemona shulchanot hayu. uvetzad mekom hashshulchanot mekom hattabbaot 24 amma. vesham shochatin et hakkadashim:

Uven mekom hattabbaot vehammizbeach shemone ammot vehammizbeach 32. vehakkevesh sheloshim. uven hakkevesh ulechotel deromi 12 amma umechetza. mikkotel tzefoni shel azara ad kotel hammizbeach shehu rochav shishshim umechetza. uchenegdo mikkotel haulam ad kotel mizrachi shel azara shehu orech shesh veshivim:
Kol hamerubba hazze hu hannikra tzafon hu hammakom sheshshochatin bo kadshe kadashim:

Shemone leshachot hayu beezrat yisrael. shalosh batztzafon. veshalosh baddarom. shebbaddarom lishkat hammelach. lishkat happarva. lishkat hammedichin. lishkat hammelach sham notnin melach lakkarban. lishkat happarva sham molchin orot hakkadashim. veal gaggah hayta bet tevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hammedichin sham hayu medichin kirve hakkadashim umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva. vehashshalosh shebbitzfon lishkat haggazit. lishkat haggula. lishkat haetz. lishkat haggazit shebbah sanhedri gedola yoshevet. vechetzyah haya kodesh vechetzyah haya chol. velah shene petachim echad lakkodesh veechad lechol uvachetzi shel chol hayu hassanhedrin yoshvin. lishkat haggula sham hayta bor shemmemallein mimmennu baggula umishsham mesappekin mayim lechol haazara. velishkat haetz hayta achore shetehen vehi hayta lishkat kohen gadol vehi hannikret lishkat parhedrin. vegag shelashtan shave. ushete leshachot acherot hayu sham beezrat yisrael. achat mimin shaar mizrachi vehu lishkat pinchas hammalbish. veechad missemolo vehu lishkat ose chavitin:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 6: Hammikdash kullo lo haya bemishor ella bemaale hahar. kesheadam nichnas mishshaar mizrachi shel har habbayit mehallech ad sof hachel beshave. veole min hachel leezrat hannashim bishtem esre maalot rum kol maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma:
Umehallech kol ezrat hannashim beshave. veole mimmenna leezrat yisrael shehu techillat haazara bachamesh esre maalot. rum kol maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma:

Umehallech kol ezrat yisrael beshave veole mimmennu leezrat hakkohanim bemaala gevoha amma vealeha duchan yesh bo shalosh maalot. rum kol mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma. nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha al shel yisrael shete ammot umechetza:

Umehallech kol ezrat hakkohanim vehammizbeach. uven haulam velammizbeach beshave. veole mishsham laulam bishtem esre maalot. rum kol mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma vehaulam vehahechol kullo beshave:

Nimtza gova karka hahechol al karka shaar hammizrach shel har habbayit shetayim veesrim ammot. vegova shaar har habbayit esrim amma. lefichach haomed keneged shaar hammizrach eno roe petach hahechol. umippene ze asu kotel sheal gabbe shaar ze namuch. kede sheyyehe kohen haomed behar hammishcha roe petach hahechol beshaa shemmazze middam happara nochach hahechol:

Uleshachot hayu sham tachat ezrat yisrael petuchot leezrat hannashim. sheshsham haleviyyim notnin hakkinnorot vehannevalim vehammetziltayim vechol kele hashshir. veal hadduchan haole meezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim hayu haleviyyim omdim beshaa sheomrim shira al hakkarban:

Halleshachot habbenuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol im hayu gaggotehen shavin im karka haazara tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh veim enan shavin af gaggotehen chol shehaggaggot vehaaliyyot lo nitkaddeshu. lefichach gaggim ellu en ochlin sham kadshe kadashim velo shochatin kadashim kallim:
Hayu benuyot lachol ufetuchot lakkodesh tochan kodesh laachilat kadshe kadashim aval en shochatin sham kadashim kallim vehannichnas lesham betuma patur. vegaggotehen chol lechol davar:
Hammechillot happetuchot laazara kodesh vehappetuchot lehar habbayit chol. hachallonot voovi hachoma kelifnim ben laachilat kadshe kadashim ben letuma:
Bet din sheratzu lehosif al yerushalayim o lehosif al haazara mosifin. veyesh lahem limshoch haazara ad hammakom sheyyirtzu mehar habbayit velimshoch chomat yerushalayim ad makom sheyyirtzu:

En mosifin al hair o al haazarot ella al pi hammelech veal pi navi uveurim vetummim veal pi sanhedrin shel shivim veechad zekenim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 9)</small> "kechl asher ani mare otcha" vechen taasu ledorot. umoshe rabbenu melech haya:

Vechetzad mosifin al hair. osin bet din shete todot velokchin lechem chametz shebbahem veholchim bet din achar shete hattodot ushete hattodot zo achar zo veomdin bechinnorot uvinvalim uvetziltzal al kol pinna ufinna veal kol even (veeven) shebbirushalayim veomer <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani" vegomer. ad shemmaggiin lesof hammakom shemmekaddeshin oto veomdin sham. veochlim sham lechem toda achat mishshete hattodot vehashsheniyya nisrefet. veal pi hannavi sorfin et zo veochlin et zo:

Vechen im hosifu al haazara mekaddeshin otah bishyare hammincha. ma yerushalayim hattoda shenneechelet bah mekaddashtah af haazara sheyare hammenachot sheen neechalin ella bah hen shemmekaddeshin otah bahen. veochlin otan besof hammakom shekkiddeshu:

Kol makom shello naasa bechol ellu vechasseder hazze en kadosh gamur. veze sheasa ezra shete todot zikkaron hu sheasa lo bemaasav nitkaddesh hammakom shello haya sham lo melech velo urim vetummim. uvema nitkaddesha bikdushsha rishona shekkiddeshah shelomo shehu kiddesh haazara virushalayim lishatan vekiddeshan leatid lavo:

Lefichach makrivin hakkarbanot kullan af al pi sheen sham bayit banuy. veochlin kadshe kadashim bechol haazara af al pi shehi chareva veenah mukkefet bimchitztza veochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol yerushalayim af al pi sheen sham chomot shehakkedushsha rishona kadsha lishatah vekadsha leatid lavo:

Velamma ani omer bammikdash virushalayim kedushsha rishona kadsha leatid lavo. uvikdushshat shear eretz yisrael leinyan sheviit umaasrot vechayyotze bahen lo kadsha leatid lavo. lefi shekkedushshat hammikdash virushalayim mippene hashshechina ushechina enah betela. vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 26 lo)</small> "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" veamru chachamim af al pi sheshshommin bikdushshatan hen omdim aval chiyyuv haaretz bishviit uvemaasrot eno ella mippene shehu kibbush rabbim vechevan shennilkecha haaretz midehem batal hakkibbush veniftera min hattora mimmaasrot umishsheviit shehare enah min eretz yisrael. vechevan sheala ezra vekiddeshah lo kiddeshah bechibbush ella bachazaka shehechziku bah ulefichach kol makom shehechziku bah ole bavel venitkaddesh bikdushshat ezra hashsheniyya hu mekuddash hayyom veaf al pi shennilkach haaretz mimmennu vechayyav bishviit uvemaasrot al hadderech shebbearnu behilchot teruma:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 7:
Mitzvat ase leyira min hammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 26 2)</small> "umikdashi tirau". velo min hammikdash atta yare ella mimmi shetztzivva al yirato: 
Vee zo hi yirato lo yikkanes adam lehar habbayit bemaklo o beminal shebberaglav o baafundato o baavak sheal raglav o bemaot hatztzerurin lo bisdino veen tzarich lomar sheasur larok bechol har habbayit ella im nizdammen lo rok mavlio bichsuto. velo yaase har habbayit derech sheyyikkanes mippetach zo veyetze mippetach shekkenegdah kede lekatztzer hadderech ella yakkifo mibbachutz. velo yikkanes lo ella lidvar mitzva:
Vechol hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veyotzin derech semol chutz mimmi sheero davar shehu makkif al hassemol. lefichach hayu shoalin lo ma lecha makkif al hassemol. sheani avel. hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachemcha. sheani menudde. hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten bilvavcha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha:
Kol shehishlim avoda venistallek lo eno yotze vaachorav lahechol ella mehallech achorannit meat meat umehallech benachat al tziddo ad sheyyetze min haazara. vechen anshe mishmar veanshe maamad uleviyyim midduchanan kach hem yotzin min hammikdash kemi shepposea achar tefilla laachorav. kol ze leyira min hammikdash:
Lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar mizrachi shel azara shehu shaar nikanor. mippene shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim. vechol hannichnas laazara yehallech benachat bemakom shemmuttar lo lehikkanes lesham. veyire atzmo shehu omed lifne Adonai kemo shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 9 3)</small> <small>(divrei hayamim 2 7 16)</small> "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim". umehallech beema uveyira ureada shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 55 15)</small> "bevet elohim nehallech beragesh": 
Veasur lechol adam leshev bechol haazara veen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 18)</small> <small>(divrei hayamim 1 17 16)</small> "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai". vehassanhedrin shehayu yoshvin belishkat haggazit lo hayu yoshvin ella bechetzyah shel chal: 
Af al pi shehammikdash hayyom charev baavonotenu chayyav adam bemorao kemo shehaya noheg bo bevinyano. lo yikkanes ella lemakom shemmuttar lehikkanes lesham velo yeshev baazara velo yakel rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 26 2)</small> "et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau". ma shemirat shabbat leolam af mora mikdash leolam sheaf al pi shecharev bikdushshato omed: 
Bizman shehammikdash banuy asur lo leadam lehakel et rosho min hatztzofim shehu chutz lirushalayim velifnim. vehu sheyyihye roe et hammikdash. velo yihye gader mafsik beno uven hammikdash:
Asur leadam leolam sheyyippane o sheyyishan ben mizrach lammaarav. veen tzarich lomar sheen kovin bet hakkisse ben mizrach lammaarav bechol makom mippene shehahechol bemaarav. lefichach lo yippane lemaarav velo lemizrach mippene shehu keneged hammaarav. ella ben tzafon ledarom nifnim vishenim. vechol hammetil mayim min hatztzofim velifnim lo yeshev ufanav kelappe hakkodesh ella letzafon o ledarom o yesallek hakkodesh latztzedadin:
Veasur leadam sheyyaase bayit tavnit hechol. achsadra tavnit ulam. chatzer keneged haazara. shulchan betzurat shulchan. umenora betzurat menora. aval ose hu menora shel chamishsha kanim o shel shemona kanim o menora sheenah shel mattechet af al pi sheyyesh lah shiva kanim:
Shelosha machanot hayu bammidbar. machane yisrael vehu arba machanot. umachane leviyya shenneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 1 50)</small> "vesaviv lammishkan yachanu". umachane shechina vehu mippetach chatzar ohel moed velifnim. uchenegdan ledorot. mippetach yerushalayim ad har habbayit kemachane yisrael. umippetach har habbayit ad petach haazara shehu shaar nikanor kemachane leviyya. umippetach haazara velifnim machane shechina. vehachel veezrat hannashim maala yetera bevet olamim:
Kol eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkol haaratzot. uma hi kedushshatah shemmeviin mimmenna haomer ushete hallechem vehabbikkurim ma sheen meviin ken mishshear aratzot:
Eser kedushshot hen beeretz yisrael vezo lemala mizzo. ayarot hammukkafot choma mekuddashot mishshear haaretz shemmeshallechin mittochan et hametzoraim veen kovrin betochan met ad sheyyirtzu shiva tove hair o kol anshe hair. veim yatza hammet chutz lair en machazirin oto letochah af al pi sheratzu kullan lehacheziro. ratzu bene hair lehotzi hakkever min hammedina mefannin oto. vechol hakkevarot mefannin chutz mikkever navi o melech. kever shehikkifattu hair ben mearba ruchotav ben mishshete ruchot zo keneged zo im hayta beno uven hair yeter mechamishshim amma lechan vachamishshim lechan en mefannin oto ad sheyyirtzu kullan. pachot mikkan mefannin oto:
Yerushalayim mekuddeshet mishshear haayarot hammukkafot choma. sheochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni lefanim mechomatah. veellu devarim shenneemru birushalayim. en melinin bah et hammet. veen maavirin betochah atzmot adam. veen maskirin betochah battim. veen notnin betochah makom leger toshav. veen mekayyemin bah kivrot chutz mikkivre bet david vekever chulda shehayu bah mimot neviim harishonim. veen notin bah gannot ufardesim. veenah nizraat veenah nechereshet shemma tisrach. veen mekayyemin bah ilanot chutz migginnat veradim shehayta sham mimot neviim harishonim. veen mekayyemin bah ashpa mippene hashsheratzim. veen motziin hemenna zizin ugezuzetraot lirshut harabbim mippene ohel hattuma. veen osin bah kivshonot mippene heashan. veen megaddelin bah tarnegolot mippene hakkadashim. vechen lo yegaddelu hakkohanim tarnegolim bechol eretz yisrael mippene hattohorot. veen habbayit nechlat bah. veeno mittamme bingaim. veenah naaset ir hanniddachat. veenah mevia egla arufa lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim:
Har habbayit mekuddash mimmenna sheen zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot nichnasin lesham. umuttar lehachenis hammet atzmo lehar habbayit veen tzarich lomar teme met shehu nichnas lesham:
Hachel mekuddash mimmennu sheen akkum uteme met uvoel nidda nichnasim lesham:
Ezrat hannashim mekuddeshet min hachel sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham. veissur ze middivrehem aval min hattora muttar litvul yom lehikkanes lemachane leviyya. uteme met shennichnas leezrat hannashim eno chayyav chattat:
Ezrat yisrael mekuddeshet meezrat nashim sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham. vetame shennichnas lesham chayyav karet:
Ezrat hakkohanim mekuddeshet mimmenna. sheen yisrael nichnasin lesham ella bishat tzarchehem lismicha ulechappara velishchita velitnufa:
Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna sheen baale mumin uferue rosh ukerue begadim nichnasin lesham:
Hahechol mekuddash mibben haulam velammizbeach. sheen nichnas lesham ella rechutz yadayim veraglayim:
Bet kodesh hakkadashim mekuddash mimmennu sheen nichnas lesham ella kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim bishat haavoda:
Makom shehaya baaliyya mechuvvan al kodesh hakkadashim en nichnasin lo ella paam achat beshavua leda ma hu tzarich lechazzek bidko. beshaa shennichnasin habbannaim livnot uletakken bahechol o lehotzi mishsham et hattuma. mitzva sheyyihyu hannichnasin kohanim temimim. lo matzu temimim yikkansu baale mumin. veim en sham kohanim yikkansu leviyyim. lo matzu leviyyim yikkansu yisrael. mitzva bithorim. lo matzu tehorim yikkansu temeim. tame uvaal mum yikkanes baal mum veal yikkanes tame shehattuma dechuya betzibbur. vechol hannichnasin lahechol letakken yikkansu betevot. im en sham tevot o i efshar lahem sheyyaasu betevot yikkansu derech petachim:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 8: Shemirat hammikdash mitzvat ase. veaf al pi sheen sham pachad meoyvim velo millistim. sheen shemirato ella kavod lo. eno dome palterin sheyyesh alav shomrin lefalterin sheen alav shomrin:

Ushemira zo mitzvatah kol hallayla. vehashshomrim hem hakkohanim vehaleviyyim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 2)</small> "veatta uvanecha ittach lifne ohel haedut". kelomar attem tihyu shomrim lo. vahare neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 4)</small> "veshamru et mishmeret ohel moed" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> "vehachonim kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav shomre mishmeret hakkodesh":

Veim bittelu shemira avru belo taase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 5)</small> "veshamru et mishmeret hakkodesh". uleshon shemira azhara hi ha lamadta sheshshemirato mitzvat ase. uvittul shemirato mitzvat lo taase:
Mitzvat shemirato sheyyihyu hakkohanim shomrim mibbifnim vehaleviyyim mibbachutz. vechd eda shomrin oto bechol layla tamid bechd makom. hakkohanim bishlosha mekomot vehaleviyyim bech makom:

Vehechan hayu shomrim. kohanim hayu shomrim bevet avtinas uvevet hannitzotz uvevet hammoked. bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot benuyot betzad shaare haazara veharovin hayu shomrim sham. bet hammoked kippa uvayit gadol haya mukkaf revadin shel even vezikne bet av shel oto hayyom hayu yeshenim sham umaftechot haazara beyadam:

Lo hayu hakkohanim hashshomrim yeshenim bevigde kehunna ella mekappelin otan umannichin otan keneged rashehen velovshin bigde atzman vishenim al haaretz. kederech kol shomre chatzrot hammelachim shello yishnu al hammittot:

Era keri laechad mehen. holech bammesibba shettachat hakkarka shehammechillot happetuchot lehar habbayit lo nitkaddeshu vetovel vechozer veyoshev etzel echav hakkohanim ad shenniftachin hashshearim babboker yotze veholech lo:

Vehechan hayu haleviyyim shomrim. al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. veal arba pinnotav mittocho. veal arba pinnot haazara mibbachutz sheasur leshev baazara. veal chamishsha shaare haazara chutz laazara shehare hakkohanim shomrim al shaar hammoked veal shaar hannitzotz. hare shemona asar makom:
Veod shomrim belishkat hakkarban uvelishkat happarochet vaachore bet hakkapporet:

Umaamidin memunne echad al kol mishmerot hashshomrim. veish har habbayit haya nikra. vehaya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar kol hallayla. vaavukot delukot lefanav. vechol mishmar sheeno omed veomer lo ish har habbayit shalom alecha nikkar shehu yashen chovto bemakkelo. ureshut haya lo lisrof et kesuto ad shehayu omrin birushalayim ma kol baazara kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin sheyyashan al mishmarto:

Bashshachar kodem sheyyaale ammud hashshachar samuch lo yavo hamemunne shel mikdash veyidpok al hakkohanim shebbevet hammoked vehen potchin lo. natal et hammafteach ufatach et hashshaar hakkatan shebben bet hammoked uven haazara venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara venichnesu acharav hakkohanim ushete avukot shel ur beyadam venechleku lishte kittot. kat holechet lemizrach vechat holechet lemaarav. vehayu bodkin veholchin et kol haazara ad sheyyaggiu shete hakkittot limkom bet ose chavitin. higgiu ellu veellu omrin shalom hakkol shalom. veheemidu ose chavitin laasot chavitin:
Kasseder hazze osin bechol layla velayla chutz millele shabbat sheen beyadam ur ella bodkin bannerot haddelukin sham meerev shabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels of the Sanctuary: Mitzvat ase laasot shemen hammishcha sheyyihye muchan lidvarim shetztzerichin meshicha bo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30, 25)</small> "veasita oto shemen mishchat kodesh":

Vechacha asahu moshe rabbenu bammidbar. lakach min hammor vehakkinnamon vehakkidda mikkol echad mishshelashtan chamesh meot shekel beshekel hakkodesh. umikkene habboshom chamishshim umatayim. vezehu shenneemar battora <small>(Shemot 30 23)</small> "vekinneman besem machatzito chamishshim umatayim" sheshshoklim oto bishte peamim chamishshim umatayim bechol paam. veshochek kol echad veechad levaddo. veerev hakkol veshara otan bemayim zakkin umetukin ad sheyyetze kol kochan bammayim venatan al hammayim shemen zayit hin vehu 12 log. kol log arba reviiyyot. uvishshel hakkol al haesh ad sheavdu hammayim venishar hashshemen vehinnicho bichli ledorot:

Hammor hu haddam hatztzarur bechayya shebbehoddu hayyadua lakkol shemmitbassemin bah bene adam bechol makom. vehakkinnamon hu haetz shebba meiyye hoddu sherecho tov umitgammerim bo bene adam. vehakkidda hi hakkosht. ukene boshom hem hakkanim haddakkim keteven haadummim habbaim meiyye hoddu verechan tov vehem mimmine habbesamim shennotnin otam harofim betzori:

Haose shemen hammishcha kammaase hazze vechammishkal hazze velo hosif velo gara bemezid chayyav karet. beshogeg mevi chattat kevua shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 33)</small> "asher yirkach kamohu" <small>(Shemot 30 33)</small> "venichrat meammav". vehu sheyyaase oto lehimmashach bo. aval im asahu lehitlammed o litteno laacherim patur:

Hassach mishshemen hammishcha kezayit bemezid chayyav karet. uveshogeg mevi chattat kevua shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 33)</small> "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar venichrat meammav". veen chayyavin ella al sichat shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe shenneemar mimmennu. mizze shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 30 lo)</small> "shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li". umeolam lo naasa shemen acher chutz mimma sheasa moshe:

Echad hassach et atzmo veechad hassach et acherim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 33)</small> "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar". hassach kelim uvehema veakkum shehem kemotah o shessach metim bo patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 32)</small> "al besar adam lo yisach":

En moshchin mimmennu ledorot ella kohanim gedolim umeshuach milchama umalche bet david bilvad. afillu kohen ben kohen moshchin oto. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 15)</small> "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav" vegomer:
Bevayit sheni shello haya sham shemen hammishcha haya kohen gadol mitrabbe bilvishat begadim bilvad shehaya lovesh bigde kehunna gedola:

Ketzad moshchin et hakkohen. tzak et hashshemen al rosho vesach mimmennu al gabbe enav kemin ki yevanit kaze X shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 8 12)</small> "vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon vayyimshach oto lekaddesho". umalche bet david moshchin otan kemin nezer al rosho. velo yimshach bimkomot acherot velo yarbe beshemen:

Hannoten mishshemen hammishcha al gabbe melech o kohen gadol shekkevar nimshechu patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 33)</small> "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar" veen ellu zarim etzlo. aval hassach mimmennu afillu lemelech vechohen gadol chayyav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 32)</small> "al besar adam lo yisach" kol adam bemashma. vechohen gadol shennatal shemen hammishcha merosho vesach bemeav chayyav karet vehu sheyyasuch mimmennu bichzayit:

En moshchin et hammelech ella al gabbe hammayan. veen moshchin melech ben melech shehammalchut yerushsha lammelech leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". veim hayta sham machloket moshchin oto kede lesallek hammachaloket ulehodia lakkol shezzehu melech levaddo. kemo shemmashchu shelomo mippene machloket adoniyyahu. veyoash mippene atalya. vihoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv. veze shemmashach elisha leyehu lo beshemen hammishcha meshacho ella beshemen afarsemon. vedavar ze masoret beyad hachachamim:

Kol kele hammikdash sheasa moshe bammidbar lo nitkaddeshu ella bimshichatan beshemen hammishcha shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 7 1)</small> "vayyimshachem vaykaddesh otam". vedavar ze eno noheg ledorot. ella hakkelim kullan kevan shennishtammeshu bahen bammikdash bimlachtan nitkaddeshu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 4 12)</small> "asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh" besherut hem mitkaddeshin:

Hakkappot vehakkearot shemmekabbelin bahem hammenachot vechen hammizrakot shemmekabbelin bahen haddam ushear kele hashsharet kullan shel kesef veshel zahav hayu umuttar laasotan mishshear mine mattachot kemo shebbearnu vechullan mitkaddeshin bimlachtan. veim nishberu mattich otam veose otan keli acher veen kedushshatan mistalleket mehen leolam:
Kele hakkodesh shennikkevu o shennisdeku en sotmin otan ella mattichin otan veosin otan chadashim:
Sakkin shennishmat min hannitztzav o shennifgam en machazirin oto veen mashchizin oto. ella gonzin oto betzad hahechol ben hakkodesh vehaulam laddarom veosin acherim. sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut:
Shete middot shel yavesh hayu bammikdash. issaron. vachatzi issaron. haissaron limnachot. vachatzi haissaron lechallek bo minchat kohen gadol shebbechol yom:

Vesheva middot shel lach hayu sham. hin. vachatzi hahin. ushelishit hahin. ureviit hahin. velog. vachatzi log. ureviit. velamma hayu chatzi hahin ushelishit hahin ureviit hahin. limdidat hannesachim shel zevachim. velog limdidat shemen hammenachot. vachatzi log limdidat shemen lechol ner minnerot hammenora. ureviit lechallek bah hashshemen lachavitin:

Veen lanu davar limdod bo hin velamma haya sham. hoil vehaya bammikdash mime moshe shemmadad bo shemen leshemen hammishcha. uvachatzi log sheyyihye bammikdash hayu moddin mayim leme sota veshemen letoda. uvarviit shehayta sham hayu moddin shemen lechem hannazir. umayim letohorat metzora. velo mippene maasim ellu nitkaddeshu ella mippene hammelachot shel mikdash sheamarnu:

Kol hammiddot haellu kodesh umikkele hashsharet. ella shemmiddot hallach nimshechu mibbifnim umibbachutz. uchele hayyavesh lo nimshechu ella bifnim. lefichach berutze middot hallach kodesh. uverutze middot hayyavesh chal:

Haketoret naaset bechol shana veshana vaasiyyato mitzvat ase shenneemar veatta kach lecha sammim vegomer. venitparshu battora arbaa missammaneha. vehen <small>(Shemot 30 34)</small> "nataf. ushechelet. vechelbena. ulevona". ushear sammaneha halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Achad asar sammanim neemru lo lemoshe missinay. vehem sheosin otan bemishkal mechuvvan. umosifin immahen belo mishkal melach sedomit vechippat hayyarden. veesev echad shemmaale ashan. velo hayu yodim oto ella anashim yeduim vehu haya halacha beyadam ish mippi ish:
Vezehu mishkal achad asar sammaneha. nataf. ushechelet. vechelbena. ulevona. mikkol echad mishkal shivim mane. vehammane mea dinarin. umor. uketzia. veshibbolet nerd. vecharkom. mikkol echad shishsha asar mane. kosht shenem asar mane. kinnamon tisha manim. killufa shelosha manim. mishkal hakkol shelosh meot veshishshim ushemona mane. shechukin hakkol hadek. mosifin lah rova hakkav melach sedomit. vechippat hayyarden umaale ashan kol shehu. umaktir mimmenna bechol yom al mizbach hazzahav mane. shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha mane keneged yemot hachamma. vehashshelosha manim hannisharim shochek otam erev yom hakkippurim dakka min haddakka ad shemmotzi mimmenna male chafnav lehaketir beyom hakkippurim. vehashshear hu motar hakketoret sheamarnu bishkalim:
Nataf haamur battora hu atze hakketaf sheyyotze mehen hatztzori. vehashshechelet hi hatztzipporen shennotnin otah bene haadam bemugmarot. vehachelbena kemo devash shachor verecho kashe vehu seraf ilanot beare yavan. vezehu shemot hassammanim belashon aravi. ud belasan veatzfar tiv. umia. ulechan. umuseki. uketzia. vesanbeli alnatorin. vezaafran. vekosht. veud [hayyardi]. vekassar selicha. veinbar:
Ketzad mefattemin et hakketoret. mevi tisha kabbin borit karshina veshaf bah et hatztzipporen veachar kach shore et hatztzipporen beechad veesrim kav shel yen kafrisin o yayin lavan yashan chazak beyoter. veachar kach shochek kol echad min hassammanim bifne atzmo hadek. ucheshehu shochek omer hadek hetev hadek hetev kol zeman sheshshochek umearev hakkol:
Vechol maaseha bakkodesh betoch haazara umishshel hakkodesh. vehamefattem et hakketoret min hachullin o bichli shel chullin pesula:
Paamayim bashshana hayu machazirin oto lammachteshet. bimot hachamma hayu mefazzerim otah kede shello titappesh. uvimot haggeshamim tzovrin otah kede shello yafug rechah:
Natan letochah devash kol shehu pesalah. chisser echad missammaneha chayyav mita shehare naaset ketoret zara. pittemah meat meat bematkuntah keshera afillu pittem peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim:
Haose ketoret meachad asar sammanin ellu lefi mishkalot ellu kede lehariach bah af al pi shello heriach chayyav karet al asiyyatah im asa mezid. uveshogeg mevi chattat kevua. af al pi shello asa hammishkal kullo ella chetzyo o shelisho. hoil veasa lefi mishkalot ellu chayyav karet. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 37)</small> "bematkuntah lo taasu lachem" <small>(Shemot 30 38)</small> "ish asher yaase chamoha lehariach bah venichrat meammav":
Asaah lehitlammed bah o lemasrah latztzibbur patur. heriach bah velo asaah eno chayyav karet ella dino kedin kol hannehene min hahekdesh. lo chiyyeva tora karet ella laose bematkuntah lehariach bah:
Mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol alav maktirin hakketoret bechol yom. veen makrivin alav davar acher. veim hiktir alav ketoret acheret sheenah kazo. o shehiktir alav ketoret kazo shehitnaddev otah yachid o rabbim. o hikriv alav karban. o hissich nesech. loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 9)</small> "lo taalu alav ketoret zara veola umincha" vegomer:
Beet shemmolichin et haaron mimmakom lemakom en molichin oto lo al habbehema velo al haagalot ella mitzva lenatlo al hakkatef. ulefi sheshshachach david unesao al haagala nifratz peretz beuzza. ella mitzva lenaso al hakkatef shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 7 9)</small> "ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau":
Keshennosim oto al hakkatef nosin panim keneged panim vaachorehem lachutz ufenehem lefanim. venizharim shello yishshamtu habbaddim min hattabbaot. shehammesir echad min habbaddim min hattabbaot loke. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 15)</small> "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu":

Zera levi kullo muvdal laavodat hammikdash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 8)</small> "baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi". umitzvat ase lihyot haleviyyim penuyin umuchanin laavodat hammikdash ben ratzu ben shello ratzu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 23)</small> "veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed". uven levi shekkibbel alav kol mitzvot leviyya chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto ad sheyyekabbel et kullan:

Avoda shellahen hi sheyyihyu shomrin et hammikdash. veyihyu mehen shoarin liftoach shaare hammikdash ulehagif daltotav. veyihyu mehen meshorrin leshorer al hakkarban bechol yom. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 7)</small> "vesheret beshem Adonai elohav kechol echav haleviyyim". e zehu sherut shehu beshem Adonai heve omer zo shira. umatay omer shira al kol olot hatztzibbur hachova veal shalme atzeret beet nissuch hayyayin. aval olot nedava shemmakrivin hatztzibbur lekayitz lammizbeach. vechen hannesachin habbain bifne atzman. en omrin alehen shira:

Levi haonen muttar laavod uleshorer. veen pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdim al hadduchan bechol yom lomar shira al hakkarban umosifin ad leolam veen omrin shira ella bappe belo keli sheikkar hashshira shehi avodatam bappe. vaacherim hayu omdim sham menaggenin bichle shir. mehen leviyyim umehen yisreelim meyuchasin hammassiin lichhunna. sheen ole al hadduchan ella meyuchas. veen ellu hameshorrim al pi hakkelim olin leminyan hashshenem asar:

Uvamme hem menaggenin. binvalim vachalilim vechinnorot vachatzotzrot vehatztziltzal. veen pochatin mishshene nevalim velo mosifin al shishsha. veen pochatin mishshene chalilim velo mosifin al shenem asar. veen pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot velo mosifin al esrim umea. veen pochatin mittisha kinnorot umosifin ad leolam. vehatztziltzal echad bilvad:

Bime hammoadot kullam uverashe chodashim hayu hakkohanim tokim bachatzotzrot bishat hakkarban vehaleviyyim omrin shira shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 10 10)</small> "uveyom simchatchem uvemoadechem uverashe chadshechem utekatem bachatzotzrot". hachatzotzra hayta naaset min eshet shel kesef. asa otah min haggerutaot shel kesef keshera. mishshear mine mattachot pesula. vehachalilin shehayu menaggenin bahen haya abbuv shellahen shel kane. mippene shekkolo arev. velo haya mechallek ella beabbuv yechidi mippene shehu mechallek yafe:

Bishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach. bishchitat pesach rishon. uvishchitat pesach sheni. uveyom tov harishon shel pesach. uvayyom harishon shel atzeret. uvishmona yeme hechag. vechalil ze doche shabbat mippene shehu chalil shel karban vechalil shel karban avoda hi vedocha et hashshabbat:

En ben levi nichnas laazara laavodato ad sheyyelammeduhu chamesh shanim techilla. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 8 24)</small> "zot asher lalviyyim mibben chamesh veesrim shana" vechatuv echad omer <small>(Bamidbar 4 3)</small> "mibben sheloshim shana". ha ketzad. chamesh lilmod. veeno nichnas laavoda ad sheyyagdil veyihye <small>(Bamidbar 4 19)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 4 49)</small> ish shenneemar "ish ish al avodato":

Ze shenneemar battora balviyyim <small>(Bamidbar 8 25)</small> "umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda" eno ella bizman shehayu nosin hammikdash mimmakom lemakom. veeno mitzva noheget ledorot. aval ledorot en hallevi nifsal beshanim velo bemumin ella bekol sheyyitkalkel kolo merov hazzikna yippasel laavodato bammikdash. veyerae li sheeno nifsal ella lomar shira aval yihye min hashshoarim:

Shemuel haroe vedavid hammelech chilleku haleviyyim learbaa veesrim mishmarot. veoved mishmar bechol shabbat. vechol anshe mishmar mechallek otam rosh hammishmar levatte avot. vechol yom mime hashshabbat ovdim bo anashim yeduim. verashe haavot mechallekin ellu haovdim bayyom shellahen ish ish al avodato. vechol haleviyyim muzharin al avodat hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "ach el kele hakkodesh veel hammizbeach lo yikravu velo yamutu" lo yikravu laavoda aval ligga muttarin:

Ucheshem shehaleviyyim muzharin shello laavod avodat hakkohanim. kach hakkohanim muzharin shello laavod avodat haleviyyim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "gam hem" <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "gam attem". vechen haleviyyim atzmam muzharim shello yaase echad melechet chavero. shello yesayyea hameshorer lashshoer velo hashshoer lamshorer shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 4 19)</small> "ish ish al avodato veel massao":

Leviyyim sheavdu avodat hakkohanim o shessiyyea levi bimlacha sheenah melachto chayyavin mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "velo yamutu". aval kohen sheavad avodat levi eno bemita ella belo taase:
